title: Invoice Query Routing Assistant
description:
Invoice Query Routing Assistant

Customer Service / Billing Enquiries / Remote
£30.00–£32.00 hourly · Full-time or part-time

An invoice question needs the right facts and the right person

Customers sometimes write because they cannot find an invoice, do not recognise a reference or want to know where to direct a payment question. The Invoice Query Routing Assistant receives those messages, checks the ordinary account information available to the role and moves each question towards an accurate answer. You would provide straightforward information that the employer has authorised you to share. Disputes, adjustments and payment decisions belong to the relevant billing colleague.

This is a remote, online customer service job with a defined boundary. You may locate a document already issued, explain how to find a reference or ask for a missing invoice number. You would not independently waive a charge, change an amount, give financial advice or promise that a dispute will be upheld. The distinction matters to the customer: a helpful acknowledgement should say what is being checked and what will happen next, without presenting a possible outcome as a decision.

The work can be described as triage with follow-through. First identify whether the message concerns a missing copy, an account detail, a payment status question or a challenge to the invoice. Then check the permitted record, note what information is already available and send it or direct the issue according to the team’s process. A handoff should include the invoice reference, the customer’s question and any relevant action already taken. It should not include guesses about why a charge appears.

What a day could contain

You might receive a request for a duplicate invoice and check that it can be sent to the stated contact. Another customer may provide only a transaction date; you would ask for the reference or other permitted identifying detail needed to locate the record. Someone else may say a line on an invoice seems wrong. You would acknowledge that concern and send it for review with the exact line and the customer’s explanation. In each case, you keep the question tied to the original message and record the current status.

Your writing should be plain and considerate. Money-related questions can be frustrating, and a generic reply can make a customer feel unheard. A good response identifies the specific document or issue, avoids jargon and gives a realistic next step. Where you cannot share an invoice because identity or recipient details are unclear, you would use the approved verification route instead of attaching a document to an unconfirmed address. The employer will teach these boundaries.

Background that fits

No accounting qualification is required. Previous customer service, reception, invoice filing or office administration experience may help, but applicants with little or no experience are welcome. You need basic computer use, care with numbers and references, and the ability to write a clear message. Training will explain the billing system and which enquiries can be answered routinely. You should not feel pressure to solve a financial dispute outside your remit.

There may be a queue of open questions at different stages. You would keep a brief record of whether a reply has been sent, a document requested or a billing colleague asked to review an item. A finished task means the customer has received the authorised information or the enquiry has been handed to someone who can decide it. Simply forwarding an email with no context is not a good handoff.

Remote work calls for careful handling of account information through the approved online system. A suitable home office area can help you keep customer details private while working through written enquiries. The opening can be arranged for full-time or part-time hours, with an hourly range of £30.00–£32.00.

About applying

Your CV need not show a billing job to be relevant. Written customer contact, accurate use of references and sensible escalation from another role are all useful examples. Please describe only the financial tasks you have genuinely performed; this opening does not require independent accounting decisions. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. The company can discuss its billing process and hours with candidates who continue.

title: Hosp Inventory Spec 1 Portland
description:
We have an excellent opportunity for part-time Hospital Inventory Specialist I positions to join our team at Bloodworks Northwest. Serve as a primary Customer Service Representative to multiple customers while processing orders for blood components. Recommend component substitutions to maximize overall blood inventory utilization. Arrange shipping logistics and transportation in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines.

Principal responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Hospital Inventory Specialist I:

Consolidate and organize blood components by blood type and expiration Date into a first-in, first-out inventory system to maximize utilization of blood resources.
Receive, prioritize, and expedite emergency and routine blood orders from multiple customers, including but not limited to regional hospitals, resource-sharing customers, and other internal Bloodworks laboratories.
Perform electronic data entry to capture all critical processing steps. Document all critical processing information manually when the computer cannot generate records.
Perform manual entry of required regulatory information into departmental forms in accordance with Bloodworks' Quality Policies and Procedures and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

Maximize utilization of available blood resources by selecting appropriate blood components (based on blood type and expiration dates) to fill customer orders. Communicate to customers, based on established criteria, acceptable product substitutions resulting from inventory limitations.

Serve as a liaison between external customers and Bloodworks medical staff regarding patient care and regulatory issues. Communicate pertinent information and problems pending resolution to the Supervisor and staff person(s) assigned to the next shift.
Inspect for suitability and label routine platelet components with the appropriate ABO/Rh type.
Inspect and electronically accept imported blood components into the Bloodworks inventory.
Operate computer systems relevant to the work performed in the department at this level, including:
BBCS
Rees Centron software
Microsoft Office PC applications
Crystal Reports Viewer (BusinessObjects) software
ETQ Reliance software
BloodHub software
WellSky(Providence System software)

Package blood components for Blood Services Hospitals, out-of-region customers, and Bloodworks satellite laboratories, following appropriate regulatory guidelines for product stability.
Arrange transportation logistics for routine blood deliveries to local, regional, and resource-sharing customers. Recommend the most suitable transportation options for STAT and ad hoc orders to meet customer needs while managing Bloodworks expenses effectively.
Coordinate the distribution of outgoing blood components and samples from the Portland site to a variety of laboratories at the Bloodworks Central facility, donor collection facilities, and other Bloodworks locations and departments.
Support the department's mission by providing exceptional customer service. This is done by demonstrating proficiency in the following areas:
Telephone communication skills, demonstrating a professional attitude
Knowledge and support of other Bloodworks departments
Transferring phone calls
Contacting the Bloodworks Physician On-Call (POC)
Comprehension of Bloodworks blood component return & credit policies
Comprehension of Bloodworks product substitution policies
Understanding of, and diplomacy in, reducing hospital orders when needed
Comprehension of FDA regulations/GMPs for customer inquiries on regulatory issues
Thorough understanding of various transportation options, including schedules and costs
Diplomacy and tact in dealing with challenging customers and situations
Coordinate requests for rare blood units and secondary processing of blood components unavailable on site.
Coordinate and document the follow-up to regulatory look-back notifications (blood product recalls) for blood components issued to regional hospitals, out-of-region customers, or to inventory located within the Portland Branch.
Support Providence Health & Services with automated batch-type confirmation of Red Cells, where qualified.
Monitor and proactively oversee inventory levels for the Portland Branch and Providence Health & Services hospital blood banks; coordinate and transfer inventory to meet each location's optimal needs.
Operate equipment, perform quality checks, and conduct periodic maintenance.
Assess returned blood components for acceptability, electronically document return of components to Bloodworks inventory, and rotate components into appropriate inventory based on expiration dates to maximize blood resource utilization.
Evaluate attribute codes to quarantine or discard components electronically.
Store quarantined blood components appropriately, and electronically discard and dispose of unusable blood components.
Respond to and document temperature alarms on blood storage equipment for the Rees Temperature Monitoring System.
Report incidents involving unusual circumstances or failure to follow standard operating procedures.
Take the equipment "out of service" for repair in accordance with appropriate procedures.
Document manual temperature readings for storage equipment as needed.
Perform periodic lab cleaning and manage biohazard waste storage and removal.
Comply with all applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as written.
Perform other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience preferred.
Two years of college education or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
In addition, one year of experience (each) in at least two of the following areas:
One year of experience in the blood banking industry
One year of experience in shipping, receiving, and distribution
One year of experience in receiving telephone orders and providing customer service

Specific job skills include, but are not limited to:

Ability to perform high-level communication with physicians and clinicians in a stressful environment.
Ability to work independently and unsupervised in meeting the required deadlines and workload of internal and external customers.
Ability to perform accurate, expedited computer order entry and produce distribution reports.
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
Lifting, carrying, and pushing requirements:

The Ability to lift and carry a maximum of 60 pounds is required

Frequent lifting and carrying up to 35 pounds

Manual dexterity sufficient to perform frequent data entry is required as a basic function of this position.
The Ability to remain on task amid multiple audio and visual distractions is required, as is the Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Requires the Ability to comprehend the criticality of the blood components being prepared for transfusion, the dollar value of blood components being handled, and the necessity to follow all regulatory rules and regulations (AABB, CFR, EU, CLIA, HIPAA, and State), including the FDA's Good Manufacturing Practices in all work activities.
Required mental activities include continuous use of decision-making, interpersonal skills, teamwork, customer service, and the Ability to read, speak, and comprehend English. Other required mental activities include discretion, negotiation, independent judgment and/or independent action; the Ability to write in English; and the ability to perform basic mathematics and problem analysis.
Other mental activities required include the Ability to follow production and shipping standard operating procedures, ensuring component safety, quality, identity, potency, and purity (SQuIPP) of components while performing a wide variety of repetitive tasks in a moderately noisy, high-volume shipping setting.
Required physical activities include continuous standing, walking, bending, lifting, talking, hearing, reaching, handling, feeling, and repetitive hand/wrist and foot motions. Other required physical activities include stooping (frequently), kneeling (occasionally), and sitting (rarely).

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Heavy lifting and constant standing are common job conditions.

As this is an essential position with direct responsibility to patients, the incumbent should be prepared to work extended and/or consecutive shifts and/or possibly at a different location during periods of inclement weather or emergency operations. Refer to Human Resources policy or department supervisor for more information.

Incumbent must be able to work overtime, weekends, holidays, and on-call shifts as assigned.
Telecommuting is not offered in this role.

This position involves direct exposure to bloodborne pathogens.

SHIFT: Thursday & Friday 1330-2200 (8); Saturday 1000-2030 (10); 26 hours weekly.
Benefits and Perks:
Employees regularly scheduled for 24+ hours per week are covered by medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, with family coverage also available. Employees can also participate in retirement plans (401a & 401b), a consolidated paid leave program (4.8–6.8 weeks of time off accrued per year, based on length of service), a subsidized transit program, and educational reimbursement. Candidates hired from outside of our service area may be eligible for a relocation assistance bonus*
*Conditions apply

title: Controller
description:
CONTROLLER

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP)

Remote | Full-Time | Exempt

Travel: Approximately 20% National Travel
Compensation: $170,000–$200,000 Base Salary DOE + Performance Bonus

ABOUT ALLIED ROOFING PARTNERS

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP) is one of the fastest-growing residential exterior services platforms in the United States. We partner with established roofing and exterior home improvement companies and provide the financial, operational, technology, HR, and strategic resources needed to help them continue to grow.

ARP operates a growing multi-brand, multi-entity, multi-state organization that includes residential roofing, insurance restoration, siding, gutters, and other exterior home services.

Our continued growth is driven by a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions. As new companies join the ARP portfolio, our Corporate Accounting team plays a critical role in integrating those businesses, standardizing financial processes, strengthening controls, and providing leadership with accurate and timely financial information.

We are seeking an experienced Controller who can help lead that effort.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

POSITION SUMMARY

The Controller will oversee core accounting and financial reporting across the Allied Roofing Partners portfolio while playing a significant role in acquisition integration, multi-entity consolidation, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, financial controls, forecasting, and team development.

This is not a Controller position focused on maintaining a single company's accounting function.CFO, Accounting Manager, Senior Accountants, M&A and integration teams, operating company leadership, and executive management.

The successful candidate must be comfortable operating within a growing multi-brand environment, integrating newly acquired businesses, consolidating financial results across multiple entities, and creating consistent accounting standards and processes across the organization.

This individual will work closely with the

The Controller will also provide leadership and development to an accounting organization that includes an Accounting Manager and multiple Senior Accountants supporting ARP's operating brands.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in ALL or the majority of the following areas:

Acquisition Integration

  • Direct experience integrating newly acquired companies into an existing accounting and financial reporting structure
  • Experience assessing acquired-company accounting processes and identifying gaps
  • Ability to implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting expectations following an acquisition
  • Experience working with local accounting teams during post-acquisition integration

Multi-Entity Accounting & Consolidations

  • Experience managing accounting across multiple companies, brands, subsidiaries, or operating entities
  • Hands-on experience preparing and/or reviewing consolidated financial statements
  • Experience standardizing financial reporting across multiple entities
  • Ability to manage multiple close processes and reporting deadlines simultaneously

Percentage-of-Completion Accounting & Job Costing

  • Strong understanding and practical experience with percentage-of-completion accounting
  • Hands-on experience with job costing and WIP reporting
  • Ability to review job-level profitability, estimated costs, margins, and revenue recognition
  • Experience identifying job-costing discrepancies and working with Operations to resolve them

QuickBooks

  • Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online
  • Ability to work across multiple QuickBooks entities
  • Experience improving accounting processes and reporting within QuickBooks environments

Month-End Close & GAAP

  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience owning and leading the monthly and year-end close process
  • Strong balance sheet reconciliation and general ledger experience
  • Ability to establish close calendars, deadlines, review processes, and accountability across an accounting team
  • Experience preparing and reviewing accurate monthly financial statements

External Audit Leadership

  • Experience leading an external financial statement audit
  • Ability to coordinate audit requests, supporting schedules, documentation, and communication with external auditors
  • Experience ensuring accounting records and supporting documentation are audit-ready

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Experience developing and managing annual budgets and financial forecasts
  • Ability to analyze actual results against budget and forecast
  • Experience identifying financial trends and communicating meaningful variances to leadership
  • Strong understanding of cash forecasting and financial planning

Team Leadership & Development

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing accounting professionals
  • Ability to review the work of Senior Accountants and other accounting team members
  • Experience providing coaching, feedback, training, and accountability
  • Ability to build stronger accounting capabilities as the organization grows

Internal Controls

  • Experience developing, implementing, and improving internal controls
  • Ability to identify control weaknesses and implement appropriate solutions
  • Experience developing accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs
  • Strong understanding of financial risk and segregation of duties

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee general ledger and accounting operations across multiple ARP brands and entities
  • Lead accurate and timely monthly and year-end close processes
  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements and consolidated management reporting
  • Ensure accounting practices comply with GAAP and established ARP accounting policies
  • Review balance sheet reconciliations and ensure appropriate resolution of outstanding items
  • Oversee AP, AR, cash management, and other core accounting functions
  • Monitor cash balances and support short- and long-term cash forecasting
  • Oversee commission accounting and processing
  • Prepare monthly Financial Reporting Packages and support Monthly Operating Reviews
  • Improve reporting processes and identify opportunities for automation

Multi-Entity Consolidation

  • Oversee financial reporting across ARP's growing portfolio of operating companies
  • Review individual entity financial results and consolidated reporting
  • Ensure consistent accounting methodology across operating companies
  • Identify and resolve intercompany and consolidation issues
  • Establish scalable reporting processes as additional companies join ARP

Percentage-of-Completion & Job Costing

  • Provide oversight of percentage-of-completion accounting across applicable ARP brands
  • Review job costing, WIP schedules, percent-complete calculations, and revenue recognition
  • Analyze job margins and identify significant variances or unusual trends
  • Partner with Operations and accounting teams to improve job-cost accuracy
  • Help standardize job-costing and POC processes across the organization

M&A & Acquisition Integration

  • Partner with the CFO and M&A/integration teams during acquisitions
  • Assist with financial due diligence and pre-close accounting assessments
  • Help transition newly acquired companies into ARP's financial reporting structure
  • Implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, SOPs, and internal controls
  • Support migration and standardization within QuickBooks Online and other financial systems
  • Establish appropriate close processes and reporting expectations for newly acquired companies
  • Work directly with local accounting teams during the integration process
  • Provide training and ongoing support following acquisition

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead and support annual budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts
  • Review KPIs, margins, job costing, backlog, cash flow, and operating performance
  • Identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Translate financial results into actionable information for operating and executive leadership
  • Support financial dashboards and management reporting

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal controls
  • Establish standardized accounting policies and procedures across ARP brands
  • Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement solutions
  • Improve financial reporting accuracy and efficiency
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes

title: Customer Growth Coordinator
description:

Compensation: $50,000 - $65,000

Launch Your Career by Helping Customers and Businesses Grow

The Cary Company is seeking a curious, analytical, and driven individual to join our team as a Customer Growth Coordinator.

This unique opportunity blends marketing, analytics, ecommerce, AI, customer experience, and business strategy. We're looking for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, solving problems, developing new ideas, and using data to drive meaningful business results.

Rather than managing a sales territory, you'll help identify growth opportunities across thousands of customers, hundreds of product categories, and multiple sales channels. You'll analyze customer behavior, ecommerce activity, marketing initiatives, and business data to uncover opportunities that increase customer engagement, revenue, and long-term customer value.

Successful candidates will begin with a structured 5-6 month Customer Experience Trainee Program designed to provide exposure to key areas of the business before transitioning into the Customer Growth Coordinator role.

You'll work closely with leaders from Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce, Customer Experience, and Analytics to identify trends, develop growth initiatives, test new ideas, and turn insights into action. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity, technology, customer insights, and data to help drive business growth.

5-6 Month Customer Experience Trainee Program

During your first 5-6 months, you'll gain hands-on exposure to multiple areas of the business, including:

  • Customer Relations
  • Sales
  • Ecommerce
  • Marketing
  • Product Management
  • Data & Analytics
  • AI & Automation Initiatives

This foundational experience will help you develop a strong understanding of our customers, products, systems, and growth strategies before transitioning into the Customer Growth Coordinator role.

Position Summary

The Customer Growth Coordinator is responsible for identifying and driving growth opportunities across Cary's existing customer base, online customers, house accounts, and dormant accounts.

The role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce, Customer Service, and leadership to uncover opportunities that increase customer value, improve engagement, and generate additional revenue.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting data, customer insights, marketing initiatives, ecommerce activity, and sales strategies to help customers discover more of what Cary has to offer.

What a Typical Week Might Look Like

  • Review customer, ecommerce, and sales reports to identify growth opportunities.
  • Analyze customers purchasing one product category but not others and identify cross-sell opportunities.
  • Identify online customers with strong growth potential who are not actively managed by a salesperson.
  • Meet with Sales Managers, Territory Representatives, Marketing, and Ecommerce teams to discuss growth opportunities and priorities.
  • Build and track customer win-back and retention campaigns.
  • Identify dormant customers that may be worth re-engaging.
  • Use CRM, reporting tools, customer data, and AI solutions to uncover trends and opportunities.
  • Develop recommendations to help customers discover more of Cary's products and services.
  • Present findings, ideas, and growth opportunities to leadership.
  • Monitor the performance of growth initiatives and refine strategies based on results.

Key Areas of Focus

Customer Growth

  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
  • Increase customer lifetime value.
  • Analyze buying patterns and uncover growth opportunities.
  • Support new product and new SKU adoption initiatives.

Online Customer Growth

  • Analyze ecommerce customer behavior and purchasing trends.
  • Identify online customers with high growth potential.
  • Develop campaigns that increase engagement and purchases.
  • Partner with Marketing and Ecommerce to improve conversion and retention.

Customer Recovery & Retention

  • Identify dormant and declining accounts.
  • Coordinate customer win-back campaigns.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve retention.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales Managers and Territory Representatives to surface opportunities.
  • Help create targeted growth campaigns.
  • Track and measure results.
  • Support growth initiatives across multiple departments.

Analytics & Opportunity Identification

  • Utilize CRM, reporting tools, and AI solutions to identify opportunities.
  • Build dashboards and reports that highlight potential growth areas.
  • Present recommendations and findings to leadership.
  • Continuously evaluate customer trends and purchasing behavior.

What We're Looking For

Preferred Background

  • Recent college graduate or early-career professional
  • Degree in Business, Information Systems, Marketing, Communications, Analytics, Economics, Finance, Ecommerce, or a related field

Skills & Traits

  • Curious and eager to learn
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable working with data and technology
  • Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills
  • Positive attitude and growth mindset
  • Interest in AI, ecommerce, marketing, customer experience, and business growth

Why Join Cary?

  • Exposure to Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce, Customer Service, Data Analytics, and AI initiatives.
  • Direct interaction with company leadership.
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact growth projects.
  • Structured training and development.
  • Opportunity to help shape a new customer growth function.
  • Significant career growth potential.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where ideas matter.

Potential Career Opportunities

As the role and individual develop, opportunities may include progression into areas such as:

  • Customer Growth
  • Marketing Leadership
  • Ecommerce Leadership
  • Commercial Analytics
  • Revenue Operations
  • Sales Enablement

This role is designed to provide broad exposure across multiple business functions, allowing high-performing individuals to help shape their own career path while making a meaningful impact on the company's growth.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Analytics Engineer Hybrid (USA Remote)
description:
The purpose of this role is to bridge the gap between complex data infrastructure and actionable business strategy. You will provide day-to-day support to Revenue Operations (RevOps), including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience leaders.

We are currently in an exciting transition, migrating our data workflows from Alteryx to dbt. As a BI Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of data engineering and business analysis. You aren't just a "dashboard builder"; you are an Analytics Engineer who builds robust data models in Redshift, orchestrates workflows via Dagster/Airflow, and works directly with stakeholders to translate technical outputs into business impact.

Crucially, you will help us move beyond standard reporting. We are looking for someone genuinely excited about the frontier of AI and LLM capabilities, helping us integrate predictive analytics and machine learning (via Amazon SageMaker) into the RevOps ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities and Outputs

  • Data Modeling & Migration: Lead the migration of legacy workflows from Alteryx to dbt, ensuring high-quality, documented, and tested data models that serve as a single source of truth.
  • Orchestration & Pipelines: Manage and monitor data pipelines using Dagster or Airflow to ensure reliability and performance within our Redshift warehouse.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Translation: Act as the primary liaison between technical data structures and non-technical leaders. You will translate complex "data speak" into clear insights that highlight ROI and business impact.
  • AI & Advanced Analytics: Actively explore and implement AI/LLM capabilities to enhance data discovery and predictive modeling. Collaborate with Product/Engineering to apply Machine Learning (SageMaker) to areas like churn prediction and lead scoring.
  • RevOps Strategy: Support high-impact initiatives such as Account Based Marketing (ABM) and Customer Health scoring by providing visibility into globally symbols KPIs via Tableau.

Proven Characteristics for Success

  • The "Technical Translator": You can explain a join or a latent variable to a Sales Director in a way that makes sense for their quota.
  • Impact-Focused: You don't just deliver data; you deliver the "so what?"
  • AI Enthusiast: You stay up to date with the latest in LLMs and are constantly thinking about how to apply generative AI to analytics workflows.
  • Curiosity & Ownership: You lead with questions and take pride in the "cleanliness" and architecture of your code.

Essential

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related data role.
  • dbt Expertise: Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade data models using dbt.
  • Orchestration Tools: Hands-on experience with Dagster or Airflow.
  • SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills and experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake/BigQuery).
  • BI Visualization: Experience building stakeholder-facing dashboards in Tableau.
  • CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce data structures.

Preferred

  • Alteryx: Experience with Alteryx (highly beneficial for supporting our migration to dbt).
  • AI/ML: Experience with Python and a strong interest (or portfolio) in LLM applications and Machine Learning (Amazon SageMaker).
  • Advanced Tableau: Building advanced dashboards and experience with Tableau Online/Server.
  • Data Modeling: Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
  • Big Data: Experience dealing with large (+1M rows) customer engagement datasets.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $84,225/year to $140,375/year. This position is bonus eligible / commission-based.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills—you make IT support feel like a first-class positive experience.

Preferred Skills and Experience

title: Product Innovation Lead
description:
A fantastic opportunity has become available for a Product Innovation Lead to join Caristo Diagnostics rapidly growing team, based at our Oxford headquarters.


About the Role

Overview

Caristo develops AI-powered cardiovascular imaging technologies that translate scientific breakthroughs into clinically impactful products. We are looking for a Product Innovation Lead to help define, prototype and de-risk future product opportunities before they are incorporated into regulated medical devices.

Operating from the Research & Innovation Team, the successful candidate will operate across Research, Engineering, Operations, Clinical, Regulatory, and external collaborators to help determine what should be built, why it matters and how it reaches patients.

Success in this role means reducing uncertainty, aligning stakeholders and helping the organisation make good decisions about what to build next.


What You Will Be Doing

Product Innovation

  • Lead development of future product roadmaps and product definitions
  • Identify and prioritise features required for clinical, commercial and regulatory success
  • Work closely with Engineering to translate prototypes into regulated product releases
  • Help shape long-term product strategy


Prototype Development

  • Develop and maintain prototype implementations of future product capabilities
  • Rapidly evaluate new technical approaches
  • Document methods, validation approaches and product definitions
  • Establish technical requirements for future releases


Regulatory and Evidence Generation

  • Support validation strategies and evidence-generation plans
  • Help define effective FDA 510(k) and other regulatory pathways
  • Conduct regulatory dry-runs to identify risks early
  • Generate technical documentation supporting product claims


Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work across Research, Engineering, Operations and Clinical teams
  • Partner with users to test prototypes in real-world workflows
  • Build alignment around priorities and strategic decisions



External Collaboration

  • Support relationships with collaborators and strategic partners
  • Represent technical programmes in selected discussions
  • Support publications, abstracts and evidence-generation activities



What Success Looks Like

  • Establish a clear MVP definition for a future product opportunity
  • Help define and de-risk the regulatory pathway
  • Deliver validated prototype capabilities ready for product implementation
  • Create a roadmap for future product evolution
  • Build effective cross-functional relationships
  • Help ensure external collaborations translate into product opportunities


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building clarity from incomplete information, naturally works across teams and disciplines, balances near-term delivery with long-term product thinking, shares work early, iterates rapidly and takes ownership without requiring formal authority.


We value judgement, pragmatism and collaboration over academic perfection. We are looking for someone who can make good decisions in the presence of uncertainty, build alignment across teams and keep complex programmes moving forward.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Background in AI, medical imaging, computer vision or quantitative healthcare technology
  • Experience developing or evaluating machine learning technologies
  • Strong scientific and technical reasoning ability
  • Experience translating research into practical solutions
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Python experience
  • Experience rapidly prototyping technical concepts
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience in CT imaging or medical image analysis
  • Experience working within a regulated healthcare environment
  • Experience supporting FDA or MDR submissions
  • Product Management or Product Innovation experience
  • Experience working with clinicians or clinical operations teams
  • Experience supporting publications, patents or conference presentations
  • Understanding of validation methodologies and clinical evidence generation
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling and foundation models

About Caristo Diagnostics

With the first and only FDA approved (July 29, 2026) coronary artery inflammation diagnostic medical device, CaRi-Heart®, Caristo Diagnostics is a global leader in AI technologies for cardiovascular disease, founded as a spin-out from the University of Oxford in 2018. Caristo also has an FDA approved (2025) coronary artery plaque diagnostic medical device. Its award-winning inflammation technology helps detect hidden heart disease and identify people at risk of a heart attack before symptoms appear allowing for proactive disease management. Working with leading hospitals, research institutions, and pharmaceutical partners, Caristo aims to save lives through early detection and personalized prevention. The company was named a 2026 Technology Pioneer by the World Economic Forum in June 2026. Learn more at www.caristo.com or follow Caristo on LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.


About the CaRi-Heart® Technology

Named first of “7 Technologies That Could Change Heart Healthcare Forevermore” by the Robb Report, the CaRi-Heart® technology is Caristo’s flagship offering which uncovers hidden coronary inflammation, a key driver of cardiovascular disease, on routine Coronary Computed Tomography Angiography (CCTA).


The technology is regulatory approved for clinical use in US, UK, Europe, and Australia and is in use with a growing number of hospitals and clinics. Multiple patents underpinning CaRi-Heart technologies have been granted in major jurisdictions around the world. In addition, exceptional validation results showing CaRi-Heart’s ability to aid the prediction of heart attacks have been published in leading medical journals including the Lancet, JACC, European Heart Journal, and Cardiovascular Research.

Job Title Product Innovation Lead

Department Head of Research and Innovation

Location Oxford, UK (full time in-office)

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary (for Oxford location)
  • 25 holidays per year plus bank holidays
  • Enhanced pension contribution
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Cycle-to-work scheme
  • Additional benefits for long-service


Why join Caristo:

  • Be part of a company at the cutting edge of medical technology, with the potential to save lives and revolutionise healthcare
  • Join a dynamic and growing team, with opportunities for personal and professional growth
  • Contribute to the development of groundbreaking products in a company poised for significant expansion
  • Enjoy a supportive and collaborative work environment, with a strong emphasis on innovation, quality, and impact

Caristo Diagnostics is committed to diversity and inclusion, and encourages applications from all qualified candidates, including those making a step up in their career. If you are passionate about making a difference in the world of medical imaging and meet the above criteria, we would love to hear from you.

Applicants should request Caristo’s Candidate Privacy Notice for information as to how we will handle your personal data.

Job Title: Senior Data Engineer
Function: Products & Platforms
Hybrid Worker – Expectation is two days per week on site at our Nottingham office
Contract type: permanent
Salary: Offered on a starting salary of £56,476 with the potential to increase to £66,443 over the course of three years.
Closing Date: Tuesday, 27th October 2026

NHS Supply Chain currently has an opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team during an exciting period of transformation, working to make it easier for the NHS to put patients first.

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape and deliver high-quality data solutions that enable better insight and decision-making across our organisation. You’ll combine strong hands-on engineering experience with technical leadership, taking ownership of complex solutions and helping define how we design, build and manage our data products. Working across Data & Analytics, you’ll set engineering standards, influence technical direction and support other engineers to deliver scalable, secure and trusted solutions.

Every day you will …

Lead the design and delivery of complex data pipelines, models and analytics-ready data products.
Develop scalable solutions using SQL, Python and modern cloud data technologies.
Provide technical leadership and make key design decisions across data solutions.
Define and champion engineering standards, reusable patterns and best practice.
Ensure data quality, security, governance, resilience and performance are built into solutions.
Work with stakeholders to turn complex business needs into effective technical solutions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and reuse data capabilities across the organisation.
Drive effective engineering practices including automated testing, release and monitoring.
Solve complex data and technical challenges, providing guidance and assurance to others.
Mentor and coach engineers, helping build capability across the wider team.
Help shape the future direction and roadmap of our data platform.

What can we offer you?
We want to reward you for your passion, enthusiasm, and hard work so we offer much more than a competitive salary:

Hybrid working opportunities, giving you the flexibility to work collaboratively in the office and remotely.

We recognise our employees' hard work and contributions with annual bonus schemes, long service, and colleague recognition awards.

27 days holiday plus bank holidays

We are dedicated to your development, through in-house training, support, and access to external qualifications to maximise your potential.

A focus on your well-being offering 1 day of paid well-being leave and free access to the 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

Generous pension scheme (with us contributing 12% when you contribute 6%)

Access to our Flexible Benefits Scheme, where you can choose from a variety of benefits such as Life Insurance, Critical Illness Cover, Income Protection, Health Cash Plan, Dental Insurance, and additional pension contributions that suit you.

2 days of paid volunteering leave allowing you to give back to your community.

Access to many discounts from the Blue Light Card to NHS Discounts.

NHS Supply Chain, who are we?
Our role is to support the NHS to save lives and improve health. We are a part of the NHS family, and our role is to source, deliver and supply healthcare products, services and food for NHS trusts and healthcare organisations across England and Wales.

We serve every NHS Trust and operate a national network of distribution centres, managing relationships with more than a thousand suppliers and delivering more than 8,000,000 orders each year to more than 17,000 locations. Doing all of this on behalf of the NHS gives NHS staff more time to focus on their main priority of providing excellent patient care.

What skills will help you thrive in this role?

Significant experience designing and delivering end-to-end data engineering solutions.
Advanced SQL and Python skills as well as Databricks
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, ETL/ELT and data modelling.
Experience designing scalable, resilient and maintainable data solutions.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance and security.
Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices.
The ability to provide technical leadership and influence design and architectural decisions.
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices.

Our Inclusive Commitment
At NHS Supply Chain, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where difference is not only valued, but celebrated, giving everyone the opportunity to thrive in their career. Developing our people is key to our success, so if this role sounds like the right next step in your career but your experience doesn’t match perfectly with the job advert, we encourage you to still apply.

Struggling to complete our application form, and require additional support? Reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at careers@supplychain.nhs.uk who will be happy to help you with alternative ways to apply.

title: Construction Coordinator
description:
Construction Coordinator

Reports To: Construction Manager (CM)
Project Types: Mobile Home Replacement, Residential Reconstruction, and Rehabilitation
Program: Residential Disaster Recovery / Housing Assistance


Position Summary

The Construction Coordinator provides administrative, operational, and project coordination support to Construction overseeing mobile home replacement, residential reconstruction, and rehabilitation projects.

This position is responsible for assisting with construction readiness, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, inspections, utility connections, applicant communications, and project documentation. The Construction Coordinator works closely with Construction Managers, subcontractors, applicants, utility providers, local jurisdictions, and program representatives to facilitate timely project execution while maintaining compliance with program requirements.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast paced construction environment.


Key Responsibilities

Construction Readiness & Pipeline Management

  • Perform quality control (QC) reviews of the construction pipeline to verify project readiness prior construction starts.
  • Assist Construction Managers with identifying outstanding requirements, documentation, and action items that may impact construction readiness.
  • Assist with creating and coordinating 811 utility locate tickets before construction activities begin.
  • Monitor outstanding preconstruction requirements and follow up with responsible parties to minimize delays.

Construction Scheduling & Coordination

  • Assist Construction Managers with developing, maintaining, and updating construction schedules for assigned projects.
  • Coordinate scheduling for construction related activities, including septic systems, wells, archaeological monitoring, and other site-specific requirements.
  • Communicate schedule updates and coordinate with subcontractors, applicants, and other stakeholders as directed by the Construction Manager.
  • Track upcoming construction milestones and follow up on outstanding activities to support project progress.

Subcontractor Coordination & Cost Management

  • Assist Construction Managers with requesting and obtaining subcontractor quotes for construction related activities.
  • Support the subcontractor onboarding process by coordinating required documentation and following up on outstanding requirements.
  • Maintain organized records of subcontractor quotes, approvals, and related project documentation.

Applicant Communication & Project Updates

  • Assist Construction Managers with applicant communications throughout the construction process.
  • Provide applicants with project status updates at least once per week, or more frequently when necessary.
  • Coordinate applicant availability for program inspections, utility related activities, and other construction requirements.
  • Document applicant interactions, concerns, and relevant communications in the appropriate project management systems.
  • Escalate applicant concerns or issues requiring management intervention to the Construction Manager.

Project Documentation & Reporting

  • Ensure project records accurately reflect construction progress, scheduling changes, outstanding requirements, and completed activities.
  • Maintain timely and accurate documentation to support program reporting, compliance, and project tracking.
  • Follow up on missing information and outstanding documentation required for project progression.

Inspections & Regulatory Coordination

  • Assist Construction Managers with requesting and scheduling inspections with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and municipal agencies.
  • Coordinate required program inspections with applicable representatives and inspection teams.
  • Track inspection requests, scheduled dates, results, and outstanding corrective actions.
  • Follow up on inspection related requirements to help prevent construction delays.

Utility Coordination

  • Coordinate electrical pole drops and related utility activities as required for assigned projects.
  • Assist with coordinating electrical service reconnections with utility companies, AHJs, and applicants.
  • Track utility related requirements and follow up with responsible parties to facilitate timely service connections.
  • Communicate utility scheduling updates and potential delays to the Construction Manager.

Change Orders & Project Delays

  • Assist Construction Managers with preparing and documenting change order requests for additional work outside the original approved scope.
  • Gather supporting information, subcontractor quotes, photographs, and documentation required for change order submissions.
  • Assist with documenting project delays, including the causes, impacts, and supporting information necessary for time extension requests.
  • Track outstanding change orders and extension requests and follow up on their status as directed by the Construction Manager.

Flood Insurance & Program Compliance

  • Assist Construction Managers with coordinating flood insurance requirements for properties located within designated flood zones, as required by the program for PFI.
  • Follow up with applicants and relevant stakeholders regarding required flood insurance documentation.
  • Maintain records of insurance related requirements and documentation in applicable project management systems.
  • Support compliance with program procedures, documentation standards, and applicable construction requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or coursework in construction management, business administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in construction administration, project coordination, scheduling, or a related role preferred.
  • Familiarity with residential construction, manufactured housing, reconstruction, or rehabilitation projects preferred.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors, inspections, permits, and utility services is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • Ability to learn and navigate project management systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with Construction Managers and project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federally or state-funded disaster recovery or housing rehabilitation programs.
  • Familiarity with construction permitting, AHJ inspections, utility coordination, and 811 locate procedures.
  • Experience maintaining construction schedules, subcontractor documentation, and project tracking systems.
  • Knowledge of change order documentation, construction delays, and project compliance requirements.
  • Experience communicating with homeowners, applicants, subcontractors, and government agencies.

Employment with Timberline Construction Group is contingent upon passing a pre-employment drug test and a background check, which may include criminal history and employment verification.


By submitting your application, you consent to agreeing to partake in a pre-employment drug test and a background check. Refusal to consent to testing may result in withdrawal of the offer. All candidates will be required to undergo a pre-employment drug test as a condition of employment.

title: Website File Download Assistant
description:
Website File Download Assistant

Office Administration | Website Support | Remote | Full-time or part-time
£27.00–£29.00 per hour

Make the approved file easy to reach

Some website pages exist mainly to help people obtain a form, guide or other approved document. The Website File Download Assistant checks that the right file is linked from the right page and that visitors can open it. When a team supplies a replacement document, you would help update the link through the employer’s online content process and check the public result. This remote office administration role deals with document access, not design or software development.

The important question is which version has been approved. A new-looking file is not automatically the one to publish, and an older document should not be removed without a clear instruction. You would compare the file name, date or version supplied by the responsible team with the one currently linked. If the instruction is incomplete, you would ask which document should be live. The work protects visitors from reaching a dead link or an outdated file while keeping a record of what was changed.

From file to page

An ordinary task may begin with an email naming a page and attaching a replacement PDF. You would confirm the page, check that the supplied document opens, and make a permitted upload or hand it to the colleague who publishes content. You would then test the download link as a visitor would. A successful save in the editor is not the final check; the link on the displayed page must lead to the intended file. If there are two links to the old document, note both rather than fixing one and declaring the task finished.

Not every issue needs a new file. A link may point to a moved document, or its text may promise one guide while the linked file is another. You would record the mismatch with enough detail for a content owner to decide the correction. If a document contains personal information or appears to be an internal draft, do not make it public. Seek guidance through the company’s approved process. A clear status note helps others distinguish a broken link that has been repaired from a publication waiting for approval.

A visitor may report that a download does not open on their device. You would first check whether the public link works in the ordinary browser view and whether the file itself opens. You would note what you observed, rather than claiming every visitor will have the same result. If the problem seems related to the visitor’s software or to the website’s technical delivery, you would pass the details to the appropriate support colleague. This keeps your role focused on accessible approved files without pretending that a single test proves the cause of every download problem.

You may use a content editor, a shared file library and a task list. Training will cover the particular tools, naming conventions and approval route. You should already be comfortable opening a web page, comparing file names and writing a short explanation of a problem. No coding is necessary. Prior customer service or office administrative experience may help you think about the visitor’s needs, but neither is required. Applicants with little experience can learn the steps if they check their own work.

A reliable result

At the end of an approved task, the correct page should offer the current authorised file, the link should work and the change should be recorded. If publication is controlled by another colleague, your part ends with a complete handoff and a later check when the page is live. You should not describe a page as fixed while it still points to the old version. The role can involve several small pages rather than one long project, so a simple list of completed and pending items is useful.

This work is fully remote and available on a full-time or part-time basis. A suitable home office area helps when checking online files and keeping track of instructions. The pay range is £27.00–£29.00 per hour. The employer will explain which changes can be made directly and which require review.

Applying

If you have maintained digital folders, checked links or helped someone access a document, those are relevant starting points. You do not need a portfolio of websites or a developer background. The role values accurate checking and a clear handoff above technical jargon. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. Your CV can identify the practical tasks you have handled in work, study or volunteering.

title: Analyst-Compliance
description:
Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) and the U.S. Investigations Unit (USIU) are part of the broader Global Risk & Compliance organization, operating within Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC). Together, they provide end-to-end oversight and support of global financial crimes investigations. In partnership with GFCC, GFCSU and USIU develop and implement transaction monitoring rules, reports, and other tools to detect potential criminal activity. They investigate suspicious financial behavior and, when necessary, file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) or refer cases to internal compliance partners for global reporting. These teams also manage risk related to politically exposed persons (PEPs) through sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence processes, as well as improper payments that may signal bribery, corruption, or other illicit conduct. GFCSU and USIU play a vital role in ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. They also support law enforcement by providing critical information to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, credit card fraud, identity theft, and other financial crimes.

Customers who present higher money laundering or terrorist financing risks are subject to periodic enhanced due diligence reviews. The USIU’s High-Risk Enhanced Due Diligence (HR EDD) Team is responsible for conducting annual reviews of high-risk customers who hold U.S. issued products with American Express.

The successful HR EDD analyst will be expected to:

  • Job Responsibilities:
    The successful HR EDD analyst will be expected to:
    • Conduct time-sensitive, meticulous EDD reviews of high-risk customers utilizing a variety of research and investigative tools
    • Produce detailed analysis and summary of customer and transactional activity and, when appropriate, refer suspicious activity to the SAR and/or account termination process
    • Collaborate with our AML compliance partner(s) to ensure proper review and risk assessment of high-risk customers
    • Work effectively with colleagues to meet aggressive deadlines and support management objectives
    • Build strong relationships with strategic partners across the USIU to ensure effective coordination of significant investigations

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Both written and verbal English skillset required
  • Two or more years of experience in AML or EDD investigations

  • Basic understanding of BSA/AML requirements and FFIEC guidelines as they relate to EDD in general

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and internet-based research

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to analyze and clearly summarize complex information

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment

  • Demonstrated people/process leadership skills with the ability to coach and mentor others

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) preferred

  • CAMS certification preferred

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

In this role, you will serve as the subject matter expert across the Veteran Health Administration (VHA) and DoD Military Treatment Facilities (MTF) nationally to deliver AstraZeneca’s Oncology cutting-edge science and commercial capabilities to pharmacy and oncology key decision makers to enable pull through of Federal product access and advance AZ’s presence in the oncology and hematology market.

The DOFA leads a team of Oncology Federal Account Managers that work with identified VAMC and MTF key stakeholders and decision makers including Pharmacy Chiefs, Oncology Pharmacy and overall Oncology HCPs (e.g., pharmacy, medical, quality) to advance AstraZeneca business priorities including but not limited to new product/indication introduction and launch, portfolio and product value proposition communication, formulary product access achievement, engage oncology pathway stakeholders, and contract pull-through. You will work with your external federal network and build deep and strong relationships with key stakeholders throughout the Federal Systems.

The DOFA utilizes all available resources to facilitate engagements with Federal healthcare professionals to deliver product access and build relationships to achieve business objectives over a specific geography.

You will develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of market, demographic, federal payers, and patient populations that impact the account. In addition, you will be expected to pull through on formulary approvals, economic opportunities and gaining an understanding of quality programs, initiatives, and treatment algorithms for the targeted patient populations.

This individual will develop, lead and facilitate AstraZeneca cross-functional customer-facing team, Federal account planning to implement and pull through of VAMC site level strategies for oncology consistent with mutual business objectives; and closely collaborates with cross functional internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective plan implementation.

The DOFA will also communicate insights and provide federal expertise to oncology brand teams for development of VA brand Strategy across Oncology Portfolio brands

This role reports to the VP, OC&A

AI, Automation & Workflow Enablement

Delivery Enablement & Governance

  • Partner with Tech and delivery teams to ensure business requirements, solution design, acceptance criteria, testing, readiness, and adoption needs are clearly defined

  • Improve transparency into portfolio status, dependencies, risks, capacity, tradeoffs, and decision points

  • Lead release and change governance in partnership with platform, product, COE, HR Operations, and technology teams

Adoption, Change & Value Realization

  • Partner with HR Operations, COEs, Communications, Change, and AI Enablement to ensure employees, managers, and HR users are ready to use new capabilities

  • Shift the function from project completion to measurable business outcomes

title: Business Analyst, Corporate Functions
location: Madison, Wisconsin, United States; Pasadena, California, United States; San Diego, California, United States; Verona, Wisconsin, United States
description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

The Position

We are seeking a Business and Data Analyst, Corporate Functions, to join our Enterprise Systems team, with primary accountability for the administration, optimization, and governance of the enterprise platforms that support our Legal and People Services & Culture partners. This role serves as the functional administrator of our Agiloft Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system and as the day-to-day systems partner to People Services & Culture, ensuring these platforms remain scalable, operationally efficient, and compliant with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

Beyond functional administration, this role plays a key part in working closely with Ex. Director of AI and Data Enterprise Management to support data integration across all business partners. Working with Legal, People Services & Culture, and other corporate and business functions, the analyst will identify priority data sources, define data models and reporting needs, and provide trusted, governed datasets and reporting that enable enterprise-wide analytics and business intelligence (BI).

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience administering enterprise business applications (ideally a CLM platform), a strong command of data modeling, BI analytics, AI data tools, and demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric and other data platforms to drive automation and actionable insight delivery.

This is an individual contributor (IC) role reporting into the Enterprise Systems team. The position requires close collaboration with business end-users, internal Information Systems (IS) colleagues, and third-party consulting partners to deliver sustainable, high-impact solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

This role is based onsite 5 days a week from one of Arrowhead's office locations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the functional administrator for the Agiloft Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system, including configuration of contract templates, workflows, approval rules, fields, reports, and integrations in support of Legal operations.
  • Provide day-to-day functional support to Legal and People Services & Culture stakeholders, ensuring timely issue resolution and continuity of critical business operations.
  • Partner with Legal and People Services & Culture business partners to identify, evaluate, and deliver process automation and digital transformation initiatives aligned with enterprise objectives.
  • Play a key role in supporting data lake for business partners and supporting the integration with the enterprise data management platform. Identifying and prioritizing data sources, building ingestion and integration pipelines with IS and data engineering colleagues, and developing data models.
  • Establish and maintain data definitions, data quality checks, and data governance practices (including metadata, lineage, and access controls) so that enterprise data is trusted, secure, and consistently defined across functions.
  • Leverage the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) and Microsoft Fabric or other similar technologies to develop scalable reporting and analytics solutions, and drive continuous process improvement for corporate functions.
  • Administer identity and access governance for supported platforms, including user role management, license assignment, and periodic access reviews in alignment with internal controls.
  • Administer change management activities for supported applications, including requirements gathering, testing, validation, and user communication.
  • Develop and maintain end-user training materials and system documentation to support adoption of Agiloft, People Services & Culture platforms, and enterprise data and reporting tools.
  • Work closely with Enterprise Systems Sr. Manager on the intake, triage, and backlog management processes for Legal and People Services & Culture system and data requests, ensuring prioritization in alignment with business objectives.
  • Actively contribute on project delivery using Agile methodologies, driving stakeholder engagement, sprint execution, and on-time delivery of system and data enhancements.
  • Monitor the evolving landscape of emerging technologies and applied AI capabilities relevant to contract management, people services, and enterprise data, providing recommendations for adoption where appropriate.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise business applications in a functional or system administrator capacity, with a strong preference for Agiloft or another Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform.
  • Experience supporting Legal and/or Human Resources (People Services) business functions and the systems that enable them, such as HRIS, talent, or employee-experience platforms.
  • Experience contributing to the build or expansion of an enterprise data lake or data warehouse, including data modeling, data integration, and BI reporting.
  • Working knowledge of the full Microsoft Power Platform stack, including Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, for analytics and intelligent process automation.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Data Platform technologies, including Microsoft Fabric, and MS SQL Server; proficiency in SQL.
  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, and security practices for sensitive Legal and HR data, including role-based access controls.
  • Understanding of governance frameworks for GxP and SOX computerized systems in highly-regulated life sciences environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, deliver in a fast-paced environment, and operate effectively within cross-functional, collaborative teams.

Wisconsin pay range
$60,000—$68,000 USD
California pay range
$68,000—$75,000 USD

Arrowhead provides competitive salaries and an excellent benefit package.

title: Vice President, Agility Lead
description:
Join a team where you can strengthen agile ways of working, elevate team performance, and help deliver meaningful outcomes at scale. You’ll grow your influence through coaching, collaboration, and measurable impact.

As a Vice President Agility Lead in Agile Delivery, you will champion agile practices across multiple teams to improve focus, flow, and outcomes. You will coach leaders, Product Owners, and delivery teams to strengthen planning, execution, and continuous improvement. You will use data and practical facilitation to remove barriers, increase transparency, and help teams deliver high-quality work with confidence.

Job responsibilities
  • Champion consistent adherence to Scrum principles and practices across teams
  • Lead and coach 4 to 5 Scrum teams across one or two product areas to build a collaborative, high-performing environment
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies to ensure they are inclusive, productive, and time-boxed
  • Identify, remove, and escalate impediments while tracking dependencies to keep delivery moving
  • Coach teams to deliver high-value increments that meet agreed quality standards, including a clear Definition of Done
  • Partner with Product Owners on effective backlog management and stakeholder collaboration techniques
  • Improve delivery transparency through strong Jira hygiene, dashboards, and actionable reporting
  • Monitor agile health metrics and guide teams through continuous improvement experiments
  • Strengthen team effectiveness by reinforcing Scrum practices that align to shared goals and measurable outcomes
  • Influence stakeholders through clear communication, facilitation, and structured decision-making
  • Teach problem-solving techniques and promote continuous learning, using data-driven methods to reduce waste and improve productivity
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Certified Scrum Master (or equivalent agile certification)
  • 5 years of hands-on experience implementing Agile and Scrum practices
  • Experience leading and coaching multiple Scrum teams in a product delivery environment
  • Proficiency in Scrum and Kanban, including experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
  • Advanced Jira expertise, including Jira Query Language (JQL) and dashboard creation
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
  • Analytical, data-driven mindset with demonstrated process improvement capability
  • Demonstrated ability to coach teams in practical problem-solving techniques
  • Commitment to continuous learning, with the ability to build that mindset across teams
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Experience coaching Product Owners and leaders on product discovery, prioritization, and outcome-based planning
  • Experience using agile metrics (for example, cycle time, throughput, predictability) to guide improvement
  • Experience scaling agile practices across multiple teams and shared dependencies
  • Experience supporting teams through change, ambiguity, and shifting priorities
