title: Staff Software Developer (Pre-ID Relo)
description:
Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. Within Workforce Solutions, our Human Capital Management charter builds the products that help small and mid-market businesses hire, pay, and support their people. These are systems customers depend on to run payroll correctly, stay compliant across jurisdictions, and handle the daily work of managing a workforce without friction.


We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across multiple engineering teams in the HCM charter. This is a charter-wide role. You will not be measured by the features you personally ship, but by the quality of the architecture, standards, and technical decisions that hold across teams, and by the leverage you create for the engineers around you. You will identify the highest-consequence technical problems in HCM, build alignment on how to solve them, and drive them to resolution across organizational boundaries.


The work is architecturally demanding. HCM spans a modern React front end and a large surface of cloud-native backend services, sitting on business logic that must be exactly right: calculation and eligibility rules, auditable compliance behavior across jurisdictions, and integration contracts with adjacent systems across the workforce stack. Much of it is mid-modernization. A significant part of this role is deciding what to rebuild, what to strangle, what to leave alone, and in what order, then making those calls stick.


This role carries explicit accountability for our AI engineering direction. On the product side, you will own the architecture for how HCM builds AI-powered and agentic experiences: the shared patterns, the evaluation infrastructure, the guardrails, and the judgment about where non-deterministic systems belong and where they emphatically do not. On the practice side, you are expected to materially raise how the entire charter engineers with AI, moving the org from individual experimentation to a coherent, high-quality, measurable way of working. We are looking for someone who is already operating at the frontier here and can bring an organization with them.

Staff engineers at Intuit lead without authority. You will influence roadmap, unblock teams, mentor senior engineers, and represent HCM technical strategy to senior engineering and product leadership.


Responsibilities

Technical strategy and architecture

  • Own architectural direction for a significant portion of the HCM charter, spanning multiple teams and services
  • Identify the technical problems that most constrain the charter's velocity, reliability, or customer experience, and drive them to resolution
  • Author and shepherd technical strategy documents and architecture decision records that teams actually build against
  • Define integration contracts and service boundaries across HCM and with adjacent Workforce Solutions platforms
  • Lead modernization and re-platforming strategy: sequencing, migration paths, and risk management, while keeping systems running
  • Make and defend consequential tradeoff decisions with incomplete information, and revisit them openly when the data changes

AI architecture and practice

  • Own the architecture for how HCM builds AI-powered and agentic product capabilities, including shared services, context and retrieval patterns, orchestration, and reuse across teams
  • Establish the evaluation and quality infrastructure for non-deterministic systems: offline and online evals, regression suites, guardrails, fallback behavior, cost and latency budgets, and observability
  • Set the boundary conditions for responsible AI use in compliance-sensitive paths, where a wrong answer has legal and financial consequences for a customer
  • Raise the charter's AI engineering practice measurably: establish patterns, build or select internal tooling, run the forums, and move engineers from ad hoc use to a consistent high-quality workflow
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving capability landscape and translate genuinely useful advances into concrete architectural and workflow changes, while filtering out what is not yet real

Leverage and influence

  • Multiply the output of engineers across multiple teams through design review, technical mentorship, and unblocking hard problems
  • Mentor senior and staff-track engineers on technical judgment, scope, and influence
  • Raise the engineering bar across teams: design review quality, test strategy, CI/CD, operational readiness, and code health
  • Build alignment across engineering, product, and design leadership without relying on positional authority
  • Represent HCM technical direction in cross-org architecture reviews and to senior leadership
  • Contribute to hiring, leveling calibration, and technical assessment of senior and staff candidates

Operational and delivery accountability

  • Drive systemic improvement in reliability, latency, security posture, and operational toil across the charter, not just within one team
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex, customer-impacting or cross-team incidents, and drive real root cause resolution
  • Ensure systems meet Intuit standards for security, privacy, data governance, and multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance
  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage: prototypes, reference implementations, foundational components, and the hardest parts of critical paths

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale
  • Demonstrated experience operating at Staff level or equivalent: setting technical direction that spanned multiple teams and was adopted beyond your immediate scope
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems design, service architecture, API design, and data modeling across relational and non-relational stores
  • Strong full stack range: production depth in a modern backend language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Ruby or Node.js, with credible working knowledge of a modern front end framework, ideally React
  • Extensive experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, containerization, orchestration, and CI/CD at scale
  • Substantive production experience building AI systems, such as LLM-backed features, retrieval-augmented architectures, or agentic workflows, including responsibility for their quality, evaluation, and operational behavior
  • Demonstrated fluency working AI-first in your own engineering practice, with evidence of having shifted how a team or org works, not just yourself
  • Track record of leading large technical initiatives to completion through influence rather than authority
  • Excellent technical writing, with a portfolio of design documents or strategy documents that drove real organizational decisions
  • Proven ability to mentor and grow senior engineers

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain experience in HR technology, payroll, workforce management, fintech, or another domain where correctness is auditable and financially material
  • Experience architecting rules engines, calculation or ledger-style systems, or complex configurable workflow platforms
  • Experience leading a significant modernization or re-platforming of a live, revenue-bearing legacy system
  • Experience building shared AI platform capabilities or evaluation infrastructure used by multiple product teams
  • Experience defining technical standards or governance adopted across an engineering organization
  • Experience with front end architecture at scale, including design systems, performance, and accessibility
  • Familiarity with data privacy, security, and employment compliance frameworks relevant to employee data, such as SOC 2, GDPR, PIPEDA, CCPA, and jurisdictional employment reporting requirements
  • Experience influencing across a large matrixed organization and multiple time zones
  • Prior experience in a Staff or Principal role at a mid-to-large-size technology company


What we look for

  • Leverage over output. You measure yourself by what the organization ships, not by what you ship
  • Judgment at consequence. You are trusted with the decisions that are expensive to reverse, and you know which ones those are
  • Influence without authority. You bring people to a decision through clarity and credibility rather than escalation
  • Frontier curiosity with engineering rigor. You adopt new capability early and still insist on evidence before it reaches customers
  • Clarity at scale. Your writing changes what an organization does

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
Toronto $164,500 - $222,500

title: Crew Scheduler
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

The Part-time Crew Scheduler serves as one of the primary points of contact for crew scheduling and operational coordination supporting AAR operations. This role is responsible for overseeing crew deployment strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and making real-time operational decisions to support mission execution.

The Crew Scheduler exercises independent judgment in aligning crew resources with mission requirements, balancing regulatory compliance, safety, and operational priorities. In advance of mission planning, this role evaluates crew qualifications, readiness, and availability to ensure operational integrity.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and oversee development of flight crew schedules in alignment with FAA regulations, operational priorities, and company policies
  • Evaluate crew availability, qualifications, and readiness to determine appropriate mission assignments
  • Exercise independent judgment in resolving complex scheduling conflicts, irregular operations, and resource constraints
  • Serve as a central point of coordination for flight operations, partnering with pilots, AROs, and cross-functional teams
  • Ensure compliance with FAA regulations, safety standards, and company procedures through proactive monitoring and decision-making
  • Analyze crew utilization, duty/rest compliance, and operational demands to optimize scheduling outcomes
  • Anticipate and mitigate operational risks by adjusting crew plans based on changing mission requirements and constraints
  • Maintain accountability for accurate scheduling data, reporting, and operational tracking
  • Oversee staffing of all missions, ensuring alignment with operational readiness and safety requirements
  • Direct scheduling and coordination of training missions to sustain crew and Aircrew qualifications
  • Provide oversight of Aircrew certification status and manage evaluation processes to ensure compliance
  • Review and enhance training materials and procedures related to Aircrew and scheduling functions
  • Provide operational support across pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight activities as needed to maintain mission continuity
  • Apply working knowledge of weight and balance, air refueling operations, and flight procedures to support operational decisions
  • Maintain situational awareness and apply Crew Resource Management (CRM) principles across all phases of operations
  • Ensure adherence to Flight Operations Procedures (FOPs), Ground Operations Procedures (GOPs), and safety requirements

title: Document Controller til større anlægsprojekter
description:

**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau fastsat i henhold til gældende overenskomst for den annoncerede lokation. title: Software Engineer II - Enterprise Architecture
description:
Software Engineer, One Data Platform

American Express is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer to join the One Data platform team within Enterprise Architecture. This role is a key part of the organization’s technology strategy and supports the design, development, and delivery of scalable platform capabilities that enable engineering teams across the enterprise to build and deploy microservices at scale.

Enterprise Architecture plays a critical role in shaping the company’s technology direction through four core pillars: Architecture as Code, Architecture as Design, Governance, and Colleague Enablement. The One Data platform team is focused on building foundational technologies that empower teams across American Express to deliver modern, resilient, and high-performing software solutions.

  • Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions across the full stack using Java and Python for enterprise-grade platform services and applications.
  • Lead the implementation of distributed systems with a strong emphasis on performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of features, from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Act as a technical contributor in an Agile environment, guiding best practices in software engineering, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems with strong service contracts and backward compatibility.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, automate testing, and enhance developer productivity through modern engineering practices.
  • Identify bottlenecks, debug complex production issues, and perform root-cause analysis to drive long-term fixes.
  • Develop systems with a focus on scalability, resilience, observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Contribute to cloud-native transformation initiatives, including containerization, infrastructure as code, and auto-scaling architectures.
  • Take accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data-driven applications.
  • Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent technologies.
  • Proven experience in full-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and service-to-service integrations.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS.
  • Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and cloud-native development patterns.
  • Hands-on experience in test data generation, unit testing, and test execution.
  • Experience with API design standards, Open API/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Strong Linux and Unix shell proficiency, including shell scripting and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with NGINX, HAProxy, Envoy, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Strong source control skills using Git.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Good understanding of JVM internals and the ability to diagnose issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, JFR, VisualVM, or similar tools.
  • A proactive and collaborative mindset with a strong desire to document technical knowledge and improve team productivity.

Core Competencies

  • Systems thinking and the ability to reason about edge cases, failure modes, and operational behavior.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including asynchronous communication and cross-functional coordination.
  • Enthusiastic, ownership-driven approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to deliver quickly, iterate rapidly, and adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic environment.

    Depending on factors such as as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, American Express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions.

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in GUBI’s Tech & AI team, you will embed in one department at a time to solve valuable business problems. You will write production code, connect AI to live business data, and refine systems with the people using them. Based in our beautiful Copenhagen office and showroom, you will have a company-wide mandate, established AI foundations, direct access to leadership, and short decision cycles.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • You are curious and proactive.

  • You take ownership beyond deployment, refining systems until they are adopted and make a difference.

We value energy, curiosity, and the ability to turn ideas into working systems. What you have made and the difference it made, matter more to us than the number of years on your CV.

title: Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist
description:
The Department of Health Information Management at SUNY Downstate Health Sciences University is seeking a full-time TH Utilization Review & Quality Assurance Senior Coordinator / Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist.

Job Summary

Reporting to the CDI Manager and Director of Health Information Management, the CDI Specialist is responsible for reviewing inpatient medical records to ensure that clinical documentation accurately and comprehensively reflects the patient's clinical condition, severity of illness, risk of mortality, and services provided throughout hospitalization.

Working collaboratively with physicians, residents, advanced practice providers, nursing staff, coding professionals, and other interdisciplinary healthcare teams, the CDI Specialist identifies opportunities for documentation clarification and improvement to support accurate clinical coding, appropriate reimbursement, regulatory compliance, and quality reporting.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

  • Conduct concurrent reviews of inpatient medical records upon admission and throughout hospitalization for designated patient and payer populations, including Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  • Evaluate clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, specificity, and consistency with the patient's clinical presentation, treatment, and care.
  • Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for clarification related to diagnoses, comorbidities, complications, severity of illness, and risk of mortality.
  • Communicate with attending physicians, residents, advanced practice providers, and other clinical staff to obtain timely clarification of clinical documentation through appropriate verbal and written queries.
  • Collaborate with Health Information Management coding professionals to ensure that principal diagnoses, secondary diagnoses, and relevant comorbidities are accurately and completely documented.
  • Apply clinical knowledge, critical thinking, and analytical reasoning to assess medical records and identify documentation improvement opportunities.
  • Support accurate clinical coding, quality reporting, and reimbursement through improved documentation practices and an understanding of applicable coding and Medicare reimbursement methodologies.
  • Develop and deliver formal and informal education to physicians, nursing staff, and other clinical providers regarding clinical documentation requirements, best practices, and identified improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with physician leadership and departmental stakeholders to develop tools, educational resources, and processes that support consistent and effective clinical documentation.
  • Conduct timely follow-up with providers regarding outstanding documentation clarification requests and ensure appropriate resolution.
  • Participate in departmental and organizational quality improvement initiatives designed to strengthen documentation accuracy, clinical data integrity, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with physicians, nursing leadership, coding professionals, and interdisciplinary healthcare teams to promote a collaborative documentation improvement environment.
  • Utilize electronic medical records, CDI applications, and Microsoft Office applications to perform documentation reviews, communicate findings, and support departmental activities.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of patient information in accordance with HIPAA, institutional policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain professional competency through continuing education, professional development, and participation in relevant training programs.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, cultural competence, and adherence to SUNY Downstate's institutional mission, values, and standards of conduct.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Reporting to the CDI Manager and Director of Health Information Management. Excellent interpersonal skills. Including verbal and written communication, to develop relationships necessary to influence physician document process. Ability to prioritize and be self directed and capable of independent decision making. Analytic skills necessary to clinically assess medical records. Critical thinking, problem solving and deductive reasoning skills. Ability to organize and present information clearly and concisely. Basic computer skills including Microsoft products Office, Excel and PowerPoint. Working knowledge of Medicare reimbursement and coding structures. The Clinical Documentation Specialist (CDS) is responsible for reviewing medical records to facilitate clinical documentation that accurately reflects the patients' severity of illness and risk of mortality by improving the quality of the physicians' clinical documentation. This involves extensive record review, interaction with physicians, residents, advanced practice nurses, ancillary providers, coding and HIM professionals and nursing staff. Key Competencies include: Foundational Thinking Skills: Reviews inpatient medical records for identified payer populations (Medicare, Medicaid, Blue Cross/Blue Shield, and others as designated) as directed on admission and throughout hospitalization. Strategic Management: In collaboration with physician leadership, designs and implements specific tools to support medical record physician documentation. Human Resources Leadership Skills: Develops and implements plans for both formal and informal education of physician, nursing, and other clinical staff. Relationship Management: Communicates with attending physician and other relevant clinical staff, either verbally or through written methodology. Personal and Professional Accountability: Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps identify problems, offers solutions, and participates in their resolution. Career Planning: Assures personal and professional growth through self-study/attendance/participation in seminars and workshops. Fostering Professional Environment: Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to the Medical Center. Optimizing the Leader within/Reflective Practice Behaviors: Behaves in accordance with Mission, Vision, and Values of the Medical Center. Demonstrates integrity, truthfulness and fairness when working with others. Creates an environment of acceptance and respect in the work place. Cultural Competence: Integrates knowledge of cultural competence and inclusion in all daily practices such as assessment, documentation, communication, etc. Shared Decision Making: Works closely with HIM coding staff to assure documentation of discharge diagnosis (es) and any co-existing co-morbidities are a complete reflection of the patient's clinical status and care. Performance Improvement: Contributes to organizational, departmental and unit based process improvement activities. Technology: Demonstrates and maintains competency and accuracy in use of software applications including capability in Microsoft Office applications. Clinical Practice Knowledge and Skill: Conducts daily follow-up communication with providers regarding existing clarifications to obtain needed documentation specificity.

Required Qualifications

  • Must meet one of the following educational and professional credential requirements:
    • Registered Nurse pathway: Current, active New York State Registered Nurse license, with a minimum of three (3) years of acute care nursing experience; OR
    • Physician education pathway: Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO), Bachelor of Medicine/Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), or equivalent medical degree from a recognized medical institution, including international medical graduates.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of professional experience in Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) or Clinical Documentation Integrity, including inpatient medical record review and clinical documentation clarification.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of clinical documentation standards, medical terminology, disease processes, and inpatient clinical care.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare reimbursement methodologies, clinical coding structures, and the relationship between clinical documentation, coding accuracy, and reimbursement.
  • Strong clinical assessment, analytical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with physicians and interdisciplinary healthcare professionals.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, exercise sound professional judgment, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Or, a satisfactory equivalent combination of experience, education and training.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three (3) or more years of Clinical Documentation Improvement experience in an acute care hospital setting.
  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) certification through the Association of Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialists (ACDIS) or Certified Documentation Integrity Practitioner (CDIP) certification through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA).
  • Experience working in an academic medical center, teaching hospital, or complex inpatient healthcare environment.
  • Familiarity with ICD-10-CM/PCS coding, Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Groups (MS-DRGs), severity of illness (SOI), and risk of mortality (ROM) methodologies.
  • Experience with electronic health records and clinical documentation improvement software.
  • Experience providing physician education, clinical documentation training, or participating in documentation-related performance improvement initiatives.

title: Senior HR Data Analyst - Workforce Planning
description:
The Senior HR Data Analyst leverages workforce and financial data to provide actionable insights to HR leadership and business teams, with a particular focus on headcount and workforce planning. This role is deeply collaborative, partnering with HRBPs, Finance, Business Operations, and business leaders to provide trusted data and analysis across compensation, hiring, attrition, and other workforce cost drivers.

By reconciling complex data, developing workforce forecasts and scenarios, identifying the drivers behind cost and headcount variances, and translating those findings into clear business implications, the Senior HR Data Analyst helps leaders better understand and actively manage workforce investment. Success in this role requires strong analytical, financial, and consultative skills; exceptional attention to detail; and the ability to independently investigate discrepancies, solve ambiguous data issues, and partner across functions to drive issues to resolution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with Finance, HRBPs, Business Operations, and business leaders to translate ambiguous workforce questions into structured analyses that support budget alignment, headcount allocation, and informed workforce decisions.

title: Asset Management, European Leveraged Credit Research Analyst, Vice President, London
description:
Help shape investment decisions in a fast-moving European leveraged credit platform where your research directly influences portfolio outcomes. We’ll support your growth with exposure to senior stakeholders, live deal flow, and opportunities to broaden coverage over time. If you’re motivated by high standards, intellectual curiosity, and teamwork, you’ll find a culture that values both debate and accountability.

Job summary

As a European High Yield Credit Analyst (Vice President) in the European Leveraged Credit team, you will develop differentiated credit views across your sectors and translate them into clear investment recommendations. You will underwrite high yield bonds and leveraged loans through fundamental research, detailed financial modeling, and disciplined downside analysis. You’ll work closely with the Portfolio Manager to size risk appropriately, monitor catalysts, and adjust positioning as facts change. You’ll engage with company management teams and market participants to strengthen access and sharpen insights. You’ll help elevate the team’s research process to drive consistency and speed.

Job responsibilities
  • Own coverage for at least two sectors, including frameworks, key themes, issuer peer sets, and catalyst calendars
  • Underwrite high yield and leveraged loan issuers through business, industry, and management analysis to identify inflection points
  • Build and maintain financial models with base/upside/downside scenarios, including liquidity runway and refinancing risk analysis
  • Analyze capital structures and documentation, including covenants, collateral, call schedules, guarantees, and structural subordination
  • Recommend investment actions (buy/hold/sell) with relative value, catalysts, key risks, and position-sizing considerations for the Portfolio Manager
  • Monitor credits actively across earnings, ratings actions, news, filings, pricing, and technicals, and communicate thesis changes quickly
  • Evaluate event-driven situations, including M&A, refinancings, amend-and-extend transactions, tender/exchange offers, and liability management exercises
  • Partner in portfolio reviews and risk discussions, delivering regular sector and names-in-focus updates
  • Engage with management teams, underwriters, and sell-side research to enhance information flow and access
  • Improve research templates, monitoring tools, and coverage processes to strengthen consistency and decision speed
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Proven buy-side leveraged credit experience covering European high yield bonds and leveraged loans
  • Demonstrated sector ownership, including building coverage frameworks, identifying themes, and maintaining disciplined monitoring cadence
  • Advanced financial modeling skills, including scenario analysis, liquidity forecasting, and refinancing risk assessment
  • Strong credit documentation and capital structure analysis skills (e.g., covenants, collateral, guarantees, priority, and structural subordination)
  • Experience presenting investment views with clear theses, catalysts, risk factors, and relative value conclusions to senior decision-makers
  • Ability to assess downside and recovery in stress and restructuring scenarios using structured analytical approaches
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity into actionable recommendations
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented investment environment, partnering closely with portfolio management and trading
  • High standards of integrity, risk discipline, and attention to detail in research and monitoring workflows
  • Eligibility to work in the United Kingdom
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • CFA charter or equivalent professional qualification
  • Experience across event-driven and stressed/distressed situations, including liability management transactions
  • Coverage experience in additional European high yield-heavy sectors that complements existing team needs
  • Established market network across underwriters, sell-side analysts, and issuer contacts

title: Margin and Collateral Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Management reports into Wealth Management Credit Operations group. The team monitors all JPMorgan Global Wealth Management exposures (loans, OTC derivatives, and brokerage margin loans) secured by financial (equities, fixed income, etc.) and other asset types. They manage intraday transactions and exceptions related to secured credit facilities and pledged collateral. The team is also involved in several development projects, manages various reporting and analytical functions, actively partners with program and technology resources to improve platforms/functionality, and represents the collateral function to various risk and control forums. The functions performed by this team are critical to protecting the bank from potential credit losses.

As a Margin and Collateral Analyst within the Credit Operations group, you will be expected to develop a deep understanding of the Credit business and all collateral functions, applicable regulations and policies to provide oversight and guidance to this group daily. In this role, you will work very closely with Credit Operations leadership, Risk, Capital Advisory, Bankers, Client Service, Centralized Lending, underwriting as well as technology, compliance and legal personnel to manage collateral and secured or unsecured credit exposure, execute client requests, identify and escalate credit issues, and manage risk.

Job Responsibilities

  • Set-up agreement terms regarding collateral in credit systems for ongoing compliance monitoring. If credit systems cannot support the monitoring of the arrangement, set-up the agreement for monitoring offline
  • Monitor collateral daily and identify non-compliant scenarios. Confirm the accuracy and escalate to Credit and Bankers for resolution plan and date determination
  • Manage requests for intraday transactions and approve if collateral position and/or covenant compliance is adequate. Intraday transactions are inclusive of cash and security movement within pledged accounts as well as loan and letter of credit draw downs
  • Manage amendments to original agreement terms, including lending value and covenant requirement changes and ensure they are accurately reflected in credit systems for ongoing compliance monitoring
  • Manage third party pledge scenarios when the client’s exposure secured by assets held internally is external to JP Morgan and when the client’s exposure secured by assets held externally is internal to JPM. Regularly update credit system valuations regarding the external assets
  • Participate in credit system defect identification, User Acceptance testing (UAT), and ongoing business requirement discussions
  • Manage initiatives to resolve control gaps and enhance current processes for further efficiency and effectiveness as needed

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience
  • Strong project management skills – experience managing process reengineering initiatives
  • High-level of proficiency in organizing, prioritizing, and managing issues
  • Strong independent judgment and awareness of appropriate escalation
  • Attention to detail, strong analytic skills
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Strong excel skills

Can a visitor follow the steps as written?

The Help Page Instruction Checker reads assigned online guidance from the point of view of a customer trying to complete a routine task. You would compare the page with an approved process, follow links to see where they lead and note a step that is missing, confusing or out of sequence.

This is a remote support role for someone with good reading habits and a practical sense of what makes instructions usable. It does not involve deciding company policy or rewriting technical guidance without review.

For example, a help article might tell a person to select a button that has since been renamed. Another may link to a general page when a more specific approved form is intended. You would capture the page title, the step involved, what you observed and the source that shows the expected process. A colleague responsible for content can then approve a correction. Where the team allows simple edits, you may update wording in the online editor and preview it before publication.

This work differs from answering a live customer enquiry. The immediate product is a clearer help page that may prevent many people from getting stuck later. You may still receive feedback from customer service colleagues who have noticed the same question recurring. Your job is to turn that feedback into a specific check, not to assume that every complaint proves the page is wrong. If the current process is itself unclear, ask for the authoritative version before changing public instructions.

A review in ordinary terms

Start by reading the whole page once. Identify the action the visitor is meant to complete and then check each step against the supplied reference. Follow links, look at form names and observe where a person could be left without a next step. Make a short note that a content owner can act on. A useful note says, for example, that step three names a button differently from the current form; a vague statement such as ‘page needs work’ does not help. If the article is accurate, record that outcome too.

Activities may include:

  • Reviewing assigned help articles against current approved instructions.
  • Checking whether links and named pages open as described.
  • Finding outdated button labels or references to removed steps.
  • Recording a precise issue with a page location and suggested clarification.
  • Using the online editor for limited, approved changes.
  • Previewing a change to ensure the sequence remains understandable.
  • Passing a technical fault or policy conflict to the responsible team.
  • Tracking whether an issue was reviewed, corrected or still needs approval.

You do not need to be a technical writer. Previous website, office administration or customer service experience may be useful but is not essential. The employer will teach its content system and review boundaries. Someone with little formal experience who can follow instructions carefully and explain a confusing step in plain English can contribute. Basic computer confidence is important; programming and advanced analytics are not part of the job.

The work requires patience with details but also a sense of proportion. You are not being asked to polish every sentence to your personal style. The purpose is to help a visitor finish a real task using current information. When a page needs a larger rewrite, you should explain why and hand it to the content owner rather than making unapproved changes across the website. A home office area suited to concentrated reading supports this online work.

Pay and working arrangement

Remote, full-time or part-time, at £28.00–£30.00 per hour. The hiring team will explain how pages are assigned and who approves a public edit. This is an introductory role with training on the particular site.

Joining the selection process

You can show relevant skills through any experience checking instructions or helping someone find their way through a process. A previous website role is not required. If your CV includes careful writing or use of an online editor, make it easy to find. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. That process allows the company to review your application for the opening.

title: Senior AI Engineer II - Forward Deployment Engineer - Enterprise AI Platforms
description:
Why Join American Express

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Enterprise AI Platform organization partners with business and technology teams to shape the Enterprise AI strategy, bring emerging technologies to the forefront, and build scalable, reusable AI platforms. This team plays a pivotal role in enabling American Express to operate as an AI-powered enterprise by equipping teams with the skills, platforms, and seamless deployment capabilities needed to accelerate responsible AI innovation, enhance decision-making, and drive customer impact with speed and scale.

Join a team shaping the future of AI at American Express. You will work directly with business and product leaders to turn high-value opportunities into trusted, secure, and responsible AI solutions, while helping successful ideas become reusable capabilities across the enterprise.

FDE partners across American Express to transform high-value business opportunities into trusted, secure, and scalable AI solutions delivering measurable outcomes, accelerating adoption, and turning successful innovations into reusable enterprise capabilities.

Role Summary

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will partner closely with business units, product teams, and engineering organizations to identify and reframe high-value opportunities, translate business challenges into clear value propositions, and build working solutions using Generative AI, agentic systems, and intelligent automation.

You will take opportunities from discovery and demonstration through proof of value, production scaling, adoption, and transition to long-term ownership. Demonstrations are a means of validating grounded value propositions, not the end goal. You will be accountable for advancing credible opportunities into real adoption and durable ways of working, with each stage tied to measurable outcomes and balanced with enterprise requirements for security, reliability, and responsible AI.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant stakeholder engagement component. You will influence without direct authority, communicate across levels of seniority and technical familiarity, and work alongside engineers to build and deploy reliable software.

You will challenge assumptions about how work is performed, analyze processes as systems, and identify the technical, operational, and organizational levers that can improve them. You will define a longer-term direction while sequencing practical near-term solutions that build toward it.

Candidates may come from mobile, web, backend, distributed-systems, or workflow-platform backgrounds. What matters most is the ability to understand a system end to end, form a point of view, engage deeply with users, and turn direction into working software.

Opportunity discovery and transformation

  • Build trusted relationships and develop a deep understanding of business priorities, user needs, operational workflows, and sources of friction.
  • Challenge existing assumptions, map processes as systems, and identify the technical, operational, and organizational changes most likely to improve them.
  • Lead discovery sessions that translate business needs into clear use cases, value propositions, measurable success criteria, and solution direction.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user impact, risk, and readiness for adoption.
  • Define a longer-term vision and identify the smallest useful intervention that can validate the opportunity while preserving a path to broader transformation.

Solution design and delivery

  • Design, build, and deploy Generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions using approved enterprise platform capabilities.
  • Develop working demonstrations and proofs of value that test assumptions and measure business impact.
  • Take solutions through prototyping, production scaling, adoption, and transition to long-term ownership.
  • Build agents and AI-enabled workflows that interact with enterprise APIs, knowledge sources, data platforms, applications, code, and business processes.
  • Incorporate appropriate human input, approval, escalation, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Work directly alongside engineering teams to produce software and apply the architecture, testing, deployment, and operational practices required for production use.
  • Use experimentation selectively to reduce uncertainty while balancing speed with security, reliability, maintainability, and governance.

AI-enabled engineering practices

  • Use coding agents and AI-assisted engineering techniques to accelerate discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, and iteration.
  • Apply specification-driven development, context management, iterative planning, and structured knowledge repositories to preserve context and improve personal productivity.
  • Evaluate agent-generated code and technical outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural alignment.
  • Identify where AI-enabled development practices can improve engineering throughput without compromising operational standards.

Platform contribution and scale

  • Generalize patterns and components developed through individual engagements for broader use.
  • Partner with platform and product teams to turn successful prototypes into reusable features, accelerators, reference architectures, and paved-road implementation patterns.
  • Capture lessons from deployments and use them to influence the enterprise AI platform and product roadmap.
  • Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows and transition solutions into sustainable operating models.

Evaluation, governance, and responsible AI

  • Develop evaluation approaches that measure solution quality, task completion, business outcomes, user experience, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Identify and address failure modes through testing, monitoring, safeguards, and iterative improvement.
  • Ensure solutions meet American Express requirements for security, privacy, risk management, responsible AI, and regulatory compliance.
  • Establish appropriate controls for model access, enterprise data, tool use, human oversight, and production operations.

Stakeholder leadership

  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to audiences with different levels of technical familiarity and seniority.
  • Influence decisions and drive alignment across business, product, engineering, risk, and platform teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Maintain strong stakeholder relationships throughout discovery, delivery, adoption, and transition, and mentor partner teams on AI solution delivery.
  • 5 or more years of experience delivering software, technical solutions, or digital products in an engineering, architecture, or technical consulting capacity.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business or user problem through discovery, implementation, and measurable validation.
  • Experience using coding agents in a structured engineering workflow, including specification-driven development, context management, iterative implementation, and reusable knowledge repositories.
  • Software engineering fluency and the ability to contribute directly to applications, integrations, services, or technical prototypes.
  • Experience in at least one relevant domain, such as mobile, web, backend services, APIs, distributed systems, platform engineering, workflow orchestration, or cloud-native development.
  • Ability to reason about systems end to end, identify constraints and leverage points, and connect technical decisions to business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-partnership skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, challenge existing approaches constructively, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to define a longer-term direction and sequence incremental solutions that build toward it.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or deploying solutions powered by language models, agentic systems, or AI-enabled process flows.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, tool calling, model context protocols, knowledge retrieval, or workflow technologies such as Temporal, LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls and operational safeguards, with knowledge of AI evaluation, observability, and responsible AI.
  • Experience supporting technology adoption or operating-model transformation, particularly in financial services or another regulated industry.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • AI opportunities that progress from discovery to proof of value and, where appropriate, production adoption.
  • Measurable business outcomes tied to clearly defined KPIs.
  • Ability to identify and reframe valuable opportunities while connecting near-term delivery to longer-term transformation.
  • Solutions that improve the broader workflow and are adopted into sustainable operating models.
  • Strong stakeholder relationships, technical quality, and effective management of security, risk, and reliability.
  • Reusable capabilities and implementation patterns incorporated into the enterprise AI platform.

Working Model and Travel

Occasional travel may be required for workshops or key delivery milestones, but frequent travel is not expected. Roles may be based near selected American Express offices to support close partnerships with regional business and product teams.

title: Patient Service Rep - Ear, Nose & Throat (E.N.T.)
description:
The Patient Service Rep is responsible for positive patient relations, accurate telephone communication, appointment scheduling, patient registration, payment and co-payment collection and overall providing outstanding customer service to patients through the intake of calls and ability to navigate services throughout Cedars Sinai Medical Network. This position also performs routine duties associated with the collection and maintenance of current patient demographics and insurance information.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides outstanding customer service through the successful intake, prioritizing, and resolution of calls and patient needs for a multi-specialty team.

  • Greets patients and assist with resolving patient issues or raising patients issues.

  • Check-in and out patients and collect co-payments/give receipts/reconcile payments. Verifies that patient demographic and insurance data are accurate in CS-Link.

  • Schedules appointments, complete patient registration, collect patient payments and provides a high standard of patient service.

  • Assists with the management of physician schedules and finds opportunities for improvement. Handle patient/provider correspondence as instructed.

  • Process and track referrals and authorizations for various insurance types.

  • Manages patient care flow and assist with monitoring CS-Link message pools and standard work.

  • Monitors and assess their own workflow to find opportunities for improvement.

  • Explains policies, procedures, or services to patients using administrative knowledge

  • Participates in daily huddles and staff meetings.

  • Promotes and practice infection prevention standards and all department policies and procedures.

Education:

High school diploma or GED preferred.

Experience:

Two (2) years of experience working as a Patient Service Rep in an outpatient medical office setting preferred.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Key Responsibilities:

System Design & Validation Development

  • Design and develop scalable validation frameworks for GPU racks and HPC infrastructure.
  • Build automated benchmarks and diagnostics for NCCL performance, GPU health, NVLink connectivity, and InfiniBand and high-speed networks.
  • Develop Slurm-based workflows for distributed validation and performance testing.
  • Implement retries, timeouts, and recovery mechanisms to improve framework resilience.
  • Develop functional, load, and fault-injection tests to assess reliability and production readiness.

Reliability & Operational Engineering

  • Build dashboards, telemetry, and alerts to monitor infrastructure health and validation results.
  • Develop automated tools for Linux diagnostics, log analysis, hardware fault isolation, FDT, and cable validation.
  • Convert incident findings into reusable diagnostics and preventive automation.
  • Develop recovery runbooks and contribute to incident response and root cause investigations.

Automation, Security & Change Management

  • Develop and maintain Bash, Python, and Infrastructure as Code tools for deployment and configuration.
  • Implement access controls and secure handling of infrastructure credentials and diagnostic data.
  • Automate patching, updates, and rollback workflows in accordance with change management practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation and improve automation coverage across infrastructure workflows.

Core Responsibilities:

Planning & Delivery

  • Translate project requirements into development plans and deliverables.
  • Manage assigned work with minimal supervision, meeting agreed timelines and quality standards.
  • Adapt priorities as requirements, resources, and dependencies change.

Collaboration & Problem Solving

  • Work with HPC, infrastructure, and engineering teams to define requirements and align on outcomes.
  • Use logs, metrics, and diagnostic results to investigate issues and develop lasting solutions.
  • Resolve issues independently, escalate when needed, and document findings to support shared understanding.

Continuous Learning & Improvement

  • Build expertise in GPU systems, HPC technologies, and software development through training and feedback.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to validation coverage, reliability, and development efficiency.
  • Share reusable tools and best practices, and incorporate team feedback into ongoing improvements.

title: Vice President, Data Modernization — Data Readiness & Metadata Standards
description:
Data is at the heart of how JPMorganChase drives innovation and competitive advantage. Join a team that turns complex, high-volume data into trusted assets that leaders can confidently use to make decisions and build new customer experiences. You will influence how data is defined, described, and governed—so it is easier to discover, interpret, and apply across analytics and artificial intelligence. This role offers meaningful visibility, cross-functional partnership, and the opportunity to shape firmwide standards through tangible delivery and rapid prototyping.

Job summary

As a Vice President in the Data Modernization program within Consumer & Community Banking Data & Analytics, you will lead work that makes structured and unstructured data more discoverable, interpretable, and dependable. You will define practical metadata and data domain patterns—business, technical, and operational—that help teams find, understand, and trust data at scale. You will partner with data owners and engineers to identify quality and definition gaps, prioritize fixes, and convert one-off improvements into scalable standards. You will translate technical progress into clear narratives and measurable outcomes that support roadmap decisions and executive updates.

You will operate as a hands-on standards leader: comfortable in detailed data conversations, credible with engineers, and effective with senior stakeholders. You will balance governance and speed—setting clear expectations while enabling teams to move faster through reusable patterns, scorecards, and prototypes. You will help create the conditions for high-quality analytics, conversational querying, and generative AI experiences by improving the “readiness” of data upstream.

Job responsibilities

  • Shape and drive adoption of the enterprise data readiness framework across Consumer & Community Banking business units.
  • Define and champion standards for business, technical, and operational metadata so data is well-defined, discoverable, and trustworthy at scale.
  • Establish semantic and context standards that improve the consistency, interpretability, and reuse of data across analytics and artificial intelligence systems.
  • Lead profiling of priority domains to surface definitional, lineage, and data-quality gaps, and partner with data owners to close them.
  • Convert one-off fixes into repeatable, scalable enrichment patterns and mentor others to apply them.
  • Advise data leaders and engineers on the quality and usability improvements that create the most value across large datasets.
  • Build and showcase prototypes that demonstrate improved data readiness for analytics and AI-assisted use cases, including conversational and agentic experiences.
  • Own readiness scorecards and key performance indicators, translating progress into inputs for maturity assessments, roadmap decisions, and executive updates.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, scientific, or technical field (for example, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Economics), or equivalent practical experience.
  • Seven years of relevant experience in data science, data management, data governance, data quality, or analytics engineering, including setting standards and influencing across teams.
  • Deep knowledge of metadata management and data catalog tools, with emphasis on discoverability, lineage, and interpretability.
  • Hands-on experience with structured and unstructured data at scale, including profiling, cleansing, standardizing, and documenting large datasets on enterprise platforms or data products.
  • Strong command of data quality frameworks and the ability to diagnose, measure, and drive remediation of quality issues.
  • Understanding of ontology and semantic/context layers, and how consistent definitions improve reuse across analytics and artificial intelligence systems.
  • Solid Structured Query Language (SQL) skills and analytical problem-solving, including root-cause investigation across large data volumes.
  • A first-principles mindset that questions assumptions and ensures data makes sense in context, not just in aggregate.
  • Working knowledge of how conversational analytics, natural-language querying, and agentic AI consume data, and the data conditions they depend on.
  • Strong attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to accuracy.
  • Proven experience collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams in a regulated environment, with clear written and verbal communication for senior stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience in consumer banking or another large-scale, high-volume data environment.
  • Exposure to building or governing semantic models and metrics layers for enterprise analytics.
  • Familiarity with data domain modeling and standardization across multiple business units.
  • Scripting or full-stack skills (for example, Python) that support data profiling, enrichment, and rapid prototyping.
  • Applied exposure to artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI concepts from the perspective of a consumer of well-governed data.

title: Senior Principal Project Controls Spec
description:
Job Overview:


The Senior Principal Project Controls Spec is tasked with solving unique and complex problems that have a broad impact on the business. They must proactively identify and solve the most complex problems that impact the management and direction of the business. They are considered specialists in the field of project controls, and they offer a broad base of knowledge about the project controls function. They impact the direction and resource allocation of programs and projects in their discipline and work within general functional policies and industry guidelines. The Senior Principal Project Controls Spec role requires conceptual and innovative thinking to develop creative solutions to project controls challenges.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement, and maintain corporate progress measurement methodologies, standards, procedures, and reporting requirements across projects.
• Lead the deployment of project controls and progress measurement frameworks across project sites, ensuring alignment with centralized project controls strategies, tools, and governance standards.
• Provide functional leadership and governance to project-based Progress Engineers, Project Controls Specialists, and reporting personnel, ensuring consistency in progress measurement and reporting practices across all assigned projects.
• Develop and enforce project-specific procedures, work methods, and reporting protocols in accordance with company standards and client contractual requirements.
• Define and manage the detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), ensuring alignment and traceability across progress measurement, cost, schedule, scope, and reporting systems.
• Ensure accurate collection, validation, consolidation, and reporting of progress data from Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning activities.
• Establish and maintain progress measurement systems aligned with project execution strategies, contractual requirements, and corporate Project Controls standards.
• Oversee the accurate and timely update of project progress data, ensuring seamless integration with centralized project reporting and performance dashboards.
• Ensure the development and maintenance of project progress curves, milestone tracking reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
• Monitor project performance against approved baselines and identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities affecting project delivery.
• Deliver monthly project performance and progress forecasts, incorporating productivity trends, progress achievements, resource considerations, and schedule risk assessments.
• Support project teams in the implementation and application of weighted progress measurement methodologies and performance reporting systems.
• Collaborate with Planning, Cost Control, Risk Management, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction teams to ensure the integration of cost, schedule, risk, and progress reporting.
• Ensure all project controls functions, including cost, schedule, progress, risk, change, and reporting, are fully integrated, aligned, and executed in a coordinated manner.
• Lead periodic reviews and audits of project progress measurement systems and reporting processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, integrity, and compliance.
• Guide project teams in the application of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and project performance measurement methodologies where applicable.
• Provide strategic analysis of project performance data and recommend corrective actions to improve project outcomes and forecast reliability.
• Oversee the preparation and delivery of internal and external project status reports, ensuring clarity, accuracy, consistency, and strategic insight.
• Develop and deliver training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to progress measurement, performance reporting, and project controls best practices.
• Support bid and proposal efforts by providing input on progress measurement strategies, reporting requirements, performance metrics, and execution methodologies.
• Act as the central subject matter expert for project progress management and provide technical guidance to Project Controls teams across the organization.
• Act as a senior advisor to project leadership, providing strategic guidance on project performance, progress trends, forecasting, and controls optimization.
• Represent the Project Controls function in client meetings, audits, executive reviews, and project performance evaluations relating to progress measurement and reporting.

Essential Qualifications and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
• Minimum of ten (10) years of experience in project controls within project-based organizations, preferably in the oil and gas, energy, or heavy industrial sectors.
• Proven leadership in managing project controls on large-scale, complex EPC projects.
• Deep expertise in progress management, cost control, scheduling, risk management, change control, and performance reporting.
• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple workstreams with minimal supervision.
• Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organizational and analytical skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and familiar with project controls systems and tools.
• Conversant with local and international QHSES (Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security) regulations and standards.
• Ability to operate effectively in a global, multicultural environment and represent the company with professionalism and authority.

title: Salesforce Developer / Architect - Remote
description:
Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

We are seeking a hands-on Salesforce Developer / Solution Architect to join our technology organization. In this role, you will design and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions integrated with traditional enterprise applications. You will combine strong Salesforce expertise with extensive experience in Java, .NET, APIs, databases, middleware, cloud platforms, and legacy modernization, while championing AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) adoption across engineering teams. You will evaluate implementation options across Salesforce and backend services, establish reusable design patterns, and drive platform security and performance.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead hands-on development and end-to-end solution architecture for Salesforce platforms and related enterprise applications
  • Design end-to-end solutions across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL, platform events, and asynchronous processing
  • Define API, integration, security, data, deployment, and non-functional architecture to ensure platform security, scalability, performance, and compliance
  • Integrate Salesforce with Java/.NET applications, databases, middleware, cloud services, and third-party platforms, evaluating optimal capability placement across systems
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI, while championing AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) adoption across engineering teams
  • Use enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, evaluate emerging trends, and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and provide implementation guidance to support application modernization and technical-debt reduction
  • Establish reusable design patterns, development standards, CI/CD practices, and architecture guardrails while communicating solution options, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to stakeholders

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of equivalent enterprise application development or solution architecture experience
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise application development or solution architecture
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development and architecture experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce security, data modeling, and governor limits
  • 2+ years of experience in AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) or AI-assisted engineering practices
  • Experience with Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service, or Health Cloud
  • Hands-on development experience in Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, .NET/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or comparable technologies
  • Experience with REST / SOAP APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, batch processing, and enterprise integration
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), including DevSecOps, containers, and release management tools (Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II, Integration Architect, or Data Architect certification
  • Experience with integration technologies such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Informatica, or Boomi
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications into Salesforce-enabled or cloud-native solutions
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated enterprise environment

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. title: Coder Outpatient
description:

title: Project Manager - Director/Senior Director - Project Farma
description:

We accomplish this through the successful execution of high-quality life sciences projects across the full project lifecycle. Project Farma (PF) team members collaborate with cross-functional teams to build trusted client relationships, deliver an exceptional customer experience, and contribute to business growth by identifying opportunities and applying data-driven insights to support project planning, cost, schedule, and performance management.

This role provides strategic leadership, oversees multiple teams or initiatives, and partners cross-functionally to align people, processes, and priorities with company objectives. At more senior levels, this role is accountable for shaping strategy, leading leaders, and driving sustained business impact across a significant area of the organization, while influencing enterprise-level decisions, ensuring operational excellence, and developing leadership talent to balance short-term execution with long-term growth objectives.


Key Responsibilities

This role demands strategic insight, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership to guide clients through capital investments that reshape operations, expand capacity, and deliver long-term business value.


The Senior Project Director acts as a senior advisor and owner’s representative, directing projects from concept through startup and transition to operations. Governance & Executive Engagement

Program Management & Integration

  • Drive alignment across engineering, operations, quality, regulatory, and commercial functions.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in resolving complex technical and operational challenges.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Anticipate and mitigate strategic, financial, and operational risks across the project portfolio.
  • Ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (GMP, FDA, ISO, EHS).
  • Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Experience Required
