title: Director, Engineering Process Definition & Improvement
description:
This leader defines one standard way Forgent engineers work, at every site, and keeps improving it. The role owns the end-to-end engineering process for switchgear and switchboard products: from quote and order entry through design, drawings, BOM release, and handoff to manufacturing.

As Forgent grows across multiple sites, inconsistent methods drive rework, long lead times, and quality escapes. This director turns site-by-site practices into a documented, measured, and continuously improved system that scales with demand while protecting UL compliance.

Key responsibilities

Process definition and standardization

• Map, define, and document the current and future-state engineering workflow across all sites, from quote through release to production.

• Establish enterprise standards for design rules, drawing packages, BOM structure, part numbering, naming conventions, and design reviews.

• Own the engineering process library: SOPs, work instructions, templates, checklists, and RACI for each stage.

• Govern change: create and run a controlled process for proposing, approving, and rolling out process changes.

Continuous improvement

• Lead a prioritized improvement roadmap using Lean, Six Sigma, and value-stream methods to cut engineering lead time, rework, and errors.

• Run root-cause and corrective action on engineering-driven escapes, ECOs, and field issues.

• Drive design standardization and reuse (configurable designs, standard modules, libraries) to reduce custom engineering per order.

Systems and tools

• Partner with IT and engineering leaders to select, implement, and align tools (ECAD/MCAD, PLM/PDM, ERP integration, configurators, design automation) to the defined process.

• Ensure data flows cleanly between engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing systems.

Compliance and quality

• Embed UL and code requirements (e.g., UL 891, UL 1558, NEC) into design standards and review gates, in partnership with Quality and the UL compliance lead.

• Ensure processes support audit readiness and consistent documentation across sites.

Measurement and reporting

• Define and publish engineering KPIs by site and enterprise-wide; report progress to executive leadership.

• Use data to identify bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and best practices to replicate across sites.

Cross-functional partnership

• Work closely with Sales/Applications, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Project Management to improve handoffs.

• Act as the single point of accountability for how engineering work moves through the business.

Leadership and scope

The director leads through a small central team and a network of site process owners.

• Direct reports: process/CI engineers, engineering standards and documentation specialists, and an engineering systems analyst (team size to confirm).

• Indirect influence: engineering managers and site process champions at every Forgent site.

• Decision authority: approves enterprise engineering standards, templates, and process changes; sets the improvement roadmap with @Dan Eslinger.

• Leadership expectations: builds a culture of standard work and continuous improvement, coaches engineers in problem-solving, and develops successors and site champions.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• 10+ years of engineering experience in electrical equipment or engineered-to-order manufacturing, including 5+ years leading teams.

• Proven record defining and deploying standard engineering processes across multiple sites or business units.

• Hands-on Lean / continuous improvement experience with measurable results.

• Working knowledge of engineering tools and systems: ECAD/MCAD, PLM/PDM, and ERP integration.

Preferred

• Familiarity with UL and NEC requirements for low- and medium-voltage electrical equipment.

• Experience with switchgear, switchboards, panelboards, or similar power distribution products.

• Six Sigma Green or Black Belt; PMP or equivalent.

• Experience leading ECAD or PLM implementations and design automation or configure-to-order initiatives.

• Master's degree or MBA.

• Experience in a fast-growing, multi-site organization.

Competencies and working conditions

Core competencies

• Systems thinking: sees the whole quote-to-production flow, not just one step.

• Change leadership: wins adoption across sites without direct authority over every team.

• Data-driven decisions: sets baselines, measures, and reports results honestly.

• Clear communication: writes crisp standards and presents to executives and shop floor alike.

• Collaboration: builds trust with Sales, Operations, Quality, and site leadership.

Working conditions

• Office and manufacturing floor environments; PPE required on the floor.

• Regular travel between Forgent sites, up to 40%.

Forgent Power is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Lagermedarbejder
description:
Keflico vækster – derfor har vi brug for endnu en lagermedarbejder

Er du god til at holde overblik, har sans for sikker, hurtig og effektiv håndtering af varer - og er du klar til at sætte dine kompetencer i spil i en større nordjysk handelsvirksomhed med et af Danmarks største lagre af træ og træbaserede produkter?

Så er det dig, vi søger i Keflico!

Lige nu er vi på udkig efter en lagermedarbejder fra øverste hylde, der vil være med til at gøre en positiv forskel via effektiv og pålidelig varehåndtering på vores 14.000 kvadratmeter store lager i Støvring, Nordjylland. I stillingen som lagermedarbejder i Keflico vil du blive en del af et fagligt stærkt team, der har passion for den gode lagerhåndtering til nytte og gavn for kunder, leverandører og kollegaer. Du vil få en bred berøringsflade med et stort ansvar for, at vores træbaserede produkter bliver håndteret korrekt fra modtagelse til afsendelse.

Du vil således komme til at jonglere med alt lige fra varemodtagelse, udtagning af varer, daglig håndtering, pakning af ordrer samt pålæsning fra lageret til leveringer overalt i hele landet.

Vi har tillid til dine evner – og du får rig mulighed for at sætte dem i spil hos os!

Hvad bliver din rolle?

Du bliver en del af en moderne og visionær organisation, hvor du kommer til at sætte dit tydelig præg på vores lagerhåndtering. Stillingen er 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdssted på vores hovedkontor i Støvring, Nordjylland.

Dine primære opgaver bliver lagerhåndtering af varer. Det er derfor også en forudsætning, at du kan holde overblik, agere fleksibelt og navigere i de forskellige opgaver, der byder sig på lageret. Men ikke mindst også, at du har lysten til at servicere, og sammen med den øvrige del af organisationen, skabe gode oplevelser for vores kunder og leverandører. Du vil derfor komme til at have ansvaret for:

  • Sikker, hurtig og effektiv håndtering af varer på lageret indenfor dit ansvarsområde.
  • Være med til at sikre korrekt varemodtagelse og indgangskontrol.
  • Sikre at varerne bliver opbevaret korrekt og mest effektivt.
  • Foretage pluk samt pakning af ordrer ud fra pluksedler.
  • Bidrage til at korrekte informationer om varerne på lageret er tilgængelige i IT-systemerne.
  • Være med til at sikre et pænt og velholdt lager sammen med teamet.

Hvad forventer vi af dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring med truckkørsel – og gerne erfaring med håndtering af træprodukter. Du skal have både lyst og forudsætningerne for at være en del af et team, der dagligt driver og udvikler den professionelle lagerhåndtering.

Det er vigtigt, at du har en god IT-forståelse, og har du erfaring med Business Central 365, er det en fordel.

Du er frisk med en sund fysik, da arbejdet kan være fysisk krævende. Du følger dine opgaver til dørs – og du er ikke bange for at tage fat, give en ekstra hånd med og komme med forslag til nye initiativer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du vil blive en aktiv spiller i en virksomhed, hvor social ansvarlighed og den enkeltes muligheder prioriteres højt. Ordentlighed og engagement er en integreret del af vores værdier. Derfor tilbyder vi blandt andet også god kantineordning, sundhedsforsikring samt løn i henhold til overenskomst med mulighed for at deltage i vores fælles bonusordning.

Lyder dette som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV inkl. bilag til hr@keflico.com senest den 01.11.2026.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Ansættelsesstart vil være fra den 01.12.2026 eller senest 01.01.2027 – vi venter gerne på den rigtige.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte lager- og logistikchef Jens Egsdal Laursen på jel@keflico.com

Om Keflico

Vi er en nordjysk virksomhed, der gennem 70 år har specialiseret os i træ og træbaserede pladeprodukter. Vores erfaring, specialistviden indenfor træinnovation og historie gør, at vi er en af de førende leverandører af træ til byggeriet og den træforbrugende industri.

Hos Keflico forsøger vi kontinuerligt at forny os og tænke i nye baner, mens vi bruger velafprøvede metoder til at fremme ansvarligt og bæredygtigt brug af træ overalt i verden. Bæredygtig udvikling er en kerneværdi i Keflico, og det betyder blandt andet, at vi var den første af en række danske træhandelsvirksomheder til at præsentere en bæredygtig indkøbspolitik for alle vores træbaserede produkter.

Hos os er der et stort fokus på værdiskabelse i form af tilpassede, unikke og langtidsholdbare koncepter og løsninger, som udarbejdes i tætte samarbejder og gennem langvarige relationer med kunder og leverandører.

title: QA Tester
description:

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for a QA Tester to join our LabArchives team working on our industry-leading Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), Inventory, and Scheduler products. We are looking for people who with a relevant Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and 2+ years of relevant working experience.

In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

Other Total Rewards Offered

  • Health Spending Accounts
  • Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance

Base Pay Range
$61,000—$83,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. title: Associate, Acquisitions and Strategic Investments Group
description:
Join a team where your analysis helps shape major strategic decisions. You will work on acquisitions, divestitures, and minority investments from evaluation through execution, alongside partners across JPMorganChase. You will also support portfolio companies after the investment, helping track performance and value over time. This role offers broad exposure, high visibility, and the opportunity to develop as an investor and transaction leader. You will collaborate with colleagues in New York and London in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Job summary

As an Associate in the Acquisitions and Strategic Investments Group, you will partner with teams across JPMorganChase to evaluate, structure, and execute acquisitions, divestitures, and minority investments. You will build and review financial models and valuations, develop clear investment materials, and help manage end-to-end diligence and execution. You will also support portfolio management for existing investments, including valuation updates, performance monitoring, and stakeholder coordination. You will work closely with senior investment professionals while taking ownership of key workstreams. You will contribute to market monitoring and strategic projects that inform where we invest and how we grow.

Job responsibilities

  • Build financial models and prepare valuation analyses to support transaction evaluations and strategic projects
  • Develop investment committee and deal materials, including clear, well-structured presentations
  • Coordinate and project manage due diligence across internal partners and external counterparties
  • Support transaction structuring and drive workstreams through signing and closing with oversight from senior team members
  • Perform market and company research to inform investment theses and recommendations
  • Monitor portfolio company performance, including key performance indicators, operating updates, and valuation inputs
  • Manage portfolio-related processes, including quarterly valuation updates and shareholder or corporate actions
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external management teams to support ongoing portfolio engagement
  • Track industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities relevant to JPMorganChase
  • Coach and mentor analysts through on-the-job training, feedback, and review of core deliverables

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in investment banking (mergers and acquisitions), corporate development, venture capital, private equity, management consulting, or a similar analytical role
  • Experience with corporate finance concepts and common valuation methodologies (for example, comparable companies, precedent transactions, discounted cash flow)
  • Ability to conduct independent research using public disclosures and market data sources (for example, SEC filings, Bloomberg, PitchBook, FactSet, Capital IQ)
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint, including building executive-ready presentations
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including building and auditing financial models
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities in parallel with attention to detail
  • Effective communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex topics into clear written and verbal updates
  • Demonstrated judgment and ownership, including the ability to work independently and escalate appropriately

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Direct deal experience supporting acquisitions, divestitures, or minority investments end-to-end
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and presenting analysis in decision-making forums
  • Portfolio support experience, such as valuation updates, performance tracking, or investor/board engagement support
  • Prior experience across both qualitative diligence (business model, strategy, competitive dynamics) and quantitative diligence (unit economics, forecasting)
  • Experience mentoring junior team members through feedback and structured development
  • Interest in market monitoring and identifying new strategic opportunities in financial services and adjacent sectors

title: Glazing/Curtainwall Designer
description:
About Bothwell-Accurate


Bothwell-Accurate Co. Inc. has been a leader in roofing, waterproofing, cladding and glazing services across Ontario and British Columbia for over 90 years. With more than 60,000 completed projects, we’re known for delivering high-quality, innovative and reliable building envelope solutions to commercial, industrial and institutional clients.


As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Glazing/Curtainwall Designer to join our Glazing team. This role is ideal for an experienced designer with strong technical knowledge of commercial glazing systems who can translate architectural and structural requirements into accurate, constructible drawings. You will work closely with project managers, engineering, field teams and other stakeholders to support projects from design development through fabrication and installation.


What You’ll Do

  • Prepare detailed drawings and installation details for commercial glazing projects

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers regarding glazing systems, components and technical requirements
  • Provide technical support to fabrication and field teams during project execution
  • Assist with project handoffs and ensure design information is communicated accurately to project and production teams
  • Maintain organized drawing files, revisions and project documentation
  • Support and provide technical guidance to junior designers and drafting team members as required
  • Manage multiple projects and drawing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail


What You Bring to the Team

  • Diploma or degree in Architectural Technology, Engineering Technology, Drafting, Building Science or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in commercial glazing design and drafting, preferably within complex building envelope projects
  • Strong knowledge of commercial glazing systems, including curtain wall, window wall, storefront, entrances and architectural glass systems
  • Demonstrated experience independently preparing and reviewing shop drawings, fabrication drawings and detailed construction drawings for commercial glazing projects
  • Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; experience with Revit or other BIM/design software is considered an asset
  • Ability to read and interpret complex architectural, structural and engineering drawings and specifications
  • Strong understanding of glazing details, system interfaces, tolerances, fabrication requirements and constructability
  • Experience coordinating designs with Project Managers, Engineers, Consultants, Suppliers and field teams
  • Ability to identify design conflicts, technical issues and constructability concerns and develop practical solutions
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to drawing accuracy and quality
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple projects and competing deadlines
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Experience reviewing the work of the drafting team and providing technical guidance
  • Experience within commercial construction, façade or building envelope projects is strongly preferred


Role Snapshot

  • Location: Head Office – 6675 Rexwood Rd, Mississauga, ON L4V 1V1
  • Type: Full-Time, Onsite
  • Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

  • Reports To: Glazing Manager / Senior Leadership
  • Pay Schedule: Paid bi-weekly, every second Friday

Why Join Bothwell-Accurate?

  • Real opportunities to grow and advance

Where your work shapes skylines, and your growth shapes your career.

title: Network Developer 2
description:
Designs and develops network systems for small and large-scale enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments independently, collaborating with vendors and internal groups to validate configurations. Contributes business logic to automation frameworks for testing and operations independently, automating network tasks and reviewing dashboards to monitor network health. Independently develops and implements test cases and strategies, guiding junior engineers, conducting break-fix validation, and gathering and innovating compliance data collection. Implements and defines requirements for monitoring network health using dashboards and alerting systems, conducts incident response and root cause investigations, and develops tools for frontline support teams. Collaborates with project managers to achieve milestones, guides junior engineers, contributes to incident response and RCA documentation, and ensures networking standards adherence independently. Analyzes network performance metrics to identify efficiency issues and supports infrastructure growth with guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Network Design, Development, and Validation:

Automation and Scripting:

Testing and Quality Assurance:
-Develops and implements standalone test cases and test strategies independently.
-Provides expertise in test practices and strategies, guiding junior engineers in developing robust testing protocols.
-Provides break-fix validation support and conducts post-event root cause analysis (RCA) to address issues.

-Runs tests and verifies that systems meet defined compliance and readiness criteria, under supervision.
-Gathers Government, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) data following playbook and begins to innovate scripts to streamline data collection.

Monitoring and Reliability:
-Interprets advanced metrics across dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health, including defining metrics, trends, and thresholds to ensure service level objectives (SLOs).
-Implements monitoring and alerting systems for detecting and diagnosing network anomalies.
-Serves in operational support rotations by providing incident response and conducting root cause investigations, seeking assistance as needed to resolve escalated technical issues.
-Implements tools and solutions for frontline support teams to respond to network failure conditions.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership:
-Collaborates with project/program managers to achieve test and deployment milestones.
-Provides guidance to junior engineers and acts as a subject matter expert (SME) for routine issues.
-Engages with customer and contributes to the delivery of incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
-Participates in discussions on roadmap and software architecture design, providing feedback on ideas from junior team members.
-Collaborates with vendors and internal teams to ensure adherence to networking standards adherence, independently.

Performance and Capacity Management:
-Analyzes network performance and service metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify network efficiency issues, with support from other team members on next steps.
-Uses capacity information through security and performance metrics to ensure the infrastructure can support anticipated growth, requesting guidance from others on steps forward.

Core Responsibilities


Planning & Execution:
-Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.

Collaboration & Partnership:
-Collaborates within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.

Problem Solving:
-Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

Continuous Learning:
-Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

Continuous Improvement:
-Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.

title: Pædagog til SFO og skole
description:
Vores dygtige pædagog er blevet ansat som børnehaveklasseleder, og derfor søger vi nu en ny kollega til en stilling på 32 timer om ugen.

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for børn og skabe sammenhæng mellem skole, SFO og fritid? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af både SFO Solsikken og skoledagen på Frederikssund Private Realskole.

Om stillingen

Frederikssund Private Realskole er en af Danmarks største og ældste privatskoler, der ligger centralt i Frederikssund tæt på S-tog.

Vi har ca. 770 elever fra 0.-9. klasse, og Solsikken er skolens egen fritidsordning for elever i 0.-3. klasse. Vi lægger vægt på at skabe en tryg og sammenhængende hverdag for børnene. Derfor følger klassepædagogen sin klasse fra førskole til og med 3. klasse, og bliver dermed en vigtig del af både skole- og fritidsdelen.

I Solsikken prioriterer vi leg og bevægelse både inde og ude. Vi søger en pædagog, der har lyst til at tage initiativ, sætte aktiviteter i gang og samtidigt bevare overblikket. Du bliver en del af en engageret og fagligt kompetent personalegruppe, der arbejder sammen for at skabe de bedste rammer, for et trygt, meningsfuldt og udviklende skole- og fritidsliv for alle børn.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • er fagligt velfunderet og udviklingsorienteret
  • er fleksibel, har let til smil og brænder for børns trivsel
  • er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet på skolen
  • møder både børn og voksne lyttende, tolerant og nysgerrigt
  • tager initiativ og kan bevare overblikket i en travl og aktiv hverdag

Vi tilbyder:

  • et velfungerende team, hvor vi hjælper og støtter hinanden
  • mulighed for at præge SFO’ens udvikling, hvor der er plads til idéer og kort fra tanke til handling
  • stærke fællesskaber, hvor vi værner om både SFO’ens og skolens traditioner
  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel tone og højt til loftet

Du er velkommen til at kontakte SFO-leder Peter Lundgren Nielsen på tlf. 26 90 16 10.

Du kan også læse mere om os på eller besøge vores Facebook-side.

Stillingen er på 32 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026 – eller gerne tidligere.

Løn følger gældende overenskomst med BUPL.

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag den 19. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Send din ansøgning til: kontor@fpr.nu (skriv “Ansøgning” i emnefeltet).

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview:


The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal and external issues to support and improve project controls processes within McDermott. They act as a resource for colleagues by sharing practical and technical expertise related to project controls and project performance management.

The Senior Project Controls Specialist supports project performance through the integration of progress measurement, cost control, schedule management, forecasting, analysis, and reporting activities. They work closely with project stakeholders to ensure accurate performance measurement, timely reporting, and effective decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Support the implementation and maintenance of project controls systems, tools, processes, and methodologies in accordance with company standards and project requirements.
• Coordinate the collection, validation, and consolidation of project progress updates from Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning teams.
• Establish and maintain project progress measurement systems aligned with project execution plans, reporting requirements, and contractual obligations.
• Ensure the accurate and timely update of project progress data and maintain the integrity of project performance reporting systems.
• Develop and maintain project performance reporting tools, including progress curves, dashboards, milestone reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
• Monitor project performance against approved cost, schedule, and progress baselines, identifying variances, trends, risks, and opportunities affecting project delivery.
• Support the development and maintenance of project schedules, ensuring alignment with project execution strategies and project performance objectives.
• Perform schedule analysis and monitor critical path activities, milestone achievement, and schedule health to support successful project delivery.
• Support project forecasting activities through analysis of cost, schedule, productivity, and progress performance trends.
• Assist in the preparation and maintenance of cost forecasts, commitment tracking, accrual reviews, and variance analysis.
• Collaborate with Cost Control personnel to ensure alignment between project progress, earned value, forecasting activities, and overall project performance reporting.
• Support the integration of cost, schedule, and progress information to provide accurate and meaningful project performance analysis.
• Assist in the application of Earned Value Management (EVM) methodologies and other project performance measurement techniques.
• Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc project controls reports for project management, clients, and other stakeholders.
• Participate in project performance reviews and provide analysis related to progress achievement, cost performance, schedule performance, and forecasted outcomes.
• Support project change management activities by assessing and reporting potential impacts to project cost, schedule, and performance metrics.
• Collaborate with Planning, Cost Control, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Project Management teams to ensure alignment of project controls information and reporting requirements.
• Review and validate project controls data to ensure accuracy, consistency, integrity, and compliance with project controls standards and reporting requirements.
• Identify project performance issues and recommend corrective actions to improve project execution and forecast reliability.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of project controls procedures, reporting processes, systems, tools, and best practices.
• Provide guidance and support to less experienced project controls personnel.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, project requirements, client expectations, and applicable industry standards.

Essential Qualifications and Education:
• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field.
• Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, preferably in the oil and gas, energy, construction, or heavy industrial sectors.
• Experience supporting large-scale EPC projects in project controls, cost control, planning and scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, or performance reporting.
• Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, planning and scheduling, forecasting, progress measurement, change management, variance analysis, and performance reporting.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams.
• Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.

title: Project Manager
description:
Basic Function
The Project Manager serves at Buckner Children and Family Services in leading the planning, execution, monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement of domestic and international Missions projects. This role ensures projects align with approved strategic objectives, intended outcomes, budgets, timelines, and grant requirements. The Project Manager oversees project management systems, project intake, prioritization, risk management, impact measurement, and compliance while providing leadership with visibility into project performance, capacity, and organizational priorities.
Primary Responsibilities

Manage the Missions project portfolio and ensure projects align with approved strategy, intended outcomes, budgets, and organizational priorities.
Facilitate project intake, evaluation, prioritization, and capacity planning to ensure resources are directed toward the highest-impact initiatives.
Ensure each project has defined goals, intended outcomes, timelines, budgets, deliverables, success measures, and assigned ownership consistent with guidance from Program Development & Design (PDD) and Missions leadership.
Serve as the primary manager of post-award grant administration and coordinate compliance activities with Finance, Development, PDD, and project owners to ensure all reporting and contractual requirements are fulfilled.
Serve as the departmental administrator and champion for the project management software, maintaining project visibility, accountability, workflow consistency, and documentation standards.
Monitor project progress, milestones, deadlines, risks, dependencies, and resource constraints and proactively intervene when projects fall behind schedule.
Develop and maintain systems and processes that support the collection, analysis, reporting, and use of project performance and impact data.
Coordinate impact measurement activities and ensure project outcomes are accurately tracked, analyzed, and reported according to established frameworks.
Produce accurate internal and external reports that communicate project performance, outcomes, lessons learned, and recommendations for improvement.
Monitor project budgets, financial performance, grant requirements, and funding restrictions and recommend corrective actions when necessary.
Provide routine portfolio-level reporting, risk assessments, and project recommendations to the Director of Missions and departmental leadership.
Maintain portfolio-level visibility of project performance and proactively address issues to reduce administrative burden on program leaders and the Director of Missions.
Serve as the Missions liaison to Program Development & Design regarding project portfolio management, impact measurement, continuous improvement, and organizational standards.
Coordinate with Finance, Development, Program Development & Design, Volunteer Engagement, Communications, and operational teams to support successful project implementation.
Support grant proposal development by providing project plans, budgets, impact data, reporting information, and operational input.
Promote effective integration and use of organizational systems.
Identify and implement process improvements that strengthen accountability, efficiency, risk management, reporting, and organizational effectiveness.
Support responsible implementation of approved technology, automation, analytics, and AI tools that improve project execution and departmental performance.
Provide support on complex or high-priority mission experiences and projects as assigned.

Other Responsibilities

Maintain compliance with all Buckner policies, procedures, and requirements. Maintain knowledge of and compliance with all state and federal laws and regulatory requirements.
Manage program resources to ensure they are used efficiently and appropriately aligned with approved business objectives.
Responsible for supporting and representing Buckner at special events, activities, and other assigned functions.
Attend and participate in meetings and training as required; facilitate meetings regularly as define by the communication framework and training as required.
Develop emerging leadership through professional growth and development.
Work successfully as a part of a team and responsible for developing and maintaining strong working relationships with co-workers.
Perform special assignments, projects, and other duties as required.

Education and Licensing Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in project management, Business Administration, Nonprofit Management, International Development, Public Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, Organizational Leadership, or a closely related field is required to perform essential job functions. Master's Degree preferred.
Requires a minimum of five years of progressive experience project management, program operations, portfolio management, grants management, organizational effectiveness, or a related field. Requires experience with project portfolio management, project intake processes, prioritization frameworks, resource planning, and organizational capacity management.
Requires demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent projects, managing competing priorities, and coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve organizational objectives. Requires demonstrated ability to create and manage project budgets, analyze financial information, monitor expenditures, and identify financial risks and variances.
Requires experience coordinating program evaluation, impact measurement, monitoring, and reporting activities. Requires experience developing and maintaining project reporting systems, dashboards, performance metrics, and data-driven decision-making processes.
Requires advanced knowledge of project management methodologies, project governance practices, risk management, and continuous improvement principles. PMP, PMD Pro, CAPM, Agile, Lean, or similar certification preferred.
Requires proficiency with project management, collaboration, reporting, and data-analysis software. Experience; Asana experience is strongly preferred. Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, Virtuous, Financial Edge NXT, or similar enterprise systems is preferred.
Requires experience in diverse and international settings. Latin American experience preferred.
Requires experience in cultivating donor relationships.
Requires knowledge of grant administration, compliance monitoring, reporting requirements, budget controls, and grant closeout procedures.
Experience working in nonprofit, humanitarian, ministry, community development, international development, or related mission-driven environments preferred.

Other Requirements

Requires ability to read, write, speak, and understand English sufficiently to perform the essential functions of the position, including communication with clients, volunteers, and community partners, documentation, and collaboration with staff. Spanish language proficiency preferred to support effective communication with Spanish-speaking clients and families.
Requires in-depth knowledge of social development and social change theory and practice.
Requires demonstrated ability to identify project risks, evaluate impacts, develop mitigation strategies, and communicate recommendations to leadership.
Requires ability to lead meetings, facilitate planning discussions, document decisions, and maintain accountability for commitments and deadlines.
Requires strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, including the ability to interpret complex information, identify trends, solve problems, and develop practical recommendations.
Requires exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.
Requires ability to work effectively with individuals across multiple departments and organizational levels while maintaining positive and productive working relationships.
Requires excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate complex information clearly to a variety of audiences.
Requires ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and make informed decisions with limited supervision.
Requires ability to adapt to changing priorities, manage ambiguity, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Requires ability to travel to various geographic locations, both domestic and international, and some overnight stays. Requires ability to obtain and maintain the necessary documentation to travel internationally.
Requires jobholder to work before and after normal business hours, some nights and weekends, as needed to meet client and business needs including promptly responding to phone calls, text messages and emails.
Requires ability to drive assigned vehicle(s) or personal vehicle, with an appropriate state license, following all laws applicable; must provide proof of liability insurance and must be eligible to be insured under Buckner’s insurance policy. Requires the ability to rent vehicles both domestically and internationally using required documentation. Must be age 21 or older to drive on behalf of Buckner.
Requires ability to maintain confidentiality.
Proficient working knowledge and ability to accurately and timely operate and perform computer-related tasks with specific equipment and software applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, required.
Requires recognition that the organization is a faith-based organization operating with a commitment to Christian principles.
Requires ability to use up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently and/or 10 pounds continuously to move objects.
Requires ability to walk frequently; occasionally stand for prolonged periods of time; occasionally required to squat, climb stairs, kneel and twist. Required to sit for prolonged periods of time, including extensive airline travel.
Requires ability to speak clearly and make self-understood in face-to-face interactions; to articulate with extreme accuracy and precisions to give directions, speak on the phone, etc.
Requires ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
Requires sufficient good health to properly discharge duties. Employees shall not be permitted to work who have infectious disease or skin lesion for the duration of the communicability.

You develop trust quickly, communicate with warmth and clarity, and take ownership of your results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Outstanding phone presence and communication skills—warm, uplifting, professional, and persuasive.
  • Ability to clearly explain programs and services to patients in a way that is easy to understand and engenders confidence.
  • Strong data entry and documentation skills with the ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn internal systems.
  • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrated empathy, compassion, and ability to engage patients with sensitivity during challenging healthcare situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual or multilingual abilities.
  • Familiarity with patient portal platforms or healthcare technology tools.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Patient-Focused: Builds rapport quickly and consistently delivers patient-centered interactions that drive adoption and loyalty.
  • Results-Driven: Motivated by measurable outcomes—patient engagement rates, portal adoption, collection success—and takes personal ownership of performance.
  • Effective Communicator: Adapts messaging naturally for diverse audiences, explaining complex healthcare programs in simple, reassuring terms.
  • Action-Oriented: Approaches each call with urgency, energy, and a solution-driven mindset.
  • Compassionate Advocate: Demonstrates genuine care for patients navigating challenging healthcare situations and represents Synapse Health with empathy and professionalism.
  • Nimble Learner: Embraces feedback and coaching, applying insights quickly to elevate performance.
  • Adaptable: Responds positively to evolving campaigns, priorities, and business needs.

Compensation:

The pay range for this position is $20 – $23 per hour. This range reflects the anticipated compensation at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, internal equity, and prevailing market conditions. Compensation discussions are encouraged throughout the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart:

Work is a part of life, but at Synapse Health, we believe it should be meaningful and enjoyable. We’re committed to helping our team members thrive personally and professionally, which is why our benefits include:

  • Professional growth opportunities with compelling career paths
  • Healthy work-life balance supported by generous paid time off (PTO)

title: R&D- Scientist
description:
The R&D Scientist on the Industrial Wood Radiation Cure NPD team independently leads the development, localization, scale-up, validation, commercial launch, maintenance, and improvement of UV- and LED-curable coating systems. The scientist plans and executes technically rigorous experiments, interprets results, and converts findings into practical product and process solutions. The role requires broad knowledge of radiation-cure chemistry, raw materials, substrates, coating application, cure equipment, analytical methods, manufacturing, and customer finishing processes. The scientist manages multiple complex projects, works directly with cross-functional and global partners, supports customer and manufacturing trials, and mentors less experienced technical employees.

Job duties include contact with other employees and access to confidential and proprietary information and/or other items of value, and such access may be supervised or unsupervised. The Company therefore has determined that a review of criminal history is necessary to protect the business and its operations and reputation and is necessary to protect the safety of the Company’s staff, employees, and business relationships.

20% Travel

  1. Safety, Compliance and Technical Stewardship
    1. Follow all safety, environmental, ISO, laboratory, and product safety and regulatory requirements; actively support safe handling of radiation-curable materials and continuous improvement of laboratory practices.
    2. Provide technical assistance for quality investigations, manufacturing issues, raw-material changes, customer complaints, and product-maintenance needs when specialized radiation-cure expertise is required.
  2. Radiation Cure Product Development
    1. Lead projects through the formal product-development process (Stage Gate) from technical assessment and definition of product requirements through formulation, testing, scale-up, field validation, launch, and post-launch support.
    2. Develop and troubleshoot 100% solids, waterborne UV, UV/LED, and related radiation-cure coating systems for Industrial Wood applications, including flooring, digital printing/embossing, roll coat, and other strategic platforms.
    3. Apply strong knowledge of oligomers, monomers, photoinitiators, pigments, matting agents, additives, substrates, application methods, and cure conditions to solve complex formulation and process problems.
    4. Understand UV, LED, mercury/gallium arc, inert-atmosphere, excimer, and related cure technologies, including the interaction of spectral output, dose, irradiance, oxygen inhibition, film build, pigmentation, and line speed.
  3. Experimental Design and Technical Problem Solving
    1. Design efficient experiments using DOE and sound statistical methods; identify root causes, assess risk, define controls, and make clear, data-based technical recommendations.
    2. Plan and support laboratory, pilot, plant, external-manufacturing, and customer-line trials; translate laboratory results to commercial equipment and operating conditions.
  4. Scale-Up, Trials and Commercialization
    1. Lead product localization and technology transfer across regions, including raw-material qualification, regulatory review, formula adaptation, performance benchmarking, supply-chain risk assessment, and manufacturing readiness.
    2. Partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, Technical Service, Applications, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement, and global R&D teams to define customer needs and deliver commercially viable solutions.
  5. Cross-Functional Leadership and Documentation
    1. Communicate project status, technical risks, recommendations, and decisions clearly through laboratory notebooks, technical reports, presentations, updates in the Navigator project-tracking system, Gate reviews, and other required documentation.
    2. Develop differentiated product and platform concepts aligned with Industrial Wood market needs, business priorities, cost targets, manufacturing capability, and customer value.
    3. Exercise sound business judgment by balancing performance, safety, regulatory requirements, cost, manufacturability, supply continuity, speed to market, and customer value.
    4. Protect intellectual property and preserve the technical knowledge base through complete, accurate, and timely documentation.
  6. Portfolio Leadership, Innovation and Mentoring
    1. Lead multiple technically complex projects with limited supervision, establish priorities, manage timelines, and escalate risks or resource needs early.
    2. Mentor chemists, technicians, and early-career formulators; share radiation-cure knowledge, experimental discipline, safe work practices, and troubleshooting approaches.
    3. Maintain awareness of emerging radiation-cure raw materials, equipment, analytical methods, competitive technologies, regulatory constraints, and external innovation opportunities.
    4. Maintain laboratory and application equipment, ensure appropriate calibration and documentation, and support capability development for current and future radiation-cure technologies.

Minimum Requirements
• Must be legally authorized to work in the country for which you are applying for employment (without now or in the future needing sponsorship for employment work visa and/or permanent residence status)
• Must be at least 18 years of age
• Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Coatings Technology, or a related STEM field.
• 8+ years of coatings formulation and product-development experience, including independently leading technically complex projects.
• Demonstrated formulation experience with radiation-curable coatings or inks, preferably including 100% solids UV or UV/LED systems.
• Advanced formulation and troubleshooting of radiation-curable coatings, including structure-property-process relationships.
• Working knowledge of UV and LED cure chemistry, photoinitiator selection, cure measurement, oxygen inhibition, depth and surface cure, and equipment/process variables.
• Experience with coating application and testing methods relevant to Industrial Wood, such as roll coat, spray, curtain, digital print interfaces, sanding, gloss, adhesion, abrasion, scratch, stain/chemical resistance, viscosity, color, and accelerated stability.
• Demonstrated experience with design of experiments, analyzing data, determining root cause, and converting results into clear technical decisions.
• Experience leading product scale-up, manufacturing batches, customer trials, and commercial launch activities.
• Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional project teams and to communicate complex technical information clearly.
• Experience managing multiple high-priority projects, maintain complete documentation, and deliver Stage Gate and Navigator requirements on time.
• Proven mentoring, technical leadership, and knowledge-sharing experience


Preferred Qualifications

• 10+ years of coatings formulation experience with significant radiation-cure, Industrial Wood, flooring, digital-printing, or high-speed roll-coat experience.

title: Quantitative Imaging Scientist
description:
A fantastic opportunity has become available for a Quantitative Imaging Scientist to join Caristo Diagnostics rapidly growing team, based at our Oxford headquarters.


About the Role

Overview
Caristo's technology depends on the accurate and reliable quantitative assessment of cardiac CT scans. This role owns the calibration capability that underpins both our current clinical services and the next generation of our AI-driven cardiovascular products.


You will join a small, highly collaborative Product Innovation team working at the interface between research, engineering, operations and clinical delivery. The role combines scientific thinking with practical execution and requires someone who can make good decisions despite incomplete information, competing priorities and changing requirements.


Success in this role is measured by keeping critical programmes moving, enabling clinical delivery, supporting product development and helping the company make pragmatic technical decisions.
This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, working across teams and turning ambiguity into action.

What You'll Be Doing

Calibration Ownership
• Own Caristo's CT calibration capability and associated roadmap
• Deliver customer calibration requirements that support clinical service delivery
• Maintain and continuously improve calibration methodologies
• Develop next-generation approaches for future products


Product Innovation & Translation
• Support translation of new scientific ideas into deployable products
• Work closely with Engineering, Operations and Product Innovation teams to ensure successful implementation
• Help identify and resolve technical bottlenecks affecting product performance and scalability
• Contribute to validation strategies and regulatory programmes


Scientific Collaboration
• Act as a technical point of contact for Oxford University collaborators and external research partners
• Support delivery of research projects, publications and patents
• Contribute to technical documentation supporting regulatory submissions


Cross-Functional Leadership
• Coordinate activities across research, engineering and operations teams
• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Help prioritise competing requests based on business impact and scientific value
• Identify when a pragmatic solution is more valuable than a perfect one

What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months you will:
• Be recognised as the owner of Caristo's calibration capability
• Deliver customer calibrations reliably and predictably
• Support development of next-generation products and regulatory submissions
• Unblock research, engineering and operations teams through rapid decision-making and technical leadership
• Build effective relationships across Caristo and Oxford University
• Improve the speed with which innovations can be translated into products

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for someone who:
• Makes good decisions with incomplete information
• Understands that a useful answer today can be more valuable than a perfect answer next month
• Thrives in a highly collaborative environment
• Balances scientific rigour with practical delivery
• Shares ideas early and iterates based on feedback
• Takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
• Communicates clearly and pragmatically
• Can prioritise when everything appears urgent
• Is excited by translating science into real-world impact

About Caristo Diagnostics
With the first and only FDA approved (July 29, 2026) coronary artery inflammation diagnostic medical device, CaRi-Heart®, Caristo Diagnostics is a global leader in AI technologies for cardiovascular disease, founded as a spin-out from the University of Oxford in 2018. Caristo also has an FDA approved (2025) coronary artery plaque diagnostic medical device. Its award-winning inflammation technology helps detect hidden heart disease and identify people at risk of a heart attack before symptoms appear allowing for proactive disease management. Working with leading hospitals, research institutions, and pharmaceutical partners, Caristo aims to save lives through early detection and personalized prevention. The company was named a 2026 Technology Pioneer by the World Economic Forum in June 2026. Learn more at www.caristo.com or follow Caristo on LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.


About the CaRi-Heart® Technology
Named first of “7 Technologies That Could Change Heart Healthcare Forevermore” by the Robb Report, the CaRi-Heart® technology is Caristo’s flagship offering which uncovers hidden coronary inflammation, a key driver of cardiovascular disease, on routine Coronary Computed Tomography Angiography (CCTA).

The technology is regulatory approved for clinical use in US, UK, Europe, and Australia and is in use with a growing number of hospitals and clinics. Multiple patents underpinning CaRi-Heart technologies have been granted in major jurisdictions around the world. In addition, exceptional validation results showing CaRi-Heart’s ability to aid the prediction of heart attacks have been published in leading medical journals including the Lancet, JACC, European Heart Journal, and Cardiovascular Research.

Job Title Research Quantitative Imaging Scientist/ Platform Engineer
Department Head of Research and Innovation
Location Oxford, UK (full time in-office)
Benefits:

• Competitive salary (for Oxford location)
• 25 holidays per year plus bank holidays
• Enhanced pension contribution
• Private medical insurance
• Life insurance
• Cycle-to-work scheme
• Additional benefits for long-service


Why join Caristo:

• Be part of a company at the cutting edge of medical technology, with the potential to save lives and revolutionise healthcare
• Join a dynamic and growing team, with opportunities for personal and professional growth
• Contribute to the development of groundbreaking products in a company poised for significant expansion
• Enjoy a supportive and collaborative work environment, with a strong emphasis on innovation, quality, and impact

Caristo Diagnostics is committed to diversity and inclusion, and encourages applications from all qualified candidates, including those making a step up in their career. If you are passionate about making a difference in the world of medical imaging and meet the above criteria, we would love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Technician III
description:
﻿
Perform field and/or laboratory testing, observation, and inspection of construction materials (e.g. soils, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, and steel). Communicate with project manager, engineering technicians, client representative, contractor’s representative and others as applicable regarding the construction site, project requirements, and testing, observation, and inspection requirements and results. Transport material samples with associated identifying documentation to the laboratory for further testing and analysis. Tabulate, prepare, and submit data and observation in the form of written and digital reports as work is performed for daily transmittal to the Terracon Project Manager. Maintain and clean equipment, vehicles and work areas. May assist with scheduling and dispatch of Technicians to project sites. Adhere to strict safety standards.
﻿
  • Performs testing, observation, and inspection as directed in accordance with training and the specified procedures.
  • Provides clear documentation of findings and results.
  • Performs basic analysis of data to verify accuracy before communication and submittal to the Project Manager.
  • Communicates information to Project Manager and other personnel as directed by the PM.
  • Has experience and proficiency in multiple areas of field testing and inspection and or laboratory testing
  • May train lower level technicians
  • May lead the activities of other engineering technicians in the laboratory or on larger field projects.
  • Maintains equipment and calibration.
  • Follows safety rules and practices and other safety requirements for all projects. Performs pre-task planning prior to executing work. Report any safety issues or concerns to management.
  • Be responsible for maintaining quality standards on all projects.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience or the equivalent in training and related experience.
  • Experience with laptop computer use and Microsoft Word and Excel
  • A valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history may be required.

Preferred Qualifications: Certifications in two or more of the following areas:

  • NICET Level II certification in Construction Materials Testing in one or more of the following categories: Asphalt, Concrete, Soils.
  • NICET Level II certification in Geotechnical in one or more of the following categories: Construction, Laboratory, Exploration, Generalist
  • ICC certification in two or more of the following categories: Reinforced Concrete, Spray-applied Fireproofing, Structural Masonry, Prestressed/Post-Tensioned Concrete, Structural Steel – Bolting, Structural Steel – Welding.
  • American Welding Society (AWS) Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)
  • American Society for Nondestructive Testing (ASNT) Level II certification in more than one of the following areas: Visual Testing (VT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), Dye Penetrant Testing (PT), Radiographic Testing (RT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT).
  • Other national, regional, state, and local Materials related certifications requiring experience and written examination will also be considered if deemed appropriate by the Terracon Department Manager.

Required Qualifications:

Materials

  • ACI certification in one or more of the following areas:
  • Concrete Field Testing Technician Grade I
  • Concrete Strength Testing Technician
  • Certified in radiation safety and Nuclear Density Gauge operation.

Steel

  • American Welding Society (AWS) Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), or
  • Structural Steel and/or nondestructive testing services: ASNT Level II

Facilities

  • Relevant certification for the services or project requirements (e.g. Registered Roofing Observer (RRO))

All

You work in the Data & AI tribe in Spain together with other experts, building, defining, and deploying our new Data platform, providing data to our stakeholders in order to cover their need regarding informational and translating functional requirements to the technical team.

As a Data Management CJE, you will report to the CJE Business Lead of Data & AI tribe.

Contribute as a key member of the squad, you will provide a broad knowledge on data models taking business requirements form operational systems and elaborating information mappings for the development members.

In collaboration with different squads and CoE (all together) define new requirements over Functional Data Architecture and Data Management Framework (WoW, Glossary, Metadata, Data Quality, Governance…)

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!

You contribute to the ING One Agile Way of Working and safeguard the Orange Code

Own a master or bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience.

Have proven experience in Data Lake / Data Warehousing platforms, specially within Data Marts Modeling, ETL processes and Reporting, including value proposition design, performance improvements and platform data quality monitoring.

Knowledge on Data Governance and Quality frameworks.

Knowledge on reporting tools such as Micro Strategy, IBM Cognos, Power BI.

Knowledge on the new trends about data management such us Data Fabric, Data Mesh, Data Virtualization …

Agile working experience for more than 2-3 years

Be able to communicate clearly (written and oral) to different stakeholders (advanced English is required)

Be able to participate in the definition of data platform in strategic terms, linking current events and business strategy.

Have strong analytical skills and create models to take decisions based on data and facts.

Have strong analytical and judgement skills (recognize key information, organize problem identification, research, various methods of analysis, establishment of connections, etc.)

Be a team player, stimulate cross-border interaction and alignment between people, Squads & Chapters.

Be curious, passionate about innovation and stay on top of trends and developments within Data world.

Are creative and a pro-active out-of-the box thinker who likes to work in a multidisciplinary team in an agile environment.

You give and ask for constructive feedback.


What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.


Check out what is waiting for you!

Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Meal allowance.

More than an office.

In our offices you can find doctor’s office, hairdresser, gym, Employee Concierge (to help you with your errands) and much more!

Health and life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you, including you and your immediate family.

Flexible remuneration.

Enjoy access to services such as nursery vouchers, public transport and training support, as well as other benefits through our flexible remuneration model.

Commuting made easier.

Our free shuttle service connects different areas of Madrid with ING MAD, helping make your commute to the office more comfortable and convenient.

Banking benefits.

Loans with preferential banking conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

More vitality and more belonging

Our 360º wellbeing approach supports employees across Financial, Physical, Mental and Social Wellbeing.

On-site physiotherapy service.

A strong wellbeing culture, including Wellhub access, sports communities and activities.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.

And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.

Job Application Safety Reminder

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

title: Data Analyst I
description:
About LoadLink Technologies

Join Canada's leading freight and logistics software company, where we've been transforming how carriers, brokers, and shippers connect for over 30 years. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Roper Technologies (NYSE: ROP, S&P 500), LoadLink combines innovative transportation technology solutions with Fortune 1000 stability.

Our best-in-class freight-matching platform helps customers grow their businesses, increase margins, and drive profitability by maximizing assets, optimizing rates, and expanding networks. From replacing the rolodex in 1990 to today's multi-platform solutions, we continue transforming how the commercial transportation industry connects, moves, and manages loads across Canada.

Are you seeking a dynamic, stable, and growing company that values your contributions and fosters a fun work culture with a healthy work-life balance? If yes, Loadlink Technologies is the perfect fit for you! Join our innovative team at the forefront of Canada's booming Tech and Transportation sectors, where your role is crucial in shaping our company's image!

The Opportunity

DAT Loadlink is looking for a Data Analyst I to join our Revenue Operations team in our Mississauga, ON location.

What You’ll Do

Reporting & Analysis

  • Maintain and update existing dashboards, scorecards, and self-serve reports
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses in response to business questions from Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and other departments
  • Extract and organize data from Salesforce and other core business systems to produce clean, usable datasets
  • Maintain sales enablement reports tracking pipeline visibility and rep performance metrics

Data Support & Quality

  • Monitor data pipelines feeding into Salesforce and connected BI/reporting tools, and flag or resolve data quality issues
  • Work within the team's existing ETL/ELT tooling and integration platforms to keep data flowing reliably
  • Provide data support to engineering and systems teams on infrastructure projects

Analytics

  • Maintain and update forecasting outputs for revenue, churn, and other key business drivers using established models
  • Analyze recurring revenue data, including MRR/ARR, deferred revenue, and subscription pricing performance, using existing frameworks
  • Apply established methodologies to flag anomalies or outlier behavior in support of fraud detection efforts

Process & Documentation

  • Identify and automate manual, repetitive reporting tasks
  • Use AI tools to speed up data prep and day-to-day analytical work
  • Document processes and data definitions to support team knowledge-sharing

The Skills and Experience You’ll Bring

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and joining data across relational databases (coursework or project experience welcome)
  • Some exposure to Python and/or R for data manipulation (academic, personal, or professional experience all count)
  • Solid Excel skills, including formulas and pivot tables
  • Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) reporting and data extraction is a plus but not required
  • Interest in or exposure to business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker)

Analytical & Domain Knowledge

  • Coursework or applied experience in statistics, math, economics, or a related quantitative field
  • General familiarity with machine learning concepts (clustering, regression) is a plus
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS business fundamentals, including recurring revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn, NRR), is a plus

Soft Skills & Work Style

  • Strong attention to detail and ownership over the accuracy of your work
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
  • Clear communicator who can explain findings to non-technical teammates
  • Self-directed, with a process improvement mindset
  • Open to using AI-assisted tools and workflows as part of daily work
  • Collaborative team player who contributes to a centralized analytics function serving the broader organization

Nice to Have

  • Recent graduate in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business, or a related field
  • Internship or co-op experience involving data analysis or reporting
  • Prior exposure to CRM systems, revenue operations, or GTM analytics
  • Personal projects, capstone work, or coursework involving data cleaning, visualization, or modeling

Our Culture:

  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a balanced hybrid approach with 2 in-office days.
  • Vibrant Workplace Culture: We celebrate achievements and strike the perfect balance between productivity and enjoyment.
  • Competitive Compensation Package: Benefit from an attractive salary, comprehensive benefits, annual performance bonuses, and an employee recognition program.
  • Secure Your Future: Take advantage of our 50% RSP matching and stock purchase options to build financial stability.
  • Generous Time Off: Recharge with our paid vacation policy, ensuring you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Make a difference by participating in events, fundraisers, and environmental initiatives.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside diverse teams, build strong professional relationships, and engage in networking events and team-building activities.
  • Innovative Technology: Work with cutting-edge tools and systems that keep us at the forefront of our industry

Company Values we Stand By: Acting with Integrity, Owning It, Being Humble, Continuous Improvement & Customer Centricity

title: Risk Management - Counterparty Credit Risk – Prime Brokerage Coverage Lead – Executive Director
description:
Bring your Expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As an Executive Director in the Counterparty Credit Risk team, you will play a key role in managing and mitigating counterparty credit risk across a diverse portfolio. You identify, analyze, and escalate exposures, validate risk reporting, and act as a subject matter expert on margin methodologies and processes. You partner with Credit Officers, Sales and Trading, Market Risk, and senior management to ensure robust risk governance and timely escalation. You help us strengthen risk controls, challenge assumptions, and drive improvements in exposure metrics and reporting.

Job responsibilities:

  • Act as Counterparty Credit Risk coverage lead supporting Prime Brokerage
  • Identify, analyze, monitor, and escalate counterparty exposures, including concentrations and stress vulnerabilities
  • Validate daily risk and exposure reporting, escalating concerns to Credit Officers, senior management, and the front office
  • Serve as subject matter expert on Prime Brokerage margin methodologies, processes, and supporting systems
  • Review client margin requests, assess adequacy versus stress exposures, and provide recommendations for approval
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Prime Brokerage clients and business activity, formulating risk appetite views and challenging risk requests
  • Monitor margin adequacy and risk across top Prime Brokerage counterparties and portfolios
  • Apply Counterparty Stress Analysis framework to analyze and monitor exposures
  • Partner with business and risk stakeholders on exposure topics, methodology releases, model limitations, and policy enhancements
  • Contribute to firmwide initiatives related to counterparty credit exposure metrics, reporting, and technical enhancements

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 10 years of experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance
  • Strong understanding of financial markets and ability to assess the impact of market moves on counterparty exposures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to synthesize complex data into clear risk conclusions and recommendations
  • Proven ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a dynamic environment
  • Strong judgment and ability to challenge assumptions and escalate issues with clarity and professionalism
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
  • Proficiency in using large language model (LLM) and AI toolsets
  • Experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance (Prime Brokerage Risk Management preferred)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance (Prime Brokerage Risk Management preferred)

title: Markets Transition Management Analyst
description:
Job Description

You will manage the onboarding lifecycle for new trading entities within the Markets team, coordinating closely with sales teams, clients, and internal partners to move requests from intake through trading readiness. You will translate onboarding requirements into clear execution plans, drive cross-functional dependencies, monitor risks and delays, and maintain audit-ready documentation while ensuring required controls, regulatory coverage, and legal documentation workflows are completed on time.

-You will manage a pipeline of onboarding requests from intake through trading readiness, ensuring timely and accurate execution.

-You will partner with client-facing teams and clients to confirm onboarding requirements, milestones, and dependencies.

-You will coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., due diligence, credit, legal, operations, regulatory coverage) to drive end-to-end progress.

-You will translate onboarding requirements into clear action plans with owners and target timelines, escalating risks and delays as needed.

-You will drive operational readiness activities, including account and connectivity setup, static/reference data alignment, and workflow handoffs.

-You will validate that required regulatory coverage and applicable classifications are in place, coordinating remediation where gaps are identified.

-You will track legal documentation execution status and ensure documents are appropriately activated and linked.

-You will identify recurring issues and implement process improvements to make onboarding smoother, faster, and more standardized.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills.

-Experience in an operations, onboarding, client service, or middle office function within financial services.
