title: Director, Produce Prescription Operations
description:
Vouchers 4 Veggies-EatSF (V4V), in operation since 2015, is one of the oldest, largest, and most well-respected produce prescription programs in the country. V4V is seeking an experienced, dynamic Director of Produce Prescription Operations to help scale the successful Food is Medicine (FIM) program across multiple geographic locations, with a specific focus on referrals from healthcare settings. As momentum builds around produce prescriptions and reimbursement opportunities expand through health insurance adoption, V4V is experiencing significant growth. Reporting to the Executive Director, the Director of Produce Prescription Operations will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight to ensure program excellence, sustainability, and measurable impact. The role will be instrumental in embedding V4V into health systems and building the infrastructure needed to support growth and scale through healthcare referrals and payments. A key goal will be to scale the already successful Vouchers 4 Veggies grocery and produce prescription programs in accordance with healthcare insurance contracts. Key responsibilities will include:

Healthcare Integration & Partnerships

  • Lead the integration of V4V within healthcare systems and payer networks

  • Establish and manage partnerships with health systems, insurers, and other key stakeholders

  • Assist with contracting and oversee implementation of payment structures

  • Expand operations to new counties through existing and new workflows and operational systems

Program Operations & Compliance

  • Oversee referral acquisition including outreach to community and county health providers, education campaigns, trainings, and other engagement

  • Develop and oversee referral workflows with healthcare partners

  • Oversee revenue cycle management processes (claims processing, billing systems)

  • Ensure compliance with reporting, regulatory, and funding requirements

  • Supervise participant fulfillment systems (restricted spend produce card) and customer service operations

  • Ensure continual quality improvement and program streamlining processes

Team Leadership

  • Serve as the direct supervisor for approximately 3-5 staff members

  • Oversee team workflows, procedures, and systems

  • Ensure collaboration and clear communication across teams

  • Provide professional development and performance management

  • Manage staff towards outcomes

  • Foster a collaborative, equity-centered team culture

The ideal candidate is a strategic, solutions-oriented leader who thrives in complex, cross-sector environments. They bring:

  • Knowledge of or experience with healthcare systems

  • Knowledge of or direct experience with produce prescription programs and other FIM interventions

  • Knowledge of or direct experience with clinical workflows and systems

  • Strong partnership management and contract negotiation skills

  • Experience with staff supervision

  • Ability to balance independent initiative and collaborative teamwork

  • Passion for the V4V mission and Food is Medicine model

This role offers a unique opportunity to drive large-scale systems change – improving health outcomes, increased food access, and helping thousands of low-income individuals manage their chronic disease through healthy food prescriptions.

Department Description:

Vouchers 4 Veggies – EatSF (V4V) is an innovative produce prescription and healthy food program, in operation since 2015, aimed at increasing access and affordability of healthy foods for low-income households, improving their health and food security. V4V not only provides people with crucial resources to purchase healthy food and improve their health but also helps address food deserts by supporting the ability of food vendors to stock fresh produce. V4V is an evidence-based program whose outcomes consistently demonstrate improved food security, diet quality, and increased access to healthy food. V4V operates in partnership with health systems and community-based organizations to reach thousands of low-income households and the program which has been nationally recognized as a model for improving food systems, is now being replicated in communities across the country.

V4V is a program of the Seligman Research Team at UCSF’s Action Research Center for Health, housed within the UCSF Division of General Internal Medicine at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital. The ARC carries out innovative research dedicated to improving the health and reducing disparities through discovery, innovation, policy, advocacy, and community partnerships.

The Seligman Research Team, led by Dr. Hilary Seligman, is committed to creating communities where healthy food is affordable and easily accessible by everyone. The team’s research focuses on policies and programs impacting the food environment and food affordability, leveraging Dr. Seligman’s roles as Director of the CDC’s Nutrition and Obesity Policy Research and Evaluation Network, Senior Medical Advisor for Feeding America, and partner to the Nutrition Incentive Hub. Since 2015 the team has operated Vouchers 4 Veggies, one of the nation’s largest produce prescription programs, utilizing its well-established infrastructure and proven outcomes to conduct policy-relevant research and provide technical expertise to help advance and grow the field of food is medicine through both research and practice. The Seligman Research Team has been at the forefront of documenting food and nutrition insecurity as major drivers of poor health and of implementing and evaluating programs and policies to address food insecurity as a mechanism to improve health.

description:

  • Ensure release planning addresses controls, resiliency, recoverability, performance, monitoring, operating procedures, training, support, and production stabilization

Financial & Commercial Accountability

Client & Market Engagement

title: Senior Project Manager, Data Center Delivery
description:
Job Type: Full-Time l Location: Childress, TX l Department: Data Center Delivery l Reporting to: Project Director | Work Location Type: #hybrid

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

Reporting to the Project Director, the Senior Project Manager owns one or more specific trades within a data center building – for example electrical (MV/LV distribution, generators, UPS), mechanical (chillers, CRAHs, piping), civil/structural, or controls – from front-end engineering and constructability through sourcing, contracting, construction, commissioning and handover. The Senior Project Manager is the single owner of schedule, cost, quality and coordination for those trades and gives day-to-day direction to the Project Manager supporting the building.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

Project start-up and front-end engineering
  • Manage front-end engineering for assigned trades, providing early assessment of constructability and site layout and coordination constraints.
  • Manage the contracting process for assigned trades, providing input into the commercial structure and technical scope of subcontracts and GC trade packages.
  • Support procurement and long-lead equipment identification, supplier assessment and capex planning in line with the building schedule.
  • Facilitate handover from the development team to the execution team for assigned trades.
  • Formulate trade-level project management plans and schedules addressing scope, work sequencing, HSE and quality outcomes, and develop the Work Breakdown Structure with project controls to establish budget-tracking processes.
Scope management
  • Ensure construction documentation for assigned trades is communicated and stored so that contractor scope and obligations under the contract are clear.
  • Lead design and constructability reviews for assigned trades through IFC, working with the design team so that coordination needs, lessons learned and construction improvements are incorporated into the design.
  • Own the RFI process for assigned trades and drive prompt resolution.
Program and schedule management
  • Develop and deliver the trade program of works within the building’s integrated master schedule, including resourcing and contractor strategies that maximize productivity.
  • Maintain look-ahead planning for scope, capex and long-lead equipment to meet the schedule.
  • Manage contractors to agreed schedules and key milestones; implement time-saving initiatives within appropriate risk tolerances.
  • Lead trade risk assessments and maintain the trade risk register; report to prescribed frequencies and requirements.
Cost management
  • Work with project controls to maintain and report trade cost plans, including forecasting of risks and contingency.
  • Monitor all trade costs against budget, advise early of cost impacts and communicate budget variances to the Project Director.
  • Manage change orders within delegated authority and drive change-order cycle time; maintain accurate records of resources used and work completed.
Quality and HSE
  • Establish measurable KPIs for subcontractors and suppliers on assigned trades.
  • Drive non-conformance close-out and defect rectification prior to completion, and manage defects within the defect liability period for each contractor.
  • Ensure all personnel, including subcontractors, under their management are inducted and trained in line with company requirements.
  • Comply with IREN’s Risk, QA and HSE management systems; drive for zero harm and act as a role model for a positive HSE culture on site.
Commissioning and handover
  • Own commissioning readiness for assigned trades, including vendor start-up, integrated systems testing participation and open-issue closure.
  • Ensure handover manuals and project documentation for assigned trades are complete, satisfactory and filed; support the project handover to Operations.
Communications and relationships
  • Run project control meetings for assigned trades with clear action items and deliverable dates for the project team, contractors and suppliers.
  • Provide concise, reliable trade status to the Project Director for consolidated reporting to senior leadership; escalate incidents, issues and concerns to the Project Director as required.
  • Take a professional leadership approach to contractor interactions; keep stakeholders informed and engaged; strengthen relationships with contractors, vendors, utilities and local government.
  • Collaborate closely with IREN construction managers, procurement managers and engineering teams with a team-first, project-first mentality.
Developing Project Managers
  • Give day-to-day direction to the Project Manager(s) supporting assigned trades, including performance feedback and an agreed trade development plan.
  • Identify gaps in project team resourcing and work with the Project Director to resolve workload allocation and staffing.
Continual improvement
  • Contribute to evaluations of project performance and recommend process improvements.
  • Facilitate lessons-learned workshops at building close-out and carry those lessons into the next building.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years of data center industry experience.
  • 5+ years of proven project management and people leadership on mid to large data center projects of similar complexity to IREN’s.
  • Qualifications in an engineering discipline, or demonstrable experience and technical knowledge in data center infrastructure.
  • Deep technical expertise in at least one trade (see preferred qualifications below).
  • Executive presence and reporting: proven ability to document and communicate project risks, schedule and budget clearly and consistently to senior leadership, in writing and in person.
  • Experience in a fast-paced growth environment and in solving complex problems with company-wide impact.
  • OSHA 30.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Suite (Project, Excel, Word, Outlook).
Preferred qualiification:
This role is filled by trade. Candidates should demonstrate deep, hands-on delivery expertise in at least one of the following trades on data center or mission-critical projects, including ownership of the subcontract or GC trade package from design coordination through commissioning:
  • Electrical: medium- and low-voltage distribution, switchgear, generators, UPS and battery systems, grounding, utility interconnect coordination and energization sequencing.
  • Mechanical: chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC units, hydronic and process piping, liquid cooling, HVAC and plumbing, including vendor start-up and balancing.
  • Civil/structural: site development, grading and drainage, foundations, structural steel and pre-engineered buildings, concrete, pavements and site utilities.
  • Controls and commissioning: BMS/EPMS integration, SCADA and controls, commissioning planning and execution through Level 5 integrated systems testing.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader total rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.
Compensation
  • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
  • Total Compensation package may be inclusive of short-term and long-term incentives.
  • Relocation (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)
Health & Wellness
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage – 100% company paid for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High-Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Financial Well-Being
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Financial wellness tools and resources
Time Off & Flexibility
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Growth & Development
  • Opportunities for advancement and internal mobility
  • Training and personal development opportunities
Lifestyle & Culture
  • Company events and team-building activities

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Join our Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) team within Enterprise Information Security as a Cybersecurity Analyst. In this role, you will monitor for relevant threats, collect and enrich intelligence from internal and external sources, perform technical analysis to understand adversary capabilities and behaviors when necessary, and translate findings into actionable intelligence for Threat Hunting, Application Security, Security Operations, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, and security leadership.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze emerging cyber threats, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), third-party incidents, and vulnerabilities relevant to the organization
  • Evaluate intelligence sources and distinguish reliable technical evidence from unverified reporting or low-confidence attribution
  • Perform technical analysis of malicious infrastructure, IP addresses, domains, URLs, certificates, and email artifacts using passive DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, and internet scanning data
  • Analyze malware and suspicious files using static/dynamic analysis techniques, sandbox environments, and reverse-engineering tools as appropriate
  • Produce clear technical intelligence reports, briefings, and profiles detailing adversary capabilities, confidence levels, and recommended defensive actions
  • Partner with Security Operations, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, and Vulnerability Management teams to enrich telemetry, develop hunting queries, and provide adversary context
  • Develop scripts and automation using Python or PowerShell to collect, normalize, enrich, correlate, and analyze threat intelligence data
  • Map observed attacker behaviors to industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain
  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate investigative tasks, and drive continuous improvement
  • Evaluate emerging technology trends to inform solution design, threat modeling, and strategic innovation

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required skills:

  • HS Diploma required
  • 3+ years of professional experience in cyber threat intelligence, threat hunting, incident response, security operations, malware analysis, or a related cybersecurity discipline
  • 2+ years of experience analyzing security telemetry across SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, DNS, proxy, or cloud security platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, CrowdStrike)
  • 2+ years of experience performing technical investigations of domain/IP infrastructure, certificates, or malware using tools such as VirusTotal, passive DNS, or WHOIS/RDAP
  • 1 year of demonstrated experience mapping adversary TTPs to framework models such as MITRE ATT&CK or the Cyber Kill Chain

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Intelligence Studies, or a related technical field
  • Experience working within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) or dedicated Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) function
  • Experience developing threat-informed detection rules or hunting analytics using search query languages such as KQL, SPL, or SQL
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., GCTI, GREM, GCFA, GCIA, CISSP, Security+, OSCP)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical threats to both technical practitioners and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience writing scripts (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for intelligence collection, analysis, or automation
  • Experience working with REST APIs and structured data formats (JSON, CSV, XML, or STIX/TAXII)

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 to $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

title: CU-Boulder Career Fair - Space Vehicle Engineering Internships
description:
As a Space Vehicle Electrical Engineering Intern, you will gain hands-on experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting the flight hardware that powers our next-generation satellites. Working alongside our Electrical Power Systems (EPS) and Command & Data Handling (C&DH) teams, you will help take hardware concepts from the laboratory bench all the way to orbital preparation. This role blends rigorous technical hardware development with fast-paced laboratory testing, PCBA debugging, and test automation.

This role will be fully on-site in our Greenwood Village, Colorado office for Summer 2027.

Responsibilities

PCBA Debug & Troubleshooting: Isolate hardware anomalies down to the component level on complex analog, digital, and power distribution circuits across both development benches and flight-ready hardware.
Satellite Subsystem Testing: Execute functional, parametric, and environmental testing on critical satellite subsystems and components.
Test Automation & Tooling: Write and modify Python scripts to automate hardware commanding and perform data collection.
Engineering Collaboration: Support EPS and C&DH engineers with schematic reviews, component selection, and laboratory test setups.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related STEM discipline.
Hands-on familiarity with core laboratory instruments (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and digital multimeters).
Basic exposure to hardware design/analysis tools (such as Altium Designer, KiCad, or LTspice) and programming in Python.
Proven experience designing, building, or modifying hardware through educational coursework, lab work, or personal projects.
Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident) due to industry-standard International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and export control protocols.
Ability and willingness to work full-time in-office at our Greenwood Village, CO location.
Ability to document and communicate complex ideas and collaborate with other technical teams as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Clear understanding of passive electronic components, power regulators, microcontrollers, and standard communication protocols (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART).
Active participation in hands-on, high-reliability technical project teams (e.g., CubeSat, Mars/Lunar Rover, Formula SAE Electric, or Solar Car).
Previous aerospace or electronics internship/co-op experience is a strong plus.

Based on your experience, you’ll be assigned to one of these teams.

title: Sr Software Engineer I
description:
American Express Platform Services builds and delivers enterprise platforms that enable business-critical applications to move faster from concept to production. Our mission is to accelerate time-to-market by providing modern, scalable, and reliable technology capabilities across American Express.

The Global Infrastructure Customer Experience team is responsible for delivering a world-class, enterprise-wide infrastructure portal that provides a seamless, unified experience for managing infrastructure services across American Express. We are focused on simplifying how teams discover, access, and manage infrastructure capabilities while delivering an exceptional customer experience through standardized, modern, cloud-native engineering practices.

We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high-performing, collaborative engineering environment and are passionate about building intuitive, high-quality user experiences. In this role, you will have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, influence engineering standards and best practices, and provide technical leadership and mentorship across internal infrastructure teams.

If you are passionate about modern engineering, exceptional customer experiences, and helping teams build and deliver technology more effectively, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at enterprise scale.

As a Senior Java Developer, you will design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native applications and services that automate and simplify the delivery of infrastructure capabilities across American Express. This is a full-stack engineering role with a strong emphasis on Java and cloud-native development, leveraging technologies such as Java, Node.js, REST APIs, React, Vert.x, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift.

You will play a key role in developing our enterprise infrastructure portal, creating a modern, intuitive experience that enables internal technology teams to discover, provision, integrate, and manage infrastructure services efficiently.

  • Design and develop cloud-native applications: Architect and build scalable, resilient, and highly available applications and services running on Kubernetes-based PaaS platforms, including Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Deliver full-stack capabilities: Develop end-to-end solutions across backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and modern web experiences, with a focus on Java-based services and React user interfaces.
  • Build distributed systems: Design and develop services supporting distributed computing capabilities such as caching, search, resource management, job execution, asynchronous processing, and cluster management.
  • Engineer for cloud-native environments: Apply cloud-native architecture principles, containerization patterns, Kubernetes capabilities, and platform engineering practices to build reliable and maintainable enterprise applications.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security: Design applications with multiple layers of authentication and authorization, integrating with enterprise identity platforms such as Okta and Active Directory while adhering to established security standards.
  • Drive observability and operational excellence: Implement logging, monitoring, and diagnostics using platforms such as Splunk and the ELK stack to rapidly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application and integration issues across distributed environments.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering: Use AI-enabled development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Devin to improve developer productivity, accelerate software delivery, and enhance code quality. Develop custom GPT-based solutions and engineering assistants that help other teams efficiently contribute code and integrate their infrastructure services with the platform.
  • Support Linux-based services: Design, deploy, and operate services on Linux virtual machines when workloads cannot be containerized, applying strong knowledge of Linux, virtualization, networking, and containerized environments.
  • Ensure resilience and disaster recovery: Own and continuously improve disaster recovery readiness for supported applications and services, including planning, coordination, documentation, and execution of annual disaster recovery testing.
  • Provide technical leadership: Influence architecture and engineering decisions, establish reusable patterns and development standards, conduct code and design reviews, and mentor engineers and contributing teams across the infrastructure organization.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, infrastructure, security, architecture, and engineering teams to translate customer needs into scalable technical solutions and continuously improve the infrastructure developer experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java and modern full-stack application development.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale applications in complex, highly available production environments.
  • Strong hands-on development experience with Java and Vert.x, along with working knowledge of Node.js, React, and modern web application frameworks.
  • Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, asynchronous programming, and their practical implementation across multiple programming languages.
  • Deep understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, including architectural patterns such as circuit breakers, service discovery, resiliency, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, and horizontally scalable services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices, particularly for infrastructure automation, integration, provisioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying cloud-native applications on Kubernetes-based platforms, with a strong understanding of containers, orchestration, scalability, resiliency, and modern cloud-native architecture principles.
  • Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD practices, including automated build, test, security, deployment, and release pipelines within enterprise development environments.
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted software engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Devin, and ChatGPT, with demonstrated ability to apply AI throughout the software development lifecycle to accelerate development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.
  • Experience working in Agile engineering environments, collaborating across product, architecture, infrastructure, security, and engineering teams to deliver capabilities iteratively and continuously.
  • Working knowledge of Linux operating systems, including system administration, troubleshooting, networking, process management, and operating applications across virtualized and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of application security and enterprise authentication/authorization patterns, including experience integrating applications with identity and access management solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex application, infrastructure, integration, and distributed-system issues.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship, influence engineering practices, conduct design and code reviews, and collaborate effectively with teams contributing to a shared enterprise platform.

title: Order Change Request Logger
description:
Order Change Request Logger

Customer Service · Order Support · Remote · Full-time or part-time
Pay: £29.50–£31.50 an hour

A customer asks to change an order. What happens next?

An order change may seem small to the person requesting it, but it can affect a payment, a delivery instruction or work already under way. The Order Change Request Logger makes sure the request is captured accurately and reaches the person who can decide what is possible.

You would read incoming online or email messages, link each request to the correct order and explain the next step using approved information. This is written customer service with a focused administrative purpose, carried out remotely.

The distinction between request received and change approved is central to this role. You may be authorised to record a request or correct a simple contact detail. You would not promise a revised item, price or delivery date before the responsible team confirms it. If a customer asks whether a change can still be made, you can acknowledge the question and pass along the order’s current status. A clear note allows the decision-maker to assess the request without making the customer repeat it.

What comes into your queue

Messages might ask to change a quantity, update a delivery instruction, correct a recipient name or cancel an item. Some contain an order number; others need one requested. You would identify the affected order and the precise change sought, compare the message with the existing record, and note any deadline or concern the customer mentioned. You would use the employer’s instructions to route payment, product and fulfilment questions appropriately. If a request is withdrawn or amended in a later message, the log must reflect the current request rather than leaving an older instruction as though it still applied.

This work can include a straightforward acknowledgement that tells the customer their request has been received and is being checked. That message should be honest about the stage. Once the relevant colleague responds, you may send an approved update or record that the decision has been communicated. You should not transform a colleague’s tentative internal note into a final commitment. The useful work product is a traceable request with the correct order, current status and clear communication.

A useful handoff contains three things:

  • The existing order reference and the detail the customer wants changed.
  • The customer’s own timing concern, if they raised one.
  • The current state of the request, including any answer already given.

That keeps the decision with the colleague authorised to make it while reducing the need to ask the customer to repeat the request.

Practical actions include:

  • Finding an order by its supplied reference and checking the customer details before linking a message.
  • Separating several requested changes in one email so none is lost.
  • Recording the exact item or delivery instruction the customer wants altered.
  • Noting whether the request is awaiting information, awaiting review or already resolved.
  • Asking for a missing order reference or clarification when necessary.
  • Directing a pricing, payment or fulfilment decision to the responsible colleague.
  • Sending an approved acknowledgement without implying the change is guaranteed.
  • Updating the log when a later message changes the customer’s instruction.
  • Checking that the final response matches the decision recorded by the team.

You will work with an online order system, a message queue and a simple record of actions. The employer will teach the systems and where your authority ends. Previous order processing or office administration experience would be helpful but is not required. Newcomers can learn the workflow if they are comfortable reading closely, recording a request in plain language and asking a sensible follow-up question. Work in retail, hospitality or another customer-facing setting can be transferable.

A calm tone matters when someone is disappointed that a change may no longer be possible. You can be helpful without making a promise that belongs to another team. The position also calls for reliable time management: pending messages should remain visible while decisions are sought. A suitable home office area may make it easier to focus on the difference between the original order and the requested revision.

Hours and compensation

The role is remote, with a full-time or part-time arrangement possible. Pay is £29.50–£31.50 per hour. The hiring company will explain its specific order-change procedure and working pattern during selection.

Application process

Please identify any experience where you recorded a customer’s request, checked a reference or handed a question to another team. Experience from a different sector is relevant if it shows careful communication. Applicants without a formal office title are welcome and will learn the employer’s process.

If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. The initial CV is a chance to show the kind of follow-through you bring to routine requests.

title: Senior Hybrid Cloud Operations Engineer (Houston)
description:
This role is based in Houston, TX and requires working onsite 2 days per week.

The Senior Hybrid Cloud Operations Engineer independently delivers complex infrastructure and operational work across enterprise data center, on-premises, virtualized, private-cloud, and public-cloud environments. This position combines advanced hands-on infrastructure expertise with automation and production operations and is expected to proactively identify work, take ownership from planning through completion, and resolve complex technical issues without routinely requiring escalation to more senior resources.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently identify, plan, prioritize, and deliver infrastructure work from analysis through implementation, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.
Administer and troubleshoot complex Linux and Windows systems, physical infrastructure, enterprise servers, virtualization, storage, networking, backup/recovery, clustering, and data center technologies.
Design, develop, maintain, and review production automation using Ansible, Terraform, Bash, Python, Git, APIs, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
Independently support VMware, OpenStack, Hyper-V, KVM, AWS, or comparable private/public-cloud and virtualization platforms.
Troubleshoot complex networking, DNS, routing, firewall, load-balancing, TLS, storage, Fibre Channel, SAN/NAS, backup, database, container, web, file-transfer, and messaging issues.
Independently support and improve monitoring, alerting, security, vulnerability remediation, patching, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and infrastructure lifecycle processes.
Evaluate dependencies, risks, testing requirements, security implications, change plans, validation procedures, and rollback strategies before implementing production changes.
Identify manual processes, technical debt, recurring incidents, and operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable automation and engineering improvements.
Review infrastructure and automation changes made by other engineers for reliability, security, maintainability, and operational impact.
Lead technical diagnosis and recovery for complex production incidents and drive appropriate root-cause and preventive actions.
Provide technical guidance to Engineers and assist with technical escalations.
Develop and improve runbooks, architecture documentation, standards, monitoring, and operational practices.

NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead technical portions of infrastructure migrations, upgrades, hardware refreshes, proofs of concept, and modernization initiatives.
Assist with technology evaluations, capacity planning, lifecycle planning, and solution design.
Facilitate knowledge sharing and development of reusable engineering practices.
Perform other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Ability to independently own complex infrastructure work from initial analysis through successful production delivery.
Strong production expertise across Linux, Windows, networking, virtualization, storage, backup/recovery, cloud, security, and infrastructure automation.
Strong ability to design, troubleshoot, modify, test, and safely deploy Ansible and Terraform automation.
Ability to determine appropriate boundaries among Terraform, Ansible, scripting, APIs, and operational processes.
Ability to understand unfamiliar repositories, systems, dependencies, and infrastructure with limited direction.
Ability to convert manual operational processes into tested, reusable, production-safe automation.
Ability to identify technical risks, dependencies, failure scenarios, validation requirements, and rollback strategies.
Ability to review technical work performed by others and provide effective guidance.
Strong incident-response, root-cause-analysis, documentation, communication, and escalation judgment.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE, AND/OR EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including demonstrated experience independently delivering and supporting complex production infrastructure.
Equivalent combinations of relevant education, technical training, certifications, and demonstrated professional experience may be considered.
Advanced production experience with Linux, Windows, Ansible, Terraform, networking, Git, and scripting.
Demonstrated experience independently identifying, planning, and delivering complex infrastructure changes and resolving production issues without routinely requiring escalation.
Experience across enterprise data center, virtualized, private-cloud, public-cloud, and hybrid-cloud infrastructure.
Experience with physical server infrastructure and Dell, HPE, or comparable enterprise server technologies.
Experience with VMware, OpenStack, Hyper-V, KVM, or comparable platforms and public-cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Backup Exec, Barracuda, or comparable enterprise backup technologies.
Strong knowledge of SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, and technologies such as Pure Storage, HPE Nimble, Synology, Brocade, or comparable platforms.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, NAT, MTU, firewalls, load balancing, TLS, and network troubleshooting.
Knowledge of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patching, certificates, encryption, secrets management, and privileged access management.
Working knowledge of HAProxy, Apache/Nginx, FTP/SFTP, Postfix/SMTP, MySQL/MariaDB, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, DNS/BIND, Windows Server Failover Clustering, SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances, or comparable technologies.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Must provide after-hours support and participate in on-call or critical escalation activities as appropriate to the position and operational needs.Travel of up to 10% may be required, depending on employee location and business needs, including travel to data centers, offices, or other company locations for infrastructure support, installations, maintenance, incident response, and other operational activities. Travel may occasionally occur outside normal business hours.Must appropriately handle privileged credentials, production data, and sensitive infrastructure information.Must maintain appropriate security, change-management, documentation, source-control, and infrastructure engineering standards.Must communicate technical risks, decisions, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

title: Streetcar Operator
description:
Streetcar Operator OKC

Salary $23.57 hourly

Job Summary

A Streetcar Operator is responsible for operating a streetcar on a 4.6-mile route safely and efficiently within city limits, ensuring passengers' comfort, safety, and adherence to operational schedules. The route will include 22 stops linking major employers, businesses, attractions, and residences in the downtown area. The operator must possess operating skills, knowledge of traffic laws, and demonstrate professionalism while interacting with passengers. Operators provide operation of the battery/overhead wire-powered streetcar in mixed use traffic typically in the Downtown area. This position plays a critical role in providing public transportation services and contributing to the community's mobility.

Duties And responsibilities:

*This is a non-exhaustive overview of the job duties for this position.

  • This position is responsible for the operation of the streetcar in a safe and efficient manner within established rules, schedules, regulations, procedures and providing professional and courteous customer service.

  • Reports for duty at the Streetcar Maintenance Facility or any other designated location along the system in the prescribed uniform with a neat and well-groomed appearance.

  • New hires should expect to work late nights, weekends and holidays exclusively as seniority dictates.

  • Maybe required to work on an “on-call” basis.

  • New hires must successfully complete provided training programs for operating rules, track access, standard operating procedures, safety, vehicle operations, minor-troubleshooting and basic customer service.

  • May work with maintenance of manufacturers to provide movement of the Streetcars within the yard and shop area and on the mainline or mainline extension(s) for vehicle testing and operations training.

  • Act as incident commander as needed until relieved.

  • Informs Dispatchers or Route Supervisors of operating status of equipment and any observed defects.

  • Perform pre-departure inspection in accordance with established procedures for streetcar preparation for service and reports to supervisory staff all operational hazards.

  • Observes and immediately report reports to supervisory staff all operational hazards.

  • Observes and reports any defects along the alignment.

  • Receives and transmits messages through handheld or Streetcar onboard messaging system.

  • Prepares trip reports and defect reports upon completion of duty.

  • Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • High School diploma or Ged.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license and with a good driving record for the past 5 years.

  • Ability to read, write and communicate proficiently in English.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Streetcar Operation certification

  • Preference: Previous Rail Transit Operator and/or Public Transit Operator experience.

Pre- Employment Requirements

  • Subject to pre-employment background check and motor vehicle report review.

  • No criminal record within the last 7 years

  • Less than 2 points on your driving record, and no infractions in the past 12 months

  • Must have a valid driver license

  • Subject to pre-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen due to the safety sensitive nature of this position.

  • Successfully complete and maintain any required safety certification and testing on an annual basis.

  • Must be 21 years of age or older

  • Must have a high school diploma or GED

  • Must have a valid DOT medical card

Any major moving violations, previous convictions or pending misdemeanor or felony charges for distribution of illegal substances, violent crimes or lewd acts are reviewed by management for approval.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described below must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this role. This position will be physically demanding at times. This is a non-exhaustive overview of the physical requirements of this job.

  • Able to walk on uneven surfaces up to one-half mile.
  • Maintain balance for an extended period while train is in motion.
  • Must be able to be aware of surroundings and follow verbal commands while being exposed to moderately loud noises on a daily basis.
  • Must be able to work in a confined access/space environment with a width of 24 inches.
  • Must be able to adapt to various temperature extremes including but not limited to heat, cold, moisture and wind.
  • Regularly sit and stand for an extended period of time.
  • Regularly push/pull up to 25 pounds.
  • Regularly ascend and descend a platform with a height of up to 18 inches from the floor.
  • Able to tolerate repetitive movements: bending and overhead reaching.
  • Must successfully pass color/vision examinations as required by the position.
  • Must be able to hear and distinguish auditory signals as required by the position.
  • Must be able to work in a safety sensitive work environment.

Working Conditions

  • Occasionally working in a confined access/space environment with a width of 24 inches.
  • Inside and outside regularly, and exposed to heat, cold, humidity, and rain.
  • The possibility of falls from working on and around slippery surfaces.
  • Possibility of body injuries such as sprains, fractures, deep cuts, or loss of body members.
  • Possibility of injury to the body caused by burns or electrical shock.
  • Will work near moving machinery and power tools.
  • Exposed to intermittent or continued loud noises caused by machinery and other workers.
  • Occasionally exposed to infections caused by microorganisms.
  • Will work eight to 10 hour shifts and may be required to work holidays and overtime.

Evaluation Criteria

Interpersonal Relations: Employees work closely with customers, community members, security staff and supervisors. Frequently working with radio communications with other staff and supervisors. Occasionally talk with Techs and other staff to determine what problems may be experiencing with equipment or vehicle.

Supervision Given and Received: Receives route details and detailed oral instructions from a Route Supervisor/Dispatch and/or supervisor(s). Work is continually reviewed by supervisor.

Other Duties and Responsibilities
This is a summary of the duties and responsibilities commonly found within this classification. It is not meant to be all-inclusive; thus, other related activities or tasks may be assigned.

title: CNC Programmer (25/hr + PTO/Benefits)
description:
Solve Industrial Motion Group strives to be the trusted source for engineered bearings and power transmission solutions. Supported by a diverse range of products within Solve’s brand portfolio and our unmatched technical expertise, we have over 100,000 ready-to-ship components. At Solve we innovate with ambition, offering custom solutions in a wide range of applications. We obsess over our customers, leveraging our nationwide network for industry leading product availability, and best-in-class customer service. Our engaged team leads with integrity, and unites with purpose, driving toward innovation and continuous improvement every day.

POSITION DESCRIPTION: Reporting to the Production Manager, the CNC Programmer is responsible for the programming, set-up, operation and troubleshooting of Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines using FANUC controls and G and M codes. This ideal candidate will lean into their high attention to detail to produce precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, quality standards and production schedules while supporting requirements for accuracy, timeliness, and thoroughness. The CNC Programmer will work collaboratively, communicating across all organizational levels to meet production deadlines and produce high-quality products for our customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operate multiple machines as required, monitor equipment performance, measure and record required dimensions and production data

  • Interpret blueprints, machining instructions, and engineered drawings to determine machining methods and ensure components meet specified requirements

  • Identify, obtain, or recommend cutting tools and fixtures needed to achieve specified dimensions and tolerances

  • Secure workpieces in fixtures, presses, or machine mounts and position gaging equipment to support consistent, repeatable production

  • Set and adjust feed rates, rotational speeds, and machine settings for CNC Swiss Mill operations, using appropriate hand tools as needed

  • Inspect and validate machined components against specifications using micrometers, gauges, inspection fixtures, and an involute checker when available; record required dimensional data

  • Calculate machining dimensions using shop mathematics to maintain part accuracy and repeatability

  • Machine plastic and other nonmetallic materials when required, following applicable departmental procedures and production specifications

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proficiency in CNC machine programming, setup, and operation using FANUC controls and G and M codes

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, machining instructions, and machine operating requirements

  • Knowledge of indexable tooling, boring tools, gauges, and inspection fixtures

  • Strong mathematical skills to calculate finished dimensions

  • Ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, work collaboratively, and meet production deadlines or promptly communicate schedule risks.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with custom or production machining involving different materials, products, and component sizes.

  • Experience with Haas-Robo Drill, Tsugami Swiss Mill, or comparable CNC machines.

OUR EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION:

  • Market competitive benefits package, including company-sponsored health coverage, life insurance, 401(k) plan with company match, paid parental leave and paid time off

  • Work in a collaborative environment with passionate and innovative teammates

title: Driller
description:
PDS DRILLER — LEAD WITH SAFETY, GROW WITH STABILITY
Safety, Stability & Financial Security: For over 135 years, Boart Longyear has helped people build safe, stable careers with the opportunity to support their families and plan for secure futures.
You’ve mastered the rig. Now choose the employer that matches your standards. Join the team that runs reliable equipment, provides opportunities for growth, and sets a clear ladder from Lead Driller ➞ Field Supervisor ➞ Leadership — without forcing you behind a desk 24/7. Boart Longyear achieves drilling excellence by prioritizing our people. Reliable schedules, strong safety standards, and benefits designed for families — so you can focus on what matters most.

Why this Role Fits You:

  • Predictable Home Time – 14–20 days on / 7–10 days off, with a regular cadence so your family calendar stays intact.
  • Lead & Mentor – Run a crew of 2–3 assistants, teach safe habits, and earn bonuses tied to performance, safety, and zero‑incident shifts.
  • Performance Pay – Bonus structure rewards completed jobs, extra effort, and spotless safety record.
  • If you’re a hands‑on leader who keeps rigs turning and crews safe, Boart Longyear will invest in your continued growth.

Responsibilities:
The following is a general list of duties and responsibilities that may be adjusted from time to time by your supervisor.

Safety is PARAMOUNT in our business. You must follow all established policies, procedures and best practices as well as the law at all times.
Operate the drill and lead a small crew while supporting all site operations: make/break connections (add/remove rods); handle rods/tools and perform manual material handling; haul supplies to/from the drill site; mix drilling fluids; collect, label, and organize samples and build chip trays; assist with rig-up/rig-down and site moves; fuel equipment and perform basic operator/PM service (greasing, oil changes, housekeeping); complete pre-start, daily site, and rig inspections; maintain accurate parts/supplies inventory; perform basic measurements/calculations; provide site inductions to visitors; and maintain/document the condition and service life of equipment and tooling.
Prepare daily reports of all drilling activities. Some examples of these reports are: reflect footage drilled, time spent performing other activities besides drilling, timekeeping for payroll purposes and reporting supplies consumed
Participate in weekly safety and daily line out meetings.
May be required to operate non-drilling equipment such as light or heavy vehicles, cranes, tele handlers, forklift, skidders, track-mounted utility vehicles, etc.
Monitor a safe workplace, maintain workplace safety and apply risk management processes for elimination of work-related injuries, damage to equipment and incident-related lost time.
Maintain accurate operating records, including daily drill reports and inventory logs.
Contribute to and establish effective workplace relationships.
Provide training through instruction and demonstration of work skills, coaching and mentoring to other field employees.
As an employee you must perform all your duties in a safe manner, taking care of the equipment and co-workers that you work with.
You will be responsible for the general condition and obtaining optimum life out of all site equipment and tools.
You may be responsible for the training of new Driller Assistants in a safe environment.
Be physically fit for work.
Work under the instructions of a driller/drilling field supervisor or division manager. Daily routine work is accomplished with more or less direction depending on the level of competency.
Work safely and follow EHS policies and procedures and conduct local risk control.
Have the ability to apply first aid.

Minimum Qualifications:

2-3 year of consistent experience as a Driller or Driller Assistant in Drilling, Mining, or adjacent/related industry.
Previous experience in related positions such as: construction laborer, heavy laborer, mechanic, and mechanical work.
Excellent in communicating with clients and supervisor and be able to work positively with others
Must have a complete knowledge of mechanics as related to drill rigs, diesel, hydraulics, electrical
Ability to personally handle heavy wrenches, lift and/or carry heavy tools or supplies and operate levers with both hands
Willing to travel by plane or car to worksites throughout Nevada, Utah, Arizona, Idaho and other states where we do business.
Able to commute long distances for shifts (300+ miles)
Willing to work in remote locations and in all-weather elements
Willing to work at job sites for an extended period of time, 12+ hour shifts for 14-20 days at a time
Must have a valid U.S. Driver’s License and capable of acquiring CDL.
Must have valid U.S. Work Authorization
Must pass background and drug screening
Must pass a Physical Functional Fitness Evaluation
High School diploma or GED or equivalent

Compensation, Benefits and Perks:
Boart Longyear matches your expertise with earning power and family support:

Strong Day Rate + Overtime – First‑year total comp typically $95k‑$125k with overtime & bonuses.
Medical, Dental, Vision – Full family coverage options from Day 1 of first full month of employment.
401(k) Match & Financial Coaching – Plan for long‑term security.
Travel on Us, Per Diem in Your Pocket — Focus on the work, not the logistics: airfare covered and a steady per diem.
Gear & Allowances – Company‑funded PPE, boot allowance, and work attire.
BRAVO Recognition – Cash and swag awards for safety milestones and innovation.

Company Overview:
About Boart Longyear Since 1890, Boart Longyear has led the way in drilling services, orebody knowledge technology, and productivity-driven equipment for mining and exploration. We support projects across copper, gold, nickel, zinc, uranium, and more—with additional work in energy, oil sands, and environmental sectors.

What You’ll Be Part Of:

Global Drilling Services:At Boart Longyear Drilling Services, you’ll join a world-leading provider of contract drilling solutions with a legacy of safe and reliable performance since 1890. Our Drilling Services division delivers a full range of drilling capabilities — including mineral exploration, water services, production drilling, reverse circulation, sonic, surface and underground coring — for a diverse global customer base spanning copper, gold, nickel, zinc, uranium and other critical commodities. We are recognized for innovative solutions, technical expertise, and operational excellence in some of the most challenging environments worldwide, backed by deep investment in safety, people, and equipment.

Our People & Values:Great ideas come from diverse teams. We foster an inclusive, respectful environment where everyone is heard. Our vision: lead the industry in safety, innovation, and productivity. Our values: Integrity, Health & Safety, Teamwork & Diversity, Customer Focus, and Sustainability. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. Learn more at boartlongyear.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and Twitter(X). Interested? Apply now at https://careers.boartlongyear.com/. Boart Longyear is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We appreciate all applicants from all backgrounds; only those selected for interview will be contacted.

Key Success Indicators/Attributes

  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Demonstrate ability to work in all work types and specialties.

  • Demonstrate ability to self-motivate, set goals, and meet deadlines.

  • Demonstrate leadership, mentoring, and interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrate excellent presentation, verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to develop and maintain relationships with key business partners by building personal credibility and trust.

title: Vil du arbejde med Danmarks kystudfordringer?
description:
Vi søger en projektleder, der vil drive komplekse projekter og trives i både interne og eksterne samarbejdsrelationer.

Danmarks kyster er under forandring. Stormfloder, erosion og stigende vandstande stiller nye krav til, hvordan vi beskytter kysterne – både nu og i fremtiden.

Hos os kommer du tæt på de konkrete problemstillinger. Du får mulighed for at lede tekniske projekter og være med fra de første undersøgelser og beregninger til de løsninger, der skal kunne fungere i praksis.

Du kommer tæt på de konkrete udfordringer
Arbejdet tager udgangspunkt i konkrete kyststrækninger og udfordringer. Hvor er der risiko for erosion eller oversvømmelse? Hvordan fungerer den eksisterende beskyttelse? Og hvad kan gøres bedre?

Som teknisk projektleder får du ansvar for at drive projekter, koordinere de forskellige faglige bidrag og sikre, at resultaterne kan bruges videre.

Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med kommuner, rådgivere og andre samarbejdspartnere. Det handler både om at indsamle viden, lave analyser og beregninger og om at få de forskellige fagligheder til at spille sammen.

Arbejdet foregår både ved skrivebordet, i mødelokalet og ude på kysten.

Du vil blandt andet komme til at:

  • Være teknisk projektleder på konkrete projekter
  • Planlægge og koordinere opgaver og faglige bidrag
  • Følge op på fremdrift og kvalitet
  • Undersøge konkrete kyststrækninger og problemstillinger
  • Udvikle og kvalificere mulige løsninger
  • Udarbejde skitser og beslutningsgrundlag
  • Samarbejde med kommuner, rådgivere og andre interessenter

Der vil også være møder og besigtigelser, hvor de tekniske vurderinger skal holdes op mod de faktiske forhold.

Du skal kunne få mennesker og fagligheder til at mødes
Vi forestiller os, at du har en ingeniøruddannelse eller anden relevant naturvidenskabelig kandidatuddannelse og har projektledererfaring.

Projektledelse hos os handler ikke kun om tidsplaner og møder. Det handler også om at kunne lytte, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og gøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige for andre.

Du skal derfor kunne skabe fremdrift i projekterne og samtidig have blik for de mennesker og fagligheder, der er omkring dem.

Vi lægger blandt andet vægt på, at du:

  • Kan skabe struktur og holde retning i et projekt
  • Kommunikerer klart – både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Trives med samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder
  • Kan tale med kommuner, rådgivere, myndigheder og andre samarbejdspartnere
  • Både kan skabe gode relationer og holde fast i den faglige retning
  • Tager ansvar for, at projekter kommer i mål

Det er herudover en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med noget af følgende:

  • Projektering og dimensionering af kystbeskyttelseskonstruktioner eller vandbygning
  • Vind, vandstande og bølger
  • Geoteknik og fundering
  • Vurdering af eksisterende konstruktioner
  • Indsamling og behandling af data

Vi er flere forskellige fagligheder i teamet, og vi lægger vægt på, at du har et solidt fagligt udgangspunkt, er nysgerrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

Du får 26 kolleger med forskellige blik på kysten
Kystteknik er en del af Område for Kyster og Klimatilpasning. Vi er 26 medarbejdere fordelt på Lemvig og Odense med forskellige faglige baggrunde – blandt andet ingeniører, geografer, geologer, oceanografer og fysikere.

Det giver et miljø, hvor der er gode muligheder for faglig sparring, og hvor vi ofte ser på den samme problemstilling ud fra forskellige perspektiver. Det er en styrke, når opgaven er at finde løsninger på komplekse kystudfordringer.

Vi har høje faglige ambitioner, men lægger også vægt på en hverdag, hvor der er plads til en kop kaffe, et grin og en snak med kollegerne.

Vi arbejder med noget, der bliver vigtigere
Kystbeskyttelse handler om mere end diger, bølger og beregninger. Det handler også om, hvor og hvordan vi skal beskytte Danmark, og om at finde løsninger, der både kan fungere teknisk og give mening for de mennesker og samfund, der skal leve med dem.

Du får mulighed for at arbejde med konkrete projekter sammen med kommuner og andre aktører. Samtidig arbejder vi med udvikling af viden og modeller, blandt andet i internationale samarbejder, som kan give os et bedre billede af risikoen ved stormfloder.

Det er en opgave, der kommer til at fylde mere i de kommende år – og hvor der er brug for stærke fagligheder.

Et fleksibelt arbejdsliv
Vi har fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra, når opgaverne egner sig til det. Der vil være møder og besigtigelser forskellige steder i landet, så du skal være indstillet på lidt rejseaktivitet. Der er mulighed for arbejdssted i enten Odense eller Lemvig.

Har du lyst til at arbejde med konkrete kystudfordringer og være med til at finde løsninger, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Læs mere om Miljøstyrelsen og vores arbejde her:

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademiker-organisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademiker-overenskomsten). Ansættelsen kan være som special- eller chefkonsulent afhængigt af dine kompetencer.

Ansættelsesområdet er Miljøministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Dit tjenestested vil være enten Højbovej 1, 7620 Lemvig eller Lerchesgade 35, 5000 Odense C.

Stillingen er på fuld tid.

Forventet startdato er den 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du vil vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef for Kystteknik Thorsten Piontkowitz på tlf. +45 21 70 10 92 eller teamleder Laura Storm Henriksen på tlf. +45 91 33 84 21.

Sådan søger du stillingen
Du søger stillingen online ved at sende din ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis m.m. senest d. 5. november 2026. Vi planlægger at holde samtaler i uge 46.

Du vil forud for en evt. samtale blive bedt om at forberede en case, der tager cirka 1-2 timer at løse. Case-opgaven sendes til dig forud for samtale, og du returnerer din besvarelse inden samtalen. Case-opgaven drøftes ved samtalen.

title: Director - Cryptographic Architecture & Engineering
description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success.
