title: Invoice Copy Delivery Assistant
description:
Invoice Copy Delivery Assistant

Customer Service | Billing Documents | Remote
Full-time or part-time · £24.25–£26.25 per hour

Find the right invoice. Send it to the right person.

The Invoice Copy Delivery Assistant handles a narrow but useful customer service task: requests for copies of invoices that have already been issued. A customer might need a document for their records, have lost the original message or be unable to open the file they received. You would locate the correct invoice through the employer’s online system, check the requester’s approved contact details and send or arrange access to the existing document. The work is remote, written and administrative.

There is a clear boundary. You would not create a new invoice, revise the amount, decide a dispute or send account information to an unverified third party. If a customer says the document itself is wrong, that issue belongs with the billing team. Your part is to identify the invoice in question, make sure the permitted recipient can obtain a copy and record what happened. When there is no confident match, you ask for a reference or pass the issue along rather than sending a similar-looking document.

Why this is more than pressing resend

One customer may have several invoices in a month. Two accounts may share a similar name. A request may refer to an order number rather than an invoice number. Before you release a file, you would compare the available references, date and recipient information against the request. You would use the employer’s verification procedure where needed. A customer who cannot open an attachment may need the approved access route explained, but you should not move a document to a personal file-sharing account to solve the problem.

The result should be easy for the customer to understand. A concise reply identifies which invoice was supplied and, if relevant, how to access it. If the document cannot yet be located, explain the particular detail needed to continue. Colleagues should be able to see whether a copy was sent, whether a customer response is awaited or whether billing has taken over the question. Keeping that record is a basic part of office administration.

For a straightforward request, you would identify the supplied invoice or order reference, find the existing issued document and compare its date with the customer’s description. You would confirm the approved recipient before releasing the file or link. Once a copy has been sent through the authorised channel, record the action in the account note.

A request needs more care when several documents could fit or the recipient is unclear. You would ask for the specific detail needed to proceed, while questions about a charge or correction go to the billing colleague. These steps keep the original request and the eventual response traceable without asking you to make an accounting decision.

This job is suitable for someone who can carry out a repeatable check without treating every request as identical. You may find a clear invoice in seconds; another request may need a careful clarification. The important habit is to separate the two, because an incorrect document can expose information or create a new problem for the customer. The employer will teach the system, the approved recipient checks and the handoff process.

Prior office administrative or billing-document experience is helpful but not necessary. We welcome applicants with little formal experience who can use a computer, compare references and write a straightforward email. A person who has kept digital records or helped someone locate a document elsewhere may already have useful skills. You are not expected to know accounting terminology or calculate invoices. The work is about retrieval, recipient care and a clear response.

This remote opening can be arranged for full-time or part-time hours. A quiet home office area helps with careful handling of account information, which should remain within the company’s approved systems. You will work independently on ordinary copy requests and ask a colleague about an unclear account or recipient. Pay is £24.25–£26.25 per hour.

Applying for the role

In your application, make any experience finding records, checking a recipient or answering a document request visible. Transferable tasks from study or another industry count; a billing title is not required. The team will teach its specific process and welcomes newcomers. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. That next stage, if used, forms part of the hiring company’s recruitment process.

title: CU-Boulder Career Fair – Software Engineering Internships
description:
York is looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineering Intern who wants to build software that interacts with real spacecraft hardware.
This is not a traditional web-development internship. You’ll work alongside Flight Software and Spacecraft Integration & Test engineers to develop, debug, and test software used to command, monitor, and validate space vehicles. Your work may touch embedded Linux systems, spacecraft interfaces, automated test infrastructure, hardware-in-the-loop environments, networking, telemetry, and the tools engineers use to prove a vehicle is ready for flight.
You’ll get exposure to the full engineering loop: write code, run it against real or simulated spacecraft hardware, break things safely, debug what happened, improve the software, and run it again.
The ideal candidate enjoys figuring out how things work, isn’t afraid of a Linux terminal, likes both software and hardware, and gets excited when their code causes something in the physical world to happen.

Why this internship is different?
You won’t spend the summer making buttons slightly more rounded.
You’ll work on problems like:
Why did this process crash? Why did that packet disappear? Why isn’t this device responding? What happens if we restart this service? Did the spacecraft produce the telemetry we expected? Can we automate this test? Can we make this failure happen again?
And then you’ll help build the software that answers those questions.

Responsibilities

Develop and test software used to support spacecraft flight software, vehicle integration, and automated testing
Write Python, C/C++, Bash, or other software that interacts with embedded systems and spacecraft hardware
Develop software and interfaces running in embedded Linux environments
Build tools that command, monitor, configure, and validate spacecraft subsystems
Participate in Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) development and testing
Connect software to real hardware interfaces, networks, telemetry streams, and subsystem simulators
Troubleshoot problems across software, operating systems, networks, and hardware
Debug failures using logs, telemetry, command-line tools, debuggers, and test equipment
Develop automated tests that exercise spacecraft functionality and verify expected behavior
Support York’s test-like-you-fly philosophy by helping make test environments behave more like the real vehicle
Write and execute unit tests and integration tests
Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews
Work with systems, software, electrical, and test engineers to turn high-level requirements into working solutions
Identify technical risks early and help develop practical solutions
Use Git, GitLab, CI/CD, and modern software-development workflows
Communicate what worked, what failed, what you learned, and what you want to try next
Willingness to work full-time in our Greenwood Village
Love space!

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing software for embedded systems
Experience with C or C++ on Linux
Experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, robotics, drones, automotive systems, or similar hardware
Experience debugging software that communicates with physical devices
Familiarity with serial, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, CAN, SPI, I2C, or similar interfaces
Experience with multithreading, inter-process communication, or pub/sub messaging
Experience with Software-in-the-Loop or Hardware-in-the-Loop testing
Experience with automated system-level testing
Familiarity with telemetry, command-and-control systems, or distributed systems
Experience with GitLab CI/CD or other automated build/test systems
Experience with CMake or other C/C++ build systems
Familiarity with Docker or containerized development environments
Experience with debuggers, packet captures, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, or other debugging tools
Experience with spacecraft, aerospace, robotics, or other safety- or mission-critical systems
Personal projects where you built something that moves, communicates, senses, controls, or interacts with hardware
Familiarity with Python or scripting languages
Interest in spacecraft, aerospace, or safety-critical systems
Experience working in lab or system integration environments
Active Secret Clearance

Based on your experience, you’ll be assigned to one of these teams.

title: Senior Associate-Digital Product Management
description:
Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) helps drive profitable business growth by reducing credit and fraud risk while maintaining customers' confidence in the security of American Express products. The Digital Risk Products & Data Strategy organization builds digital software products that support risk decisions across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, authorizations and servicing.

The Senior Associate, Digital Product Management will serve as a Product Analyst supporting the Product Owner in the execution of fraud risk assessment and authentication capabilities. The role will work day-to-day with Engineering, Fraud Risk, Product, Data/Analytics and other partners to convert business and risk needs into well-defined, testable software requirements and to help move work from discovery through development, testing, launch and post-production monitoring.

This role is execution-oriented. It requires strong product analysis, requirements management, Agile delivery and technical collaboration skills, with enough understanding of authentication and fraud-risk concepts to connect business intent to engineering implementation. Exposure to emerging AI- or agent-enabled commerce is helpful but is not the primary focus of the role.

  • Support the Product Manager in executing the product roadmap and prioritized backlog for fraud risk assessment and authentication capabilities.

  • Partner with the Product Owner, business stakeholders and Engineering to clarify scope, decompose capabilities into epics/features/stories, document dependencies and define clear acceptance criteria and Definition of Done expectations.

  • Create and maintain functional requirements, process flows, data mappings, business rules, interface requirements, decision tables, error/exception scenarios and other artifacts needed for engineering execution.

  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, demos and retrospectives; surface blockers, requirement gaps, risks and cross-team dependencies early.

  • Serve as a day-to-day requirements contact for engineers and testers, answer questions promptly, facilitate decisions with the Product Owner and stakeholders, and maintain traceability from business need through delivered functionality.

  • Support prioritization by providing analysis of customer impact, fraud/risk impact, delivery complexity, dependencies, defects and operational needs; prepare options and tradeoffs for Product Owner decisions.

  • Partner with Fraud Risk and analytics teams to translate fraud strategies, risk signals and decisioning needs into consumable product and technology requirements without prescribing model design.

  • Support authentication capabilities across relevant customer journeys, including enrollment/setup, authentication events, risk-based or step-up authentication, exception handling, recovery and servicing.

  • Work with Engineering and Architecture to understand APIs, request/response fields, events, identifiers, data contracts, integration dependencies, logging/telemetry and non-functional requirements for real-time risk and authentication services.

  • Develop test scenarios and support functional, integration and user acceptance testing; validate that delivered functionality meets acceptance criteria and help triage defects with Engineering and business partners.

  • Support release readiness and implementation activities, including dependency tracking, test evidence, documentation, controls, operational readiness, production validation and post-launch issue management.

  • Analyze product metrics, defects, production incidents, fraud outcomes and customer/servicing feedback to identify gaps and translate findings into backlog items and product/process improvements.

  • Maintain clear product documentation and status reporting in tools such as JIRA and Confluence, including decisions, requirements, risks, issues, dependencies and action items.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify product processes, improve requirement quality, reduce rework and strengthen collaboration between Product, Risk and Engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in digital product development, product analysis, business analysis, risk technology, payments, authentication, fraud technology or a related field.

  • Experience gathering/documenting requirements and supporting software delivery through development, testing and launch.

  • Ability to drive project deliverables, work effectively in cross-functional teams and operate independently on sophisticated or unstructured initiatives.

  • Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Customer-centered mindset and ability to partner with business and technology teams.

  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and iterative product development.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint; exposure to Java, Python, SAS, Hive, low-code/rule-authoring tools or similar technologies is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Product Owner or Product Manager and working directly with software engineering and QA teams.

  • Exposure to card payments, authorizations, e-commerce, digital identity, payment authentication, fraud prevention, account security or real-time risk decisioning.

  • Experience with APIs, data mapping, process modeling, rule-authoring platforms, prototyping, testing or production monitoring.

  • Familiarity with risk-based authentication, device or behavioral signals, identity federation, credentials/tokens or related authentication concepts.

  • Exposure to AI-enabled commerce or machine-to-machine interactions is helpful but not required.

  • Master's degree in a technical, quantitative, business or related field is a plus.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

title: Senior / Principal Power Systems Engineer
description:
Reporting to the Director of Power Systems Modeling, you will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transmission planning and generation interconnection. This is a high-impact technical role where your deep understanding of power systems will not only drive complex study work but also serve as the "blueprint" for our software development team. You are the bridge between traditional electrical engineering and modern digital transformation. You are also expected to contribute towards the successful completion of a range of consulting projects focused on power system planning studies involving Steady-State, Short Circuit, Transient Stability, Generator and Renewables Interconnections, Large Loads and Data Centers, Electromagnetic Transients (EMT), Model Quality Tests (MQT) and benchmarking, Power System Economics, Market Analysis, and Grid Resilience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute Complex Power System Studies: Lead and perform advanced transmission planning and generation interconnection studies (System Impact, Feasibility, and Deliverability) across multiple North American markets (WECC, PJM, MISO, ERCOT, SPP, SERC, etc.).
  • Technical Authority on Interconnection: Act as the lead expert for both large-scale generation (including IBR) and large-load interconnection requests, navigating the specific tariff and reliability requirements of various RTOs/ISOs.
  • Product Strategy & SME Support: Collaborate directly with our software engineers to translate complex engineering workflows into automated tools. You will define the logic, "teach" the software team the engineering nuances, and validate the output of our internal automation frameworks.
  • Advanced Modeling: Build, tune, and validate high-quality power system models for steady-state, short circuit, transient stability, and EMT analyses using industry-standard tools.
  • Automation Mindset: While we have dedicated software developers, you will be expected to use Python and SQL to automate your own workflows and prototype new ideas that can be scaled into production-level software.
  • Support Business Growth: Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and implement strategies for expanding our consulting services, including identifying emerging needs and new market opportunities and service offerings.
  • Engage with Stakeholders: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including utilities, RTOs, project developers, and regulatory bodies, to advocate for and advance Simple Thread’s projects.
  • Innovate and Improve: Lead the development of innovative methodologies and tools that enhance power systems analysis and streamline processes for both internal and client use.
  • Mentor and Lead: Guide and instruct team members using a strong technical understanding of generation (including IBR), transmission, interconnection, customer and load, and modeling principles.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all study work and automated processes adhere strictly to NERC and regional reliability standards.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with a focus on Power Systems; a Master’s or PhD degree is highly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in transmission planning, interconnection studies, EMT analyses likely gained within a utility, RTO, or specialized consulting firm.
  • Market Versatility: Proven track record of navigating the study processes and TARA/PSSE/PSCAD modules for multiple regions (e.g. ERCOT MQT, PJM GD, MISO RIST, CAISO GD, etc.).
  • Tool Proficiency: Expert-level command of PSSE, TARA, PSLF, PSCAD, EMTP, and PowerWorld.
  • Coding Literacy: Proficiency in Python is required for workflow automation. While you don't need to be a full-stack developer, you must be comfortable reading/writing scripts and eager to work in a software-centric environment.
  • Load & Generation Expertise: Deep knowledge of both traditional generation and the unique challenges of Inverter-Based Resources (IBR) and large industrial load and data centers integration.
  • Communication: The ability to distill highly technical engineering concepts into clear requirements for software developers and actionable insights for clients.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with PowerGEM TARA’s automation API.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with EM/ES interferences, grounding (GPR, step & touch) analysis using CDEGS,
  • Familiarity with arc flash analysis using ETAP

Join Us:

Simple Thread offers an opportunity to be at the forefront of technological innovation in the energy industry. We are looking for someone who shares our passion for making a difference and is ready to tackle the challenges of integrating software solutions with energy systems. If you’re passionate about power systems, driven by growth, and eager to make an impact, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

A Great Team – Our team is the best part of working here. We only hire people who are fantastic teammates – competent and smart, sure, but also humble, positive, and generous.

Great Clients – We work with mostly small and medium clients, for whom our projects make a huge impact. We prioritize clients who are pleasant and good to work with, people who share our values of transparency and empathy.

Work From Home – We are a distributed company. Everyone works from home.

Flexible Work Schedule – We require a certain amount of overlap with the rest of the team, but if you have a predictable schedule, we can probably support it, e.g., ending at 3:30 every day or being out every Friday morning.

Good Work Life Balance (really) – We ask our team to work 40 hours a week*. That’s all: a good, productive 40 hours. And then we try our best to leave you alone off the clock. We do this in part because that’s how we want to live but also because we want our team to be recharged and ready to do their best when working. *If you need to work fewer than 40 hours, that might be possible too; let’s talk.

Competitive Compensation – We offer highly competitive salary and benefits, including generous time off, pension plan (401k or RRSP), FSA, medical and dental insurance, support for continuous growth and professional development. We hire remotely and adjust compensation to meet individual needs, but the standard salary range for this role is $145,000 to $225,000, varying highly with individual experience and strengths.

Simple Thread values diversity in all of its forms, and we hire the best person we can for each role, no matter your personal background. Research tells us that applicants who are female or non-binary, as well as applicants who are people of color, are less likely to apply for roles they do not feel 100% qualified for. If you think you meet more than 50% of our requirements but fewer than 100% of them, please apply. We’re imperfect communicators, so think of our job postings as the starting point for discussion rather than proof that you shouldn’t apply.

title: QC Specialist
description:
Quality Control Specialist
Therma | Boise, ID | Onsite

About the Role
Therma, a Legence company, is expanding our presence in the Boise market, and we’re looking for a Quality Control Specialist to help ensure the quality of our mechanical systems from fabrication through field installation and project turnover.
This is a hands-on role for someone who takes pride in getting the details right. You’ll work closely with our fabrication, field, project, and BIM/VDC teams to inspect work, verify materials and documentation, identify potential quality issues, and help make sure our HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical systems meet project specifications and quality standards.
If you have a strong eye for detail, experience around mechanical fabrication and welding, and enjoy working alongside project teams to solve problems before they impact the job, this is a great opportunity to join Therma as we continue to grow in Boise.

What You’ll Do

Perform quality inspections of fabricated and installed mechanical systems, including HVAC, plumbing, piping, and related equipment
Inspect incoming materials and equipment for damage, defects, and compliance with project requirements
Perform dimensional and orientation checks against spool drawings, fabrication drawings, and project specifications
Inspect weld quality and verify fabricated spools meet applicable quality requirements
Conduct shop and field walkdowns, system verification, and planned inspections and testing throughout fabrication, installation, startup, and turnover
Verify that fabricated spools are properly identified, documented, protected, staged, and ready for shipment
Maintain accurate quality documentation, including inspection logs, test reports, RFIs, submittals, redlines/as-builts, weld logs, and related records
Help maintain material and component traceability from fabrication through field installation
Identify and document nonconforming work and assist with root cause analysis, corrective actions, and timely resolution
Support preparation of QA/QC documentation and project turnover packages
Coordinate closely with Fabrication, Field, Project Management, and BIM/VDC teams to address quality issues and maintain project schedules
Support inspections and audits involving customers, general contractors, vendors, third-party inspectors, and authorities having jurisdiction
Apply relevant project codes, standards, specifications, and established quality procedures
Provide regular quality updates and reports to appropriate project and quality leadership

Qualifications
Required

2+ years of relevant quality control, weld inspection, mechanical fabrication, or construction experience
Experience with visual examination of welds, brazed or bonded joints, and fabricated materials
Working knowledge of welding and fabrication processes, drawings, weld symbols, and related documentation
Ability to perform dimensional and orientation verification using fabrication or spool drawings
Familiarity with visual examination tools such as fillet weld gauges, V-WAC gauges, or similar inspection tools
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify and document quality issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work effectively with fabrication, field, project, and technical teams
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
Ability to work in both fabrication shop and active construction environments as needed

Preferred

AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) or ASNT VT Level II certification
Experience with mechanical HVAC, plumbing, piping, or process/utility systems
Familiarity with applicable codes and standards such as IMC, IPC, SMACNA, AWS, and ASME
Experience with QA/QC turnover documentation, material traceability, NCRs, and corrective action processes
Experience working with BIM/VDC and fabrication teams in a mechanical construction environment

title: Technical Program Manager, GPU System Engineering
description:
Oracle Hardware Division is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer and Technical Program Manager to lead GPU and CPU server platform development and implementation in collaboration with external manufacturers and NVIDIA and AMD engineering teams.

This role combines hardware systems engineering expertise with technical program management responsibilities, supporting complex server hardware products from development through validation and production delivery.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply GPU and CPU system engineering expertise to hardware integration, validation, and production readiness.
  • Lead assigned hardware development programs, coordinating engineering requirements, schedules, technical dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Oracle hardware, software, and cloud engineering teams, GPU and CPU suppliers, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Drive cross-functional engineering execution through technical credibility, collaboration, and influence.
  • Work autonomously on moderately complex assignments, leading projects and processes that contribute to team and organizational goals.

Hardware Engineering & System Integration

  • Own assigned GPU system development plans from engineering requirements through qualification and production readiness.
  • Evaluate hardware and software integration across GPU and CPU platforms, including firmware, drivers, and baseboard management controllers (BMC).
  • Apply hardware systems engineering knowledge to identify technical dependencies, integration challenges, and potential risks.
  • Work with NVIDIA, AMD, external manufacturers, and Oracle engineering teams to investigate technical issues using vendor validation tools, engineering logs, and test results.
  • Coordinate internal and external testing to ensure hardware products are validated against agreed requirements before customer release.
  • Review validation results, document readiness evidence, and drive resolution of quality and delivery issues.

Technical Program Management & Execution

  • Lead assigned hardware development programs, coordinating requirements, schedules, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across engineering teams and external partners.
  • Translate internal customer needs into engineering requirements and actionable program plans.
  • Align supplier priorities, engineering schedules, and development activities with product delivery objectives.
  • Coordinate hardware development through engineering validation, design validation, production validation, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Track program execution against schedules, technical milestones, quality requirements, and budget constraints.
  • Anticipate and mitigate technical and program risks, manage changes through established review processes, and escalate issues beyond delegated authority.
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs and alternative approaches, considering quality, schedule, and cost implications.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with Oracle hardware, software, and cloud engineering teams, GPU and CPU suppliers, and joint design manufacturers to coordinate engineering activities.
  • Build relationships across lines of business and with external partners and leadership.
  • Communicate technical trade-offs, program risks, progress, milestones, and next steps to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Provide evidence-based recommendations to support management decisions affecting assigned products and programs.
  • Prepare technical reports, program updates, and executive briefings, including senior leadership and SVP reviews when required.
  • Drive alignment and issue resolution across engineering teams and external partners without direct reporting authority.

Engineering Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead cross-functional engineering and program activities through technical credibility, collaboration, and influence.
  • Apply independent judgment to resolve moderately complex hardware systems and program challenges involving multiple variables and potential outcomes.
  • Identify and implement improvements in hardware validation, system integration, and technical program execution.
  • Seek diverse viewpoints, mentor junior colleagues, and provide task oversight to improve team capability and execution.
  • Coordinate vendors, contractors, and temporary staff as required.
  • Contribute to functional and business goals within and, when needed, beyond the immediate team.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, with relevant education and experience.
  • Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in hardware engineering, systems engineering, technical program management, or related disciplines, assessed with applicable education.
  • Advanced knowledge of hardware engineering duties, systems, and procedures, with broad knowledge of GPU or CPU system engineering.
  • Practical experience taking hardware systems through development, integration, validation, and production readiness.
  • Experience integrating hardware and software, applying vendor validation tools, interpreting engineering logs, and working with external manufacturers.
  • Experience coordinating technical programs, engineering schedules, cross-functional dependencies, and product development milestones.
  • Strong understanding of GPU and CPU system integration, including firmware, drivers, and BMC functionality.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical issues, identify risks, and drive engineering and program decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, evidence-based problem-solving abilities, and effective collaboration without direct authority.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements and delivery conditions through disciplined review, escalation, and follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical knowledge of NVIDIA and AMD GPU and CPU platforms and architectures.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional hardware development programs involving internal engineering teams, suppliers, and external manufacturers.
  • Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI), including engineering validation, design validation, production validation, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Experience managing engineering requirements, schedules, dependencies, quality, risk, and budget considerations across multiple organizations.
  • Experience preparing technical reports, program updates, and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects, mentor colleagues, and improve hardware validation, integration, and program execution processes.

description:

Job Description

About the role:
The Process Technology & Innovation Lead PAT is responsible for defining and driving Takeda’s global Process Analytical Technology (PAT) strategy, including Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) and Advanced Process Control (APC). This role leads the development and deployment of innovative analytical and digital manufacturing technologies to strengthen process understanding, product quality and operational performance. Working across Global MSAT, Manufacturing, Quality and Digital functions, the role ensures scalable, compliant and value-driven implementation of PAT solutions across Takeda’s manufacturing network.

How you will contribute:

  • Define and execute the global PAT technology and innovation strategy, establishing a multi-year roadmap aligned with Global MSAT, GSQ and enterprise priorities.
  • Establish harmonized PAT standards, governance frameworks and technology architectures to enable consistent adoption of analytical technologies, real-time monitoring and advanced control strategies across manufacturing sites.
  • Lead and optimize a global PAT innovation portfolio covering advanced analytical technologies, process modeling, automation, digital twins, data platforms and AI-enabled process intelligence, ensuring effective investment prioritization and measurable value creation.
  • Identify, evaluate and industrialize emerging PAT technologies, including spectroscopy (NIR, Raman, UV and mass spectrometry), sensing technologies, chemometrics and multivariate data analysis, from proof of concept through full-scale deployment.
  • Drive the implementation of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) and Advanced Process Control (APC) solutions in partnership with MSAT, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Development, Manufacturing, Quality and Regulatory teams.
  • Collaborate with DD&T and Engineering to establish scalable, secure and GMP-compliant digital infrastructure, data integration capabilities and analytical platforms supporting PAT deployment and advanced process intelligence.
  • Ensure robust validation, data integrity, model governance, regulatory compliance and lifecycle management of PAT solutions, incorporating GAMP 5 principles and appropriate change control processes.
  • Develop strategic partnerships with technology providers, analytical instrument suppliers, academia and industry consortia to accelerate innovation, strengthen technical capabilities and support technology lifecycle management.
  • Define and monitor performance indicators to demonstrate improvements in product quality, manufacturing robustness, yield, productivity, release cycle times and supply reliability, while developing organizational PAT capabilities and fostering a culture of scientific innovation.

What you bring to Takeda:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Analytical Chemistry, Chemical or Process Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemometrics, Data Science, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Approximately 10 or more years of experience in Process Analytical Technology, process analytics, process control, automation or manufacturing technology within the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated environment.
  • Strong technical expertise in PAT instrumentation and sensing technologies, including NIR, Raman, UV, mass spectrometry, chemometrics, multivariate data analysis and process modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing PAT, advanced process control, soft sensors, automation or Real-Time Release Testing solutions within validated manufacturing environments.
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional technology innovation or digital manufacturing programs, delivering measurable improvements in quality, yield, operational efficiency and manufacturing performance.
  • Solid understanding of GMP requirements, computerized system validation, GAMP 5, data integrity, Quality by Design (QbD) and continuous improvement methodologies such as DMAIC, Kaizen and GEMBA.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to manage technology portfolios, develop investment cases, prioritize resources and demonstrate business value.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and collaborating across complex, global and matrixed organizations.
  • Fluency in English, combined with strong analytical thinking, an innovative mindset and the ability to translate complex scientific and technological concepts into practical manufacturing solutions.

title: Facilities Technician

Facilities Technician

title: Order Confirmation Details Assistant
description:
Order Confirmation Details Assistant

Office Administration | Order Confirmations | Remote
Full-time or part-time | £27.75–£29.75 per hour

The purpose of an order confirmation is simple: the customer should be able to see what the organisation has actually recorded. In this online role, you would prepare or check routine confirmation details after an order has reached the appropriate stage. Your work is to catch a mismatch between the order record and the outbound message, use the approved wording and keep a record of what was sent.

It is remote office administration with a practical customer service outcome.

An inaccurate confirmation can create a second enquiry even when the underlying order is fine. You might find that the quantity in a draft message differs from the saved order, that a recipient name was entered incorrectly or that the confirmation uses an outdated reference. You would correct what falls within your instructions and refer any change to price, product or delivery commitment to the appropriate colleague. The position is about faithful communication of existing information, not renegotiating an order.

A confirmation worth keeping

You would start with the current order record, not a previous email that might be out of date. Check the reference, item description, quantity and recipient details the employer asks you to verify. If a system produces the confirmation automatically, you may review exceptions or messages held for checking rather than typing every line. If the record is inconsistent, do not send the confirmation just to clear the queue. Note the discrepancy and direct it for review.

After a message goes out, the order record should show that it was sent through the appropriate channel. A customer may then reply with a correction or a question. You would log that response and route any new request to the right order support process. A confirmation is not proof of delivery and should not be described as such. These distinctions will be covered in the team’s training, along with the online tools used to view orders and outbound messages.

The routine responsibilities

You would review orders that are ready for a confirmation check and compare the outbound message with the current record. A missing reference, wrong recipient or mismatched item detail should be corrected if your instructions permit it. You would not change an order decision while editing a confirmation. A price or fulfilment discrepancy goes to the colleague who can resolve it before the message is sent.

Once the approved confirmation has been released through the designated system, you would record the action so another person can find the outbound message. If the customer later asks to correct the order, you would direct that new request into the change process rather than quietly treating the original confirmation as though it had never been sent.

This role has a clear finish line for each item. The confirmation accurately represents the recorded order, reaches the intended recipient and can be located later if someone asks about it. You may work through a set of items independently, but you should be willing to pause when a field does not make sense. Care with detail is more important than pretending to know why a discrepancy occurred. The team will show you which details require checking and which are generated by its system.

You do not need a previous order-administration job. Applicants with little experience are welcome if they can compare two sources, read a short instruction and send a professional written message. Retail receipts, event bookings, administrative coursework or another setting may have taught similar habits. Related office administration or customer service experience is useful but optional. A named software package is not a prerequisite; basic computer confidence is.

Because the position is remote, a dependable home office setup can support focused checking of records and recipients. You will use online systems rather than paper files. The schedule may be full-time or part-time, depending on the opening. The hourly rate is £27.75–£29.75.

Taking the next step

A concise CV showing careful checking, order support or clear written communication is useful for this position. If your experience comes from study or voluntary work, make the relevant task visible rather than worrying about the title you held. The employer will teach the specific confirmation process. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. That stage allows the company to gather any details it needs for its own recruitment process.

The Senior Clerk of Governance (SENIOR CLERK) supports governance operations for the Provisional Council of the Métis Nation of Ontario (PCMNO), the Executive Committee, the Finance and Audit Committee (FAC), and the MNO Cultural Commission (MNOCC). The SENIOR CLERK also ensures that branches and implementation leads provide timely updates to motion minute reports (MMRs) for the PCMNO, MNO Annual General Assemblies (AGA), and other key governance committees as required.
The SENIOR CLERK oversees the MNO record matrix and collaborates with the PCMNO, Provincial Secretaries, senior leadership, and branches to ensure that actions and updates are properly recorded. The SENIOR CLERK works with the Chair, Vice-Chair, and C-Suite to develop a PCMNO meeting and workshop schedule, establish clear timelines, and follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure meeting materials are provided on time, speakers are secured, and post-meeting follow-up is completed.
What You Will Be Doing:
Governance Operations & Committee Support

Lead governance operations supporting PCMNO, Executive Committee, FAC, MNOCC, AGA, and other governance bodies as assigned.
Work closely with the Chair, Secretary Treasurer, senior leadership and MNO legal counsel where required to advance the PCMNO agenda and meeting schedules
Develop and maintain annual governance calendars, meeting schedules, and critical timelines in collaboration with leadership.
Develop and maintain a Standard Operating Procedures manual for PCMNO meeting operations and orientations
Oversee meeting coordination, including agendas, materials, logistics, presenters, technology, and post-meeting follow-up.
Attend meetings as required to provide governance and procedural support.
Prepare and distribute meeting books and materials through BoardEffect or other approved systems.

Governance Records, Reporting & Compliance

Ensure resolutions, action items, and directives are accurately tracked and reported to completion.
Oversee Motion Minute Reports (MMRs), governance tracking tools, and regular status reporting.
Maintain, organize and coordinate governance records, records systems, repositories, record matrices, access controls, and confidentiality safeguards.
Support the development, implementation and ongoing improvement of document and records management systems and processes
Ensure records management practices align with organizational policy, applicable legislation, and governance best practices.

Leadership & Team Oversight

Manage recruitment, onboarding, training, performance, attendance, and employee development for direct reports.
Establish team priorities, service standards, and quality expectations to ensure effective delivery of governance support services.

Strategic Support

Provide advice and recommendations to leadership on governance processes, procedural risks, meeting effectiveness, and operational improvements.
Identify issues, missed deadlines, or process gaps and recommend practical solutions.
Develop and maintain governance SOPs, templates, and internal processes to improve consistency and efficiency.
Research and prepare briefing notes, reports, presentations, and other materials for leadership decision-making.

Stakeholder Support & Organizational Values

title: Business Intelligence Competency Center (BICC) Quality Analyst

  • Proficiency with computer systems and applications
  • Obtain and maintain forklift certification

ADESA Values

ADESA Benefits and Perks

Competitive Pay | Quality Benefits | Holiday and Paid Time Off | Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs | Matching 401(k) | Career Path Opportunities | And More!

Other Requirements

To be able to do your job at ADESA, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

This position is subject to both inside and outside environmental working conditions, including temperature changes, outside weather conditions, slightly elevated ambient noise levels, and minor atmospheric conditions affecting skin or respiratory systems, such as fumes, odors, and dust associated with internal and external service station/convenience food and petroleum dispensing operations.

title: Senior Orthopaedics Tech - Ortho Center - Full Time - 8hr Days
description:
Create an Impact Every Single Day at Cedars-Sinai!

When your daily work significantly affects others’ lives, each effort, detail, and moment counts. This culture of passion and dedication thrives at Cedars-Sinai. By collaborating with leading healthcare experts and assisting patients with complex orthopaedic needs, you’ll have the chance to create a meaningful impact for patients and their families.

About the Orthopaedic Clinic

The Orthopaedic Center is an outpatient clinical care facility offering comprehensive services for patients with orthopaedic and musculoskeletal conditions throughout their lives. Our multidisciplinary team collaborates closely to deliver diagnostic and therapeutic care while assisting patients during their entire continuum of care.

Our mission is to restore quality and function to life through compassionate care, innovation, and education, with a vision to be the global leader in Orthopaedics.

What Sets You Apart

Successful candidates will bring strong hands-on orthopaedic technical skills along with a dedication to patient safety and high-quality care. You are proactive, dependable, diligent, and able to anticipate the needs of patients and providers in a busy outpatient environment.

You communicate clearly, remain composed when patient volume is high, and work effectively across fields. You understand that excellent orthopaedic care involves not only technical expertise, but also compassionate patient education, teamwork, infection prevention, and attention to the overall patient experience.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a Senior Orthopaedic Tech, you will carry out various direct patient care tasks for patients with musculoskeletal conditions, guided by a licensed caregiver. You will collaborate closely with orthopaedic surgeons, registered nurses, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, medical assistants, clinical partners, residents, fellows, medical students, and other care team members.

  • Assist physicians with casting procedures, including casting with and without reductions and skeletal traction.
  • Apply, cut, trim, adjust, and remove casts as ordered by the physician.
  • Apply and remove splints and assist with braces, suspension devices, skin traction, and other orthopaedic devices.
  • Perform suture removal and change wound dressings as required by the role.
  • Support durable medical equipment (DME) application for the finger, hand, wrist, upper extremity, and lower extremity.
  • Assess patients with orthopaedic devices for accurate fit, positioning, pressure symptoms, and neurovascular status.
  • Educate patients on injury care, device use and maintenance, and crutch use.
  • Provide crutch training when needed.
  • Maintain orthopaedic equipment and supplies and facilitate accurate usage tracking.
  • Lead skills training for medical and surgical residents in splinting, bracing, casting, and traction application.
  • Partner with members of the multidisciplinary care team to find solutions, manage care, and ensure safe, efficient patient outcomes.
  • Provide compassionate, culturally responsive care to patients from a diverse set of backgrounds and across age groups.
  • High school diploma or GED, or equivalent experience.
  • Orthopaedic Technician certification (OTC)
  • Demonstrated proficiency in essential orthopaedic procedures, including cast and splint application and removal, wound dressing changes, suture removal, and DME application.
  • Two (2) years of Orthopaedic Technician experience in a similar outpatient orthopaedic environment.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Cloud Infrastructure team develops the tooling, services, and deployment workflows used to build and support NetSuite’s infrastructure in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). We turn infrastructure requirements and operational processes into reliable, repeatable, and testable automation.

In this role, you will independently deliver components of our infrastructure tooling and collaborate on broader technical designs. You will integrate with cloud services and improve how infrastructure is provisioned, updated, maintained, and supported across regions. You will work with engineering and operations teams to understand their requirements, reduce manual work, and make infrastructure easier to deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain.

This role does not include an on-call rotation.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience developing, testing, and maintaining software in at least one programming language, such as Python or Java.

  • Practical experience with infrastructure as code, including reviewing proposed changes, managing dependencies and state, and diagnosing deployment failures.

  • Experience provisioning or managing infrastructure in a cloud environment, with an understanding of compute, networking, storage, and identity and access controls.

  • Experience integrating with APIs and handling failures in services or automation that depend on external systems.

  • Experience with source control, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery workflows.

  • Ability to troubleshoot problems across Linux, networking, storage, cloud APIs, and application code using logs, metrics, and other evidence.

  • Ability to independently deliver a defined component or feature, work through ambiguous requirements, and seek input or escalate when complexity or risk warrants it.

  • Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with engineering or operations teams to understand requirements and support adoption.

  • Ability to write maintainable code and evaluate technical choices against reliability, security, and operational needs.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure; experience with other major cloud platforms is also relevant.

  • Experience developing reusable Terraform or OpenTofu modules and infrastructure deployment workflows.

  • Experience building internal tooling, APIs, or self-service capabilities used by other engineering teams.

  • Experience with distributed infrastructure automation across regions, including concurrency, long-running operations, and recovery from partial failures.

  • Experience applying least-privilege access, secure credential handling, and auditability to infrastructure tooling.

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain software, APIs, and automation for provisioning, configuring, and managing cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop reusable infrastructure-as-code components and workflows that produce consistent, reviewable changes across environments.

  • Integrate with cloud APIs and internal services, handling authentication, asynchronous operations, retries, and partial failures.

  • Build validation and delivery pipelines that support controlled infrastructure changes, maintenance, and recovery when changes fail.

  • Add monitoring, logging, and diagnostic capabilities to make infrastructure tooling reliable and supportable.

  • Investigate failures in automation and the infrastructure it manages; implement improvements that prevent recurring problems.

  • Translate requirements from engineering and operations teams into technical designs and usable tooling; communicate tradeoffs, progress, and risks.

  • Participate in code reviews and maintain documentation, runbooks, and examples that help other teams use the tooling.

title: Research Director - Remote

What You'll Do

Lead projects end-to-end

  • Work closely with junior Research Executives, guiding their execution, output quality, and professional development.

Deliver rigorous quantitative research

  • Manage Quant AI (BoltQ) projects end-to-end: questionnaire design, logic setup, automated analysis, and report storytelling.

  • Ensure all quant outputs are accurate, clearly structured, and meet client expectations for rigour and insight depth.

Craft strong research narratives

  • Produce output decks that combine analytical clarity with compelling storytelling — findings that clients can act on, not just read.

  • Translate complex quantitative outputs into clear strategic implications for non-technical audiences.

  • Quality-assure AI-generated outputs and ensure all deliverables meet Bolt Insight's standards.

Drive innovation and process improvement

  • Contribute to the development of BoltChatAI and BoltQ by gathering client feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to enhance AI-driven research capabilities.

  • Develop and refine internal workflows to improve research efficiency and quality across the team.

Develop the team

  • Mentor and train junior researchers in both traditional and AI-assisted methodologies.

  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and professional growth within the research team.

  • Provide input on team expansion and recruitment where needed.

What We're Looking For

Strong quantitative foundation — You've independently delivered complex quant projects — MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, segmentation — and you're comfortable with SPSS and advanced Excel. This isn't a nice to have; it's the core of the role.

End-to-end project ownership — You take full responsibility for delivery, from brief to debrief, and you don't need to be chased to keep things moving.

Client-facing confidence — You're comfortable leading client calls and building relationships. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and know when to push back constructively.

Storytelling through data — You can turn a MaxDiff output or a regression model into a clear, compelling narrative that actually influences decisions.

AI research curiosity — You're open to — ideally already experienced with — AI-powered research tools. You understand their value and their limits.

Team player and mentor — You enjoy bringing junior colleagues on, sharing what you know, and building team capability over time.

A note on quantitative depth

We'll explore your quant experience directly in the interview process — not to catch you out, but because it matters for this role. We're looking for someone who has genuinely delivered advanced techniques (MaxDiff, conjoint, segmentation) independently, not just observed them. If there are areas where you'd benefit from development, be upfront — we invest in our people and we'd rather know where we can help than find gaps later.

Why Work for Bolt Insight?

At Bolt Insight, we’re a vibrant and growing start-up mentality business with a passionate team that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Remote working and the flexibility to work in a nomadic way – Enjoy the best of both worlds, balancing work and life your way.

  • Flexible working environment – We trust you to manage your time and work in a way that suits you best.

  • Private Medical Insurance - Your health and well-being are important to us, and we’ve got you covered.

  • Business referral bonus – If you know someone who’s a great fit for the team, we’ll reward you for it!

  • Employee referral bonus – You get the chance to shape our team and be rewarded for bringing great people onboard.

  • Virtual or local team gatherings – Whether online or in person, we love to connect and celebrate our successes together.

  • In-house recognition awards – We celebrate our ‘lightning bolts’ (those who go above and beyond) and show our appreciation for hard work!

  • Annual Bonus System – If the company meets its targets, you’ll receive a bonus payment of up to two months’ salary! We win together.

At Bolt, curiosity, creativity and passion matter most. If you’re excited about shaping the future of research and contributing to a culture built on innovation and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Bolt Insight is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, diverse and professional workplace for all. We strive to create a welcoming environment where all individuals, no matter their background or identity, feel valued and supported.

If you have specific requirements throughout the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our HR team who will make the appropriate adjustments.

Apply today and join a dynamic, international team driving innovation across borders!

title: Project Manager
description:
Priority may be given to the following designated employment equity groups: women, Indigenous Peoples* (First Nations, Inuit and Métis), persons with disabilities and racialized persons*.

* The Employment Equity Act, which is under review, uses the terminology Aboriginal peoples and visible minorities.

Work arrangements:

At the NRC, we recognize that Indigenous candidates may have important connections to their communities and you may be eligible for an exception to this work arrangement. Alternative work arrangements may also be considered to accommodate candidates as required. To learn more about these options, please contact the NRC Hiring team using the contact information below.

The role

We are looking for a Project Manager who would report directly to the Director of Special Initiatives/ Executive Advisor to the Vice President of Digital Technologies (DT) to implement and maintain efficient project management for portfolio projects and initiatives. The ideal candidate would be someone who shares our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Respect and Creativity. The Project Manager will be working collaboratively with research teams across DT, NRC employees from various research centres, branches and IRAP, and external stakeholders. The Project Manager will operate at a strategic, cross-functional intersection bridging the gap between cutting-edge scientific research and technology innovation, executive leadership support, ecosystem partners (from industry, academia and government), and corporate strategy.

The role consists of the following key responsibilities aligned with the priorities of the NRC and DT as both a division and a research centre:

  • Executive leadership support: For example, draft briefing notes, presentations, reports and other materials for submission to executive committees (such as, the NRC’s Senior Executive Committee, the Finance, Resource and Programs Committee, and DT Management); and provide secretariat support for the DT Advisory Board meetings twice a year, and monitor all follow-up actions from the meeting minutes to ensure on time completion.
  • Ecosystem partners: For example, organize visits to the DT research centre, partner meetings and events (such as collaborative research and funding workshops); and research upcoming networking/ funding opportunities for dissemination to DT researchers (such as, Horizon Europe, the Killam NRC Paul Corkum Fellowship and Office of Facilities Renewal Management funding calls for proposals).
  • Corporate strategy: For example, contribute to the development of new initiatives for the organization under the mandate of the Chief Digital Research Officer (such as, AI literacy and AI Governance).

Screening criteria

Applicants must demonstrate within the content of their application that they meet the following screening criteria in order to be given further consideration as candidates:

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or science is required. A bachelor’s degree in another discipline with a combination of work experience relevant to the position may be considered.

Formal designation as a Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) from the Project Management Institute (PMI) would be considered an asset.

For information on certificates and diplomas issued abroad, please see Degree equivalency

Experience

  • Significant experience in supporting the management of projects involving multi-disciplinary teams and multi-partner resources.
  • Significant experience in developing and managing effective working relationships between multiple stakeholders including organizations external to NRC.
  • Experience meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Condition of employment

Language requirements

Bilingual Imperative CBC/CBC

Information on language requirements and self-assessment tests

Assessment criteria

Candidates will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:

  • Knowledge of performance measurement and/or evaluation frameworks, principles and techniques which includes data gathering, analysis, preparation and presentation of reports.
  • Ability to work with a broad range of stakeholders.

View all competency profiles

This position is classified as a Research Council Officer (RCO), a group that is unique to the NRC. Candidates are remunerated based on their expertise, outcomes and impacts of their previous work experience relative to the requirements of the level. The salary scale for this group is vast, from $64,739 to $183,010 per annum, which permits for employees of all levels from new graduates to world renowned experts to be fairly compensated for their contributions.

As such, the initial salary could be within another level of the RO/RCO salary scale (i.e. above or below the intended level for this position).

In addition, the incumbent will receive the Bilingualism Bonus of $800 per year.

NRC employees enjoy a wide-range of competitive benefits including a robust pension plan, comprehensive health and dental coverage, disability and life insurance, office closure at the end of December, and additional supports to enhance your well-being throughout your career and beyond.

Discover the possible

Anything is possible at the NRC, named in 2026 one of Canada’s Top Employers for Young People, Top Employer in the National Capital Region and Forbes Canada’s Best Employers!

As Canada’s largest research and innovation organization, our world-renowned research pushes the boundaries of science and engineering to make the impossible, possible. Every day we explore new ideas through innovative research and help companies discover possibilities that impact Canada’s future and the world.

At the NRC, you’ll also discover new possibilities. Our supportive workplace fosters a culture of creativity, welcoming fresh perspectives and innovation at all levels. We value teamwork. You’ll collaborate across multiple fields and with the brightest minds to find creative solutions. Most importantly, you’ll discover what’s possible within you as you grow, make valuable contributions and progress in your professional journey. From ground-breaking discoveries to a life-changing career, discover your possible at the NRC.

title: Product Manager, Business Systems
description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is seeking a Manager, Business Systems to own and evolve the core operating systems that power our admissions, scheduling, clinical access, and revenue workflows. You will be responsible for architecting, governing, and continuously improving the logic that defines how our business actually runs, using Salesforce as the backbone of our operational nervous system.

You will partner closely with Operations, Clinical, Revenue Cycle, Data, and Engineering leaders to design deterministic, scalable systems that improve access to care, increase throughput, and protect revenue and compliance at scale.

This role will report through Charlie Health’s Product Management team and is ideal for someone from a Strategy & Operations, BizOps, RevOps, or consulting background who wants to move from analysis and recommendations into true systems ownership, with a path towards Product Management.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, governance, and roadmap for Charlie Health’s Salesforce-based operating systems
  • Translate real-world operational workflows into scalable, deterministic system logic
  • Design routing, automation, case management, and capacity allocation frameworks that directly impact access to care, revenue capture, and compliance
  • Partner with Operations, Clinical, Admissions, Scheduling, and RCM teams to identify bottlenecks and convert them into system-level solutions
  • Define and enforce schema design, automation standards, and change-control governance
  • Build economic and throughput models to inform prioritization and system design
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve funnel performance, reduce operational friction, and increase scalability
  • Partner with Salesforce Admins and Engineers to deliver clean, auditable, maintainable systems
  • Serve as the single owner responsible for the quality, integrity, and evolution of Charlie Health’s operational systems

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, BizOps, RevOps, GTM Ops, Analytics, or related roles
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL / Excel / Sheets / BI tools)
  • Experience translating complex operational workflows into system logic
  • Familiarity with CRM, workflow automation, or revenue operations systems (Salesforce strongly preferred)
  • Ability to think in constraints, throughput, and operating models
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable owning high-impact systems in a fast-growing environment
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Familiarity with cloud-based collaboration tools (Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce)
  • Must be willing to work in-person 4 days per week in our office in Union Square, NY.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $125,000 and $200,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role also offers a performance bonus of 10%. Please note, pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location, experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Further, cash compensation is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may include stock options and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits. #LI-HYBRID

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.
