title: Edit Assistant
location: London, Kensington and Chelsea, United Kingdom
description:
About:

The Rolex SailGP Championship is the most exciting racing on water, where anything can happen in short, adrenaline-fueled battles between national teams at iconic stadium destinations worldwide. Top athletes fly in identical high-tech F50 catamarans faster than the wind, at speeds in excess of 100km/h (60mph). Founded in 2018, SailGP is one of the world’s fastest-growing sports and entertainment properties, now in its sixth season.


SailGP is a global organisation with defined values that shape the culture of its team – Deliver Quality and Consistency; Evolve with Focus; Make it Count; Stand Together and Strike a Balance.



Summary:

SailGP is expanding, and we are looking for a Edit Assistant (Social) to join our growing in-house content team. Reporting to the Senior Producer, this role is ideal for someone looking to build a career in content creation.

You will collaborate across the social and content teams to produce real-time content that captures the atmosphere and storylines of SailGP events across a variety of platforms. You will also support producers and editors in delivering world-class coverage of the most exciting racing on water.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Social first video editing, you should be comfortable cutting mobile footage directly in app, or taking a project into Premier Pro for a more polished finish.
  • Identify and deliver content in real-time with a particular focus on recognising social-worthy moments from race weekends, shoots and archive content.
  • Work with the senior producer to ensure quality control of content against platform and brand guidelines (aspect ratios, safe areas, captions, fonts, colours, audio levels and file formats) before delivering content for publishing.
  • Contribute to world class social coverage of SailGP events supporting the social and content teams onsite or from London in the social/content event hub.
  • Templates and versioning: build and maintain reusable project templates and produce platform-specific variations and re-cuts of existing content to keep on top of the latest trends.
  • Collaboration: work closely with editors, producers and the social team; share your ideas, take direction well, and be open to learning from your colleagues.
  • Ensure the organisation and accessibility of SailGP's social content archive, and support editors and producers in locating clips and media quickly.
  • Keep up to date with general social media best practices, trends, tools, and technologies.

Key Expectations:

  • Lives SailGP's values and contributes to a positive culture.
  • Inclusive team player, championing an environment where diversity is valued.
  • Keen to have ownership over certain processes, areas or procedures taking responsibility for the outcome.
  • Comprehends how their decisions may impact SailGP both from an operational and financial perspective in line with Better Sport, Better Planet.
  • Draws upon their internal network to support with the delivery of projects or operations, initiating conversations and building connections.
  • Aware of the importance and urgency of tasks as a part of SailGP's operations and can effectively prioritise these areas.
  • Identifies and acts upon lateral opportunities to develop and learn.
  • Proactively makes ideas, suggestions, and solutions to challenges as well as proposing implementation.



About You:

  • A confident, creative and collaborative team player with a passion for sailing or other sports
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, with a foundational understanding of After Effects (keyframing, masking, basic compositing) or a strong desire to learn.
  • In-depth knowledge of social media platforms, trends and best practices a plus; baseline knowledge with an appetite to upskill a must
  • An interest in social-first storytelling and an understanding of what makes short-form content work.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously without compromising quality
  • Technically proficient – able to learn new tools and platforms quickly
  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Proactive with strong attention to detail


Location:

SailGP HQ in London, United Kingdom. Hybrid working model with a minimum of 3 days per week in the London office.

Some travel to events and weekend work required.

SailGP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity, equity and inclusion.

title: Director of Finance
description:
Position Summary

The Hatch Group is seeking an experienced Director of Finance to lead financial strategy, support profitable growth, and strengthen financial performance across its company entities and locations. This position partners with executive leadership on strategic planning, cash flow, financing, acquisitions, capital investments, and risk management.

The Director of Finance oversees the Controller, Senior Accountant and other Accounting Department Staff and provides direction to the accounting department. The Controller owns day-to-day accounting operations, financial statement preparation, internal controls, and the close process. The Senior Accountant performs technical accounting work and directly supervises the three accounting support employees.

The ideal candidate combines financial expertise with practical business judgment, understands construction and project-based operations, and can translate financial information into clear recommendations for leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Strategy and Business Planning

  • Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning across entities, branches, and service lines.
  • Partner with executive and operational leaders to establish financial goals and evaluate performance.
  • Analyze revenue, profitability, overhead, and operating trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop financial models and scenario analyses for expansion, pricing, staffing, and other business decisions.
  • Establish financial performance measures and work with department leaders to address results.
  • Balance growth objectives with liquidity, financial capacity, and operational requirements.

Banking Relationships and Financing

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for banks, lenders, and financing partners.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit facilities, equipment financing, and other borrowing arrangements.
  • Coordinate financing applications, renewals, and negotiations with executive leadership.
  • Monitor debt obligations, borrowing availability, and lender covenant compliance.
  • Ensure required financial information is submitted accurately and on time, using schedules prepared by the accounting team.
  • Recommend banking arrangements and account structures that support the organization’s needs.

Bonding and Surety Management

  • Manage relationships with surety providers and bonding agents.
  • Oversee bonding renewals, capacity reviews, and project-specific bond requests.
  • Coordinate financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, and other underwriting information with the Controller.
  • Monitor factors affecting bonding capacity and communicate limitations or requirements to leadership.
  • Partner with operations and estimating teams to assess bonding requirements for prospective projects.

Cash Flow Strategy and Working Capital

  • Own cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning across the organization.
  • Anticipate seasonal funding needs, major expenditures, debt payments, and other cash requirements.
  • Use reconciled cash balances, receivables aging, payables schedules, and project information to develop reliable forecasts.
  • Set working capital priorities and monitor collection trends, payment timing, and retainage exposure.
  • Establish payment priorities and funding plans within approved policies.
  • Recommend actions to maintain sufficient liquidity and improve cash conversion.

Acquisitions and Financial Integration

  • Lead the financial evaluation of acquisition opportunities in coordination with executive leadership and advisers.
  • Assess financial results, working capital, debt, liabilities, and other factors affecting transaction value.
  • Develop acquisition models and evaluate financing options.
  • Coordinate financial due diligence and communicate findings, assumptions, and risks.
  • Lead financial integration planning, including reporting structures, banking, controls, systems, and accounting processes.
  • Direct the Controller’s execution of accounting integration tasks and monitor post-acquisition performance.

Insurance and Risk Management

  • Manage relationships with insurance brokers and coordinate company insurance renewals.
  • Evaluate coverage needs, premiums, deductibles, and financial exposure with leadership and advisers.
  • Coordinate insurance information across entities and locations.
  • Partner with HR, safety, operations, and legal advisers on claims information, loss trends, and risk-reduction initiatives.
  • Evaluate financial risks associated with customer concentration, contracts, credit exposure, and operational decisions.
  • Recommend appropriate financial safeguards and insurance arrangements.

Capital Expenditures and Asset Planning

  • Lead capital expenditure planning for equipment, vehicles, facilities, and technology.
  • Evaluate proposed investments using return, utilization, operating cost, and cash flow analyses.
  • Assess purchase, lease, and financing alternatives.
  • Present recommendations for approval and monitor spending against approved plans.
  • Review the financial performance of major investments with operational leaders.
  • Coordinate with the Controller to ensure approved transactions are properly recorded.

Executive Reporting and Decision Support

  • Own the preparation and presentation of executive financial reporting using financial statements reviewed by the Controller.
  • Explain performance against budget and forecast, including significant variances and corrective actions.
  • Present branch, service-line, and project profitability trends.
  • Communicate liquidity, debt, bonding capacity, financial risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Translate financial information into practical recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Ensure leadership receives timely information for major business decisions.

Accounting Leadership and Department Development

  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate the Controller.
  • Establish department goals, reporting expectations, and priorities.
  • Review financial results and significant accounting matters with the Controller.
  • Provide oversight of accounting policies, internal controls, audit readiness, and tax-adviser coordination.
  • Ensure the accounting department has appropriate staffing, systems, training, and coverage.
  • Sponsor improvements to financial reporting and accounting systems while the Controller directs implementation.
  • Maintain clear ownership, approval authority, and escalation procedures throughout the department.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field required.
  • Ten or more years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including financial leadership and staff management.
  • Experience in construction, contracting, or another project-based industry strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple company entities, locations, or business units.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, cash flow management, and financial statement analysis.
  • Familiarity with construction job costing, work-in-progress reporting, retainage, and revenue recognition.
  • Experience managing banking relationships, financing arrangements, and lender reporting.
  • Experience with bonding and surety requirements preferred.
  • Acquisition due diligence and integration experience preferred.
  • Experience coordinating insurance programs and evaluating business risk.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to advise executive and operational leaders.
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with financial and accounting systems.
  • CPA, CMA, or MBA preferred.

Schedule:

This position is full-time. In office availability is required in Plainville, MA

Pay Range:

  • Annual Salary Range: $185,000 - $225,000
  • Company Benefits include Health Insurance with generous company contribution. Dental and Vision insurances paid fully by the company. 401(k) with matching contributions along with multiple paid holidays, PTO, and more!
What Success Looks Like
  • Leadership receives clear, timely financial reporting and actionable recommendations.
  • Budgets and forecasts support realistic operating and growth plans.
  • Cash requirements are anticipated and adequate liquidity is maintained.
  • Banking, bonding, and insurance relationships support business needs.
  • Capital investments receive consistent financial evaluation.
  • Acquisitions are thoroughly assessed and financially integrated.
  • The Controller and accounting team have clear priorities, effective systems, and appropriate oversight.
  • Financial performance improves through disciplined planning and collaboration with operations.

Benefits: We're thrilled to offer our full-time employees with a healthy benefits package including Health, Life, and Dental Insurances. Additionally, we match in 401k contributions up to 4%.

Please note that Hatch is a drug free work environment and all employees are subject to pre-employment and random drug screenings throughout their employment.

title: IT Support Specialist III
description:
Pure IP, a BCM One Company, is trusted by millions daily to power business communications. We bridge the gap between legacy and modern systems, integrating voice across platforms, systems, and applications to deliver seamless, end-to-end communication services. With a global footprint and a reputation for innovation, Pure IP enables businesses to collaborate effectively, no matter where they are.


As an IT Support Specialist III, you’ll play a critical role in the operational efficiency of our global IT support function, providing expert helpdesk and systems administration for our team. You will tackle complex IT issues, provide top-notch support to our global team, and contribute to the strategic improvement of our technology environment. In addition, you’ll work with global IT team members to foster a culture of technical excellence and proactive support.


Work Locations:

This position will work in a hybrid capacity, with a minimum of two days per week at our Cannon Green office in central London. Office days will fluctuate based on international and local team members' presence in the office. This position is not eligible for sponsorship or relocation.


Hours: Typically, 8:00/9:00 to 17:00/18:00 local. Some flex hours will be required in order to overlap with US and NZ teams. A trip to New Zealand or the US may be a possibility.


What You Will Do:

Helpdesk

  • Serve as the senior point of escalation for IT-related inquiries, delivering Tier 1 and Tier 2 support with a focus on high-level troubleshooting and resolution.
  • Facilitate helpdesk support efforts for software, hardware, and network inquiries, ensuring efficiency and user satisfaction.
  • Provide technical guidance and establish best practices for troubleshooting and documentation.
  • Document advanced technical issues and solutions in a user-friendly manner, maintaining a knowledge base and training resources.
  • Oversee and manage user accounts, permissions, and backup procedures through Active Directory.
  • Administer Office 365, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and other cloud-based services.

Security & Compliance

  • Actively manage and maintain security protocols, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Mobile Device
  • Management (MDM), and Intune solutions.
  • Use and administer security tools such as Microsoft Defender, SIEM, and EDR solutions.
  • Proactively monitor security alerts and address potential threats, collaborating with global security teams as needed.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Drive process improvements and develop technical efficiencies across the IT function.
  • Lead automation projects using PowerShell and other scripting tools, streamlining routine tasks and system management.
  • Continuously evaluate and implement best practices to improve service quality and system performance.


What You Will Need:

  • People Skills: Demonstrated ability to support internal customers with patience and a collaborative approach.
  • Experience: 3+ years in IT helpdesk and systems administration, with senior-level experience.
  • Technical Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft desktop and server OS, Linux, virtualisation technologies, and cloud services.
  • Security Focus: Strong understanding of information security principles; certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or similar are a plus.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: A track record of resolving complex incidents, from diagnostics to resolution.
  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Continuous Learner: A genuine passion for emerging technologies, automation, and process improvement.


Who We Are:

BCM One is a leading telecom provider of NextGen Communications and Managed Services that has been in business for 30 years with more than 18,000 business customers and 5,000 channel partners who rely on our products, services, and teams to support their critical underlying network infrastructure. BCM One is the parent company to our family of brands that includes SIP.US, SIPTRUNK, Flowroute, SkySwitch, and Pure IP.


Joining the BCM One team is a chance to be part of a financially strong company with an exciting growth story; over the past 4 years we’ve brought together leading companies in our space who have built products, services, and programs to innovate and disrupt our industry. Now, operating under one roof, we are taking BCM One to the next level and looking for talented individuals to help make that happen.


When you choose to work at BCM One, you get to work with a talented team and build experience with the leading technologies, suppliers, and partners in our industry. We don’t offer cookie-cutter solutions, so the opportunities are endless, and the work is always varied and interesting. We take our mission “to provide a world-class experience with every human interaction” seriously, which means everything you do makes a difference. And we’re committed to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive workforce and environment that empowers you to do your best work, spread your wings and reach your full potential. At BCM One, we encourage our team to learn something new every day, so you don’t just become part of our growth story, we become part of yours.


Why BCM One:

We are committed to creating an environment that fosters teamwork, accountability, innovation, and teamwork. Many BCM One employees have been with the company for 10+ years, which we think says a lot about our culture.


We Are a Team

  • We pride ourselves on our team-based approach to providing quality solutions for our clients. BCM One encourages a culture of collaboration, exposing employees to different areas of the business and fostering career growth.
  • We support employee involvement and provide opportunities to be responsible stewards via our BCM One Gives Back Program and our Emergency Fund to help our team members who are going through difficult times.


Hard Work is Recognized

  • We offer an Employee of the Quarter program with a monetary award and Employee of the Year that includes a 7-day vacation package to the Caribbean. In addition, we host various regional team-building gatherings throughout the year.
  • We believe in developing our team members and offer many opportunities for training, professional development and career growth.


Your Voice is Heard

  • We empower our team members to speak up and look for opportunities in challenges.
  • We have an Employee Council and a Diversity Equity and Inclusion Committee made up of volunteers from across the company who share a passion for making BCM One a great place to work and find ways to positively impact our communities.


How we take care of you:

  • Competitive base salary
  • Annual reviews
  • Paid time off (vacation)
  • Paid public holidays
  • Critical Illness Protection
  • Income Protection
  • Health Insurance
  • NEST Pension company match
  • Life Insurance


BCM One is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Clerkship Coordinator (Fresno)
description:
Job Summary

The Pediatrics and OB/GYN Clerkship Coordinator is a staff position supporting the Departments of Pediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynecology at the UCSF Fresno regional campus. The position uses professional concepts and applies University policies and procedures to coordinate a variety of ongoing administrative and operational activities and administer defined educational and academic programs for both departments.

Under general supervision, the incumbent is responsible for the effective day-to-day administration and coordination of the Pediatrics and OB/GYN medical student clerkship programs and provides academic affairs support to both departments. Responsibilities include coordinating medical student core clerkships, electives, and other educational rotations across multiple clinical training sites; managing student schedules and related program requirements; coordinating communication among students, faculty, clinical sites, and educational partners; supporting faculty appointment activities; and performing financial and administrative transactions using University systems.

The position serves as a key administrative resource for medical students rotating through the Pediatrics and OB/GYN programs, including UCSF School of Medicine students and visiting students from other medical schools. The incumbent works closely with departmental faculty and leadership, clerkship directors, residents, medical students, UCSF Fresno and UCSF School of Medicine programs, clinical affiliates, and outside institutions to facilitate educational activities and address administrative and operational issues of moderate scope.

The incumbent must be able to independently organize and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-program and multi-site academic environment; identify and resolve routine to moderately complex operational issues; and appropriately escalate matters requiring higher-level review. The position requires strong organizational, written and verbal communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills; attention to detail; proficiency with applicable technology and University systems; and the ability to exercise diplomacy, discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism when interacting with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders.

Department Description

The UCSF Fresno Departments of Pediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynecology (OB/GYN) are academic departments of the UCSF School of Medicine based at the UCSF Fresno regional campus. Together, the departments provide clinical services and support undergraduate and graduate medical education throughout the Central San Joaquin Valley, training medical students, residents, and other learners across multiple clinical and academic sites.

The Department of Pediatrics includes more than 40 faculty members and 21 residents in its three-year residency program. Pediatric clinical services and training are provided at Community Regional Medical Center (CRMC) and United Health Centers (UHC), with additional resident rotations at Valley Children’s Hospital, UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland, and UCSF Mission Bay.

The Department of OB/GYN includes more than 30 faculty members and 20 residents in its four-year residency program. The department provides clinical services and oversees resident education and training at Community Regional Medical Center, United Health Centers, and Inspire Health Medical Group–Perinatology.

Both departments support robust medical student education programs, coordinating core and elective rotations across multiple clinical sites. Collectively, the programs receive more than 200 medical student applications annually and coordinate rotations for approximately 90 students each year. This multi-site educational environment requires close collaboration among faculty, residents, medical students, clinical partners, UCSF Fresno and UCSF School of Medicine programs, and outside medical schools.

The departments are committed to providing high-quality patient care to the communities of Central California, educating the next generation of physicians, fostering positive learning environments that promote lifelong learning, advancing patient-centered research, and strengthening community partnerships.

Medical Student Clerkship and Program Coordination

  • Coordinate the day-to-day administration of medical student core and elective clerkships for the Departments of Pediatrics and OB/GYN.
  • Coordinate the rotation schedules for approximately 90 medical students across multiple clinical training sites.
  • Manage the medical student application process, including receiving, reviewing, tracking, and processing more than 200 applications annually.
  • Coordinate student rotation requests, verify eligibility and required documentation, and facilitate placement approvals in collaboration with clerkship directors and designated program leadership.
  • Maintains electronic student files including but not limited to accurate rotation calendars, student rosters, scheduling records, and program databases.
  • Coordinate rotation assignments with faculty, residents, clinical departments, and affiliated training sites to ensure appropriate educational experiences.
  • Independently manage routine scheduling conflicts, rotation changes, and administrative issues, escalating complex matters as appropriate.
  • Monitor established program timelines, application deadlines, and rotation requirements to ensure efficient program operations.
  • Review and maintain Visiting Student scholarship process including application process, award notifications and processing of scholarship award. Works with Department Manager to prepare budget for the Visiting Student scholarship.
  • Remain abreast of LCME policies and procedures, maintains all essential documents required for program accreditation and provides support for LCME accreditation compliance.
  • Participate in all UME related Committee meetings (Fresno and UCSF as required).
  • Participate in student outreach by attending recruiting fairs and coordinating program booth.

Student Onboarding and Educational Support

  • Coordinate onboarding and orientation activities for incoming medical students at participating clinical training sites.
  • Communicate rotation expectations, schedules, educational objectives, institutional policies, and required documentation to students before and during their rotations.
  • Coordinate completion of student onboarding requirements, including institutional clearances, health documentation, training modules, identification badges, and clinical system access, as applicable.
  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for medical students regarding rotation logistics, schedules, and program procedures.
  • Coordinate educational conferences, didactic sessions, orientations, and other clerkship-related learning activities.
  • Serve as proctor for the Shelf Exam.
  • Distribute and maintain clerkship materials, orientation documents, educational resources, and student communications.
  • Assist students with routine questions and concerns, referring academic, professionalism, or sensitive issues to the appropriate clerkship director or program leadership.
  • Support a professional, inclusive, and positive learning environment for medical students rotating through UCSF Fresno.

Educational Evaluations, Records, and Compliance

  • Coordinate the collection and tracking of medical student evaluations and faculty assessments.
  • Monitor evaluation completion and communicate outstanding requirements to residents, faculty, and clerkship directors.
  • Assist clerkship directors with tracking student progress, required clinical experiences, midpoint feedback, and completion of established educational requirements.
  • Support timely submission of student evaluations, grades, and required documentation to UCSF School of Medicine and affiliated medical schools, as directed by clerkship leadership.
  • Assist with the collection and organization of educational data used for program reviews, accreditation activities, and continuous quality improvement.

title: Senior Director Product Management, Hardware Engineering (AI Infrastructure)
description:

Our AI Infrastructure organization is at the forefront of designing, deploying, and managing the advanced hardware platforms that power high-performance GPU, CPU, and storage clusters for OCI customers.

Our hardware engineering organization is responsible for the physical infrastructure supporting these platforms, including servers, networking, storage, power, cooling, and rack-scale optimization. This encompasses component- and system-level validation, hardware reliability, lifecycle management, and establishing platform standards to ensure operational excellence and best-in-class availability.

As Senior Director, Product Management – Hardware Engineering (AI Infrastructure), you will lead the hardware program organization responsible for the build, configuration, delivery, and integration of next-generation hardware platforms. You will collaborate with leading AI technology partners and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver infrastructure solutions at exceptional speed, scale, and reliability.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished hardware systems leader with extensive experience in board design, systems integration, reliability engineering, and data center hardware operations. You will bring strong technical judgment, strategic vision, and the ability to lead geographically distributed teams through complex engineering challenges. Success in this role requires balancing technical priorities, organizational objectives, and execution timelines while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Leadership & Cultural Development

  • Define and communicate a long-term technical roadmap aligned with OCI's broader AI infrastructure objectives, driving alignment across hardware engineering, software, and data center operations.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing, geographically distributed engineering organization, fostering technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and psychological safety.
  • Identify, develop, and empower emerging technical leaders, strengthening organizational capabilities and supporting long-term team growth.
  • Serve as a key technical and organizational leader for complex hardware program decisions, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Navigate high-pressure, resource-constrained environments by balancing engineering priorities, supply chain considerations, business objectives, and delivery commitments.

Risk Management & Operational Resilience

  • Establish proactive risk management processes to identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and program risks before they impact critical delivery milestones.
  • Anticipate and address supply chain constraints, component-level technical challenges, and hardware integration complexities that could affect platform availability or delivery.
  • Lead the development and execution of end-to-end hardware reliability strategies, incorporating data-driven root cause analysis (RCA), failure analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Establish mechanisms to capture and apply lessons learned from hardware failures and operational challenges to improve platform quality, availability, and long-term resilience.
  • Develop and maintain contingency plans for critical hardware programs, enabling teams to respond rapidly to technical challenges, changing priorities, and evolving market conditions without compromising quality or delivery commitments.

Hardware Engineering & Program Execution

  • Oversee the end-to-end design, validation, integration, deployment, and lifecycle management of complex hardware platforms operating at hyperscale.
  • Establish and maintain hardware engineering standards, ensuring quality, consistency, and compliance in collaboration with global engineering and operational teams.
  • Drive successful execution of large-scale hardware programs, ensuring delivery against technical requirements, program milestones, quality expectations, and budget objectives.
  • Partner closely with software, firmware, operations, supply chain, and data center engineering organizations to optimize hardware platforms for demanding AI and high-performance computing workloads.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts to improve hardware platform reliability, availability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12+ years of technical experience in hardware engineering, hardware systems development, or related technical disciplines.
  • 7+ years of experience managing hardware engineering or hardware platform teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical organizations and geographically distributed engineering teams.
  • Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and program management skills, with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications

  • Significant experience delivering highly available hardware systems on schedule and within budget.
  • Expertise in hardware design, board-level engineering, system integration, hardware qualification, and mechanical engineering fundamentals.
  • Deep technical understanding of server hardware subsystems, including GPUs, CPUs, memory, PCIe, Ethernet/InfiniBand networking, and storage technologies.
  • Experience with data center hardware reliability, failure analysis, and root cause investigation.
  • Working knowledge of power delivery, cooling technologies, and rack-level architecture in hyperscale data center environments.
  • Experience collaborating with software, firmware, manufacturing, and data center operations teams throughout the hardware development lifecycle.
  • Strong experience with high-performance computing (HPC), GPU-based systems, and large-scale AI infrastructure platforms.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and country-specific hardware compliance standards.

title: AI Engineer III - Forward Deployed Engineer - Enterprise AI Platforms
description:
Why Join American Express

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Enterprise AI Platform organization partners with business and technology teams to shape the Enterprise AI strategy, bring emerging technologies to the forefront, and build scalable, reusable AI platforms. This team plays a pivotal role in enabling American Express to operate as an AI-powered enterprise by equipping teams with the skills, platforms, and seamless deployment capabilities needed to accelerate responsible AI innovation, enhance decision-making, and drive customer impact with speed and scale.

Join a team shaping the future of AI at American Express. You will work directly with business and product leaders to turn high-value opportunities into trusted, secure, and responsible AI solutions, while helping successful ideas become reusable capabilities across the enterprise.

FDE partners across American Express to transform high-value business opportunities into trusted, secure, and scalable AI solutions delivering measurable outcomes, accelerating adoption, and turning successful innovations into reusable enterprise capabilities.

Role Summary

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will partner closely with business units, product teams, and engineering organizations to identify and reframe high-value opportunities, translate business challenges into clear value propositions, and build working solutions using Generative AI, agentic systems, and intelligent automation.

You will take opportunities from discovery and demonstration through proof of value, production scaling, adoption, and transition to long-term ownership. Demonstrations are a means of validating grounded value propositions, not the end goal. You will be accountable for advancing credible opportunities into real adoption and durable ways of working, with each stage tied to measurable outcomes and balanced with enterprise requirements for security, reliability, and responsible AI.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant stakeholder engagement component. You will influence without direct authority, communicate across levels of seniority and technical familiarity, and work alongside engineers to build and deploy reliable software.

You will challenge assumptions about how work is performed, analyze processes as systems, and identify the technical, operational, and organizational levers that can improve them. You will define a longer-term direction while sequencing practical near-term solutions that build toward it.

Candidates may come from mobile, web, backend, distributed-systems, or workflow-platform backgrounds. What matters most is the ability to understand a system end to end, form a point of view, engage deeply with users, and turn direction into working software

Opportunity discovery and transformation

  • Build trusted relationships and develop a deep understanding of business priorities, user needs, operational workflows, and sources of friction.
  • Challenge existing assumptions, map processes as systems, and identify the technical, operational, and organizational changes most likely to improve them.
  • Lead discovery sessions that translate business needs into clear use cases, value propositions, measurable success criteria, and solution direction.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user impact, risk, and readiness for adoption.
  • Define a longer-term vision and identify the smallest useful intervention that can validate the opportunity while preserving a path to broader transformation.

Solution design and delivery

  • Design, build, and deploy Generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions using approved enterprise platform capabilities.
  • Develop working demonstrations and proofs of value that test assumptions and measure business impact.
  • Take solutions through prototyping, production scaling, adoption, and transition to long-term ownership.
  • Build agents and AI-enabled workflows that interact with enterprise APIs, knowledge sources, data platforms, applications, code, and business processes.
  • Incorporate appropriate human input, approval, escalation, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Work directly alongside engineering teams to produce software and apply the architecture, testing, deployment, and operational practices required for production use.
  • Use experimentation selectively to reduce uncertainty while balancing speed with security, reliability, maintainability, and governance.

AI-enabled engineering practices

  • Use coding agents and AI-assisted engineering techniques to accelerate discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, and iteration.
  • Apply specification-driven development, context management, iterative planning, and structured knowledge repositories to preserve context and improve personal productivity.
  • Evaluate agent-generated code and technical outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural alignment.
  • Identify where AI-enabled development practices can improve engineering throughput without compromising operational standards.

Platform contribution and scale

  • Generalize patterns and components developed through individual engagements for broader use.
  • Partner with platform and product teams to turn successful prototypes into reusable features, accelerators, reference architectures, and paved-road implementation patterns.
  • Capture lessons from deployments and use them to influence the enterprise AI platform and product roadmap.
  • Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows and transition solutions into sustainable operating models.

Evaluation, governance, and responsible AI

  • Develop evaluation approaches that measure solution quality, task completion, business outcomes, user experience, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Identify and address failure modes through testing, monitoring, safeguards, and iterative improvement.
  • Ensure solutions meet American Express requirements for security, privacy, risk management, responsible AI, and regulatory compliance.
  • Establish appropriate controls for model access, enterprise data, tool use, human oversight, and production operations.

Stakeholder leadership

  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to audiences with different levels of technical familiarity and seniority.
  • Influence decisions and drive alignment across business, product, engineering, risk, and platform teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Maintain strong stakeholder relationships throughout discovery, delivery, adoption, and transition, and mentor partner teams on AI solution delivery.
  • 3 or more years of experience delivering software, technical solutions, or digital products in an engineering, architecture, or technical consulting capacity.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business or user problem through discovery, implementation, and measurable validation.
  • Experience using coding agents in a structured engineering workflow, including specification-driven development, context management, iterative implementation, and reusable knowledge repositories.
  • Software engineering fluency and the ability to contribute directly to applications, integrations, services, or technical prototypes.
  • Experience in at least one relevant domain, such as mobile, web, backend services, APIs, distributed systems, platform engineering, workflow orchestration, or cloud-native development.
  • Ability to reason about systems end to end, identify constraints and leverage points, and connect technical decisions to business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-partnership skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, challenge existing approaches constructively, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to define a longer-term direction and sequence incremental solutions that build toward it.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or deploying solutions powered by language models, agentic systems, or AI-enabled process flows.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, tool calling, model context protocols, knowledge retrieval, or workflow technologies such as Temporal, LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls and operational safeguards, with knowledge of AI evaluation, observability, and responsible AI.
  • Experience supporting technology adoption or operating-model transformation, particularly in financial services or another regulated industry.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • AI opportunities that progress from discovery to proof of value and, where appropriate, production adoption.
  • Measurable business outcomes tied to clearly defined KPIs.
  • Ability to identify and reframe valuable opportunities while connecting near-term delivery to longer-term transformation.
  • Solutions that improve the broader workflow and are adopted into sustainable operating models.
  • Strong stakeholder relationships, technical quality, and effective management of security, risk, and reliability.
  • Reusable capabilities and implementation patterns incorporated into the enterprise AI platform.

Working Model and Travel

Occasional travel may be required for workshops or key delivery milestones, but frequent travel is not expected. Roles may be based near selected American Express offices to support close partnerships with regional business and product teams.

title: Drafting Project Manager - Glazing
description:
Drafting Project Manager - Glazing


About Bothwell-Accurate


Bothwell-Accurate Co. Inc. has been a leader in roofing, waterproofing, cladding and glazing services across Ontario and British Columbia for over 90 years. With more than 60,000 completed projects, we’re known for delivering high-quality, innovative and reliable building envelope solutions to commercial, industrial and institutional clients.


We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Drafting Project Manager to join our team in Mississauga. In this role, you will lead the technical detailing, shop drawing preparation, and multidisciplinary coordination for complex architectural glazing projects. You will act as a pivotal link between design concepts, architectural specifications, structural engineering, and shop floor manufacturing.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative lead designer/technologist with deep expertise in unitized and stick curtain wall systems, storefronts, and architectural metal cladding, possessing strong skills in Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coordinate the preparation of complete architectural shop drawing packages, structural connection details, glass schedules, and anchor layouts.
  • Utilize Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD to generate parametric 3D models, die profiles, assembly drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and fabrication cut sheets for shop production.
  • Coordinate architectural glazing designs with structural, mechanical, civil, and building envelope consultants to resolve site conditions and structural loads.
  • Review and respond to RFIs, architectural revisions, addenda, shop drawings, submittals, and construction-phase documentation.
  • Assist with project schedules, deliverables, and coordination efforts to meet project deadlines.
  • Participate in project meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.
  • Respond to technical questions and assist with the resolution of design and construction issues.
  • Conduct site visits and assist with field observations and documentation.
  • Support the Project Manager and drafting team throughout all phases of the project.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior staff as appropriate.
  • Help maintain office standards, drawing standards, templates, and project documentation procedures.
  • Ensure work complies with applicable building codes, zoning requirements, accessibility standards, and other regulations.


What You Bring to the Team

  • College Diploma or University Degree in Architectural Technology, Civil/Structural Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of direct professional experience in architectural glazing, curtain wall detailing, or building envelope manufacturing.
  • Strong working knowledge of commercial glazing systems (unitized/stick curtain wall, window wall, skylights, interior glass, metal panels), rainscreen principles, thermal performance, and air/water barrier integration.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams and consultants.
  • Solid understanding of building codes (OBC/NBC), structural deflection criteria, and wind-load considerations.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills for liaising with Project Managers, architects, engineers, and shop personnel.
  • Proficiency in Autodesk Inventor (3D parametric assemblies/part modeling) and AutoCAD (2D detailing and layout).
  • Experience with project collaboration and document-management platforms is an asset.
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Teams, Outlook) and PDF markup software (Bluebeam Revu).
  • Familiarity with Revit / BIM coordination workflows.


Role Snapshot

  • Location: Head Office – 6675 Rexwood Rd, Mississauga, ON L4V 1V1
  • Type: Full-Time, Onsite
  • Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
  • Pay Schedule: Paid bi-weekly, every second Friday
  • Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 (Based on experience)
  • Reports To: Glazing Manager
  • Vacancy Reason: Existing Vacancy
  • Number of Positions: 1


Why Join Bothwell-Accurate?

  • Real opportunities to grow and advance
  • A team that supports you like family
  • Competitive benefits that grow with you
  • Bi-weekly pay you can count on
  • Work on high-profile, high-impact projects


Where your work shapes skylines, and your growth shapes your career.

title: Production Washroom Operator
description:
Overview
Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.
Responsibilities / Essential Functions

Checks all machine safety devices before operating equipment and records and signs the appropriate equipment safety form. If machine does not pass safety inspection, operator will not operate unit, and notifies supervisor.
When loading washer, retrieve sling from storage and maneuvers sling to the washer’s rails and in front of the washer. If loading a dryer, obtain an extracted sling from the overhead feed rail and verifies each batch ticket to avoid mixing lots and batches. Stages similar batches together for maximum product/wash utilization.
Positions washer/dryer in proper loading position (tilted up), removes batch ticket, loads the washer/dryer by untying the bottom cord of sling, forces the items into the washer/dryer cylinder, closes washer/dryer doors, lowers washer/dryer to the horizontal position, selects the appropriate washer/dryer formula, and starts the machine.
Takes the batch ticket and writes the ticket information on the washer/dryer form visually displayed by the machine.
For washer, enters the weight off of the batch ticket into SOFTROL. For dryer, re-ties the sling and transports to hoist staging area.
Unloads washer: opens washer door, tilts washer forward, moves lined cart with clean sling, and removes items from the washer into the cart, places batch tickets on top of items, moves cart to sling raise area, and tilts washer back into load position.
Unloads dryer: opens the front door, ensures items are at the proper moisture levels (if not, re-dry), raises the front-end of the dryer, moves to the rear of the machine, opens the rear door, places the appropriate tub at the dryer opening, removes items from dryer, places batch ticket on top of items, stores in appropriate area, closes rear door, and leaves dryer in tilted position to aid in loading process.
Verifies proper moisture retention of items, carts/tubs are not overload, load items are at proper temperature, all extracted slings are free of excessive water, and all items are properly cooled down.
Identifies any slings with rips or tears and removes them from the system.
Maintains safe and clean work environment, and observes best practices in all production activities.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Ability to understand all required training, written, and verbal instructions.
Working knowledge of basic math skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to meet attendance schedule.

Working Environment / Safety Requirements

Work is performed in a warehouse setting and regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme heat and cold conditions as well as dust and noise.
Work is based on a shift schedule, and may include weekends.
Overtime required as needed.

Physical Requirements
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Requires the ability to move or maneuver slings or carriers weighing up to 220 lbs.
Requires the ability to move, lift, carry, push, or pull product weighing up to 50 lbs.
Requires bending, reaching, pulling, and pressing at shoulder level and below waist area.
Requires the use of hands for grasping and other manipulations.
Requires standing and walking for long periods of time.

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred.

title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
description:

Backend platform engineering is the primary responsibility, complemented by the ability to deliver frontend experiences and AI-powered interactions.

Defines system behavior, interfaces, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation strategies before implementation. Uses AI development tools to generate, refine, and test solutions, applying engineering judgment to assess correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and architectural fit.

Leads technical initiatives across teams, resolves ambiguity, and manages dependencies and integration contracts. Delivers reliable platform services and interactive experiences using React, Node.js, MCP App Extensions, and dynamic AI canvases. Owns outcomes from specification through production validation and ongoing improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform and Backend Software Development

  • Design and develop scalable APIs and services that support multi-tenant workloads, frontend applications, and AI-powered experiences.

  • Apply appropriate validation, authorization, and error handling across frontend and backend boundaries.

  • Preferred Qualifications

    • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product goals into precise, testable specifications covering system behavior, interface contracts, constraints, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

    • Experience using specifications to guide AI-assisted development, critically reviewing generated implementations and tests, and validating correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.

    • Ability to contribute across the full stack, including React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Node.js, connecting interactive frontend experiences with backend services.

    • Experience or familiarity with MCP App Extensions and dynamic AI canvases, including tool-connected interfaces, streaming updates, and interactive AI-generated content.

    • Experience designing secure service integrations with identity, authorization, auditability, and policy enforcement.

    • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, hosted tools, vector stores, or agent orchestration patterns.

    • Experience with OCI, Kubernetes/containers, Java/Python/TypeScript, service telemetry, and operational excellence.

    • Strong engineering judgment and ownership from specification through production validation, with the ability to work across teams and shape reusable platform capabilities.

title: Event Information Listing Assistant
description:
Event Information Listing Assistant

Customer Service | Marketing Information | Remote | Full-time or part-time
Pay £28.25–£30.25 per hour

Give visitors dependable event details

The Event Information Listing Assistant takes approved event facts and places them into online listings. A visitor should be able to see what the event is, when it happens and where to find the official next step.

You would check the supplied title, date, access information and link, then prepare or update the relevant listing in the employer’s system. The position is remote and sits between basic marketing support and customer service: accurate information reduces avoidable questions from people who may attend.

You would not plan events, negotiate speakers or decide that a draft date is final. The organiser provides the authorised information. If the source is incomplete, you would ask for the missing detail before publishing. If an online listing already exists, you would check whether the new instruction replaces it or adds another event. Accidentally creating two conflicting listings can confuse visitors and colleagues, so a search for the existing entry is part of the process.

For a new listing, establish:

  • Which organiser supplied the final details.
  • The approved title, date and next-step link.
  • Whether a page for the same event is already online.

These are preparation checks, not authority to finalise an event the organiser has not approved.

A listing from start to finish

An ordinary request might provide an event name, approved description, date and registration page. You would enter those fields, check the date format and follow the registration link. If the link opens a different event, you would flag it. You would preview the listing for missing characters or awkward line breaks, then publish or submit it for approval according to the team’s process. After the page is live, you would verify that the displayed information matches the approved source and record the result.

Sometimes the event is changed. A later note may revise a start time or the link for online attendance. You should identify which live listing is affected, update only the authorised detail and check whether a colleague also needs to know about the change. A cancellation must be handled through the employer’s instructions, not simply erased without a trace if people may already have seen the information. The aim is a public listing that reflects the organiser’s current approved facts.

For a changed listing, record:

  • The field that changed and the source of the new information.
  • Whether the live page now shows the new detail.
  • Any separate communication the organiser still needs to handle.

That helps prevent a page edit from being mistaken for a complete communication plan.

Everyday responsibilities

  • Locate the existing event record before creating another listing.
  • Transfer approved titles, dates and links into the online editor.
  • Check time and date presentation against the supplied source.
  • Test the public registration or information link.
  • Preview the listing and correct simple entry errors.
  • Ask for approval when key details are missing or inconsistent.
  • Update an existing record after a documented change.
  • Keep a brief note of what was published or sent for review.

This is an introductory role. Previous event marketing, office administration or customer service experience can help, but none is required. The employer will train you on its online editor, event categories and approval steps. An applicant with little experience may already have the relevant ability to move carefully between a source document and a form. You should be willing to double-check a date and write a clear question when the organiser’s instruction is incomplete.

You will not be expected to write promotional claims from scratch or determine how widely the event should be advertised. You may use an approved short description, but content changes requiring judgement go to the responsible person. A finished listing is accurate, accessible through the intended link and traceable to its source. If publication is pending, the task should say so; merely entering text in an editor does not mean visitors can see it.

Remote work suits this computer-based task. A home office area can support close checking of online event details. The position may be full-time or part-time, with an hourly range of £28.25–£30.25. The hiring company can explain the type of events and its working arrangements during selection.

How to be considered

Show any experience updating a webpage, maintaining a calendar or checking information for an audience. It can come from a course, volunteer event or another job.

Specific event software is not an entry requirement because the company’s process will be taught. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. Your first application should give a clear account of the tasks you have genuinely handled.

title: Director Legal Operations (Remote, US)

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Legal Operations to shape and lead a legal support function that serves teams across Legal & Public Policy (LPP). You will design and manage how work is received, prioritized, assigned, and delivered while ensuring the right work reaches the right resources at the right time. You will lead a team of legal support professionals, and continuously improve how services are delivered as the function grows, including strategically leveraging AI, automation, and other technology solutions.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the Legal Operations function and oversee day-to-day service delivery across Legal & Public Policy.
  • Own the end-to-end support model, including intake, triage, assignment, escalation, and performance management.
  • Ensure work is routed consistently and efficiently using defined service standards and governance criteria.
  • Balance team workload and capacity, addressing demand fluctuations, backlogs, and coverage needs.
  • Develop cross-training and succession plans to reduce single points of failure and strengthen team resilience.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Define and maintain service offerings, workflows, procedures, and governance standards.
  • Establish controls for confidential, privileged, and higher-risk matters, including appropriate escalation to counsel.
  • Develop and report on key performance metrics, including service levels, turnaround times, quality, capacity, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Partner with legal leaders and stakeholders to improve service delivery and drive adoption of legal operations solutions.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, and the client experience.
  • Champion the use of AI and legal technology to improve scalability, productivity, and operational effectiveness.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Experience

  • Experience leading legal operations, legal service delivery, or a comparable function.
  • Experience building, scaling, or transforming service-oriented teams and processes.
  • Strong understanding of corporate legal support functions, including contracts, matter management, records management, legal holds, e-discovery support, entity management, legal technology, and compliance support.
  • Experience managing workloads, service commitments, and operational performance in a complex environment.
  • Proven success working with senior stakeholders across a matrixed organization.

Skills

  • Strong operational leadership, project management, and process improvement capabilities.
  • Ability to design scalable workflows, procedures, and service models.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with legal-focused technology solutions.
  • Sound judgment regarding confidentiality, privilege, and attorney escalation.
  • Comfortable building structure and clarity in a new and evolving environment.

Leadership and Influence

  • Proven ability to lead organizational change and influence without direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams and improving service delivery outcomes.
  • Ability to balance consistency, efficiency, risk, and stakeholder needs.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Legal Studies, Project Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Paralegal certification or legal operations certification preferred.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Providing outstanding customer service to both internal and external customers

Maintaining productive working relationships with print vendor staff and internal lines of business

Contribute to continuous improvement projects to improve efficiency and lower costs
Other work-related duties, as assigned
Responsible for meeting RoundPoint’s commitment to compliance

Strong critical thinking, organization, and excellent verbal and written communication skills
Detail Oriented
Great Communications skills

Driven to solve problems and provide excellent customer experience

RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC is a fully integrated, non-bank mortgage company, with a subservicing portfolio of approximately 900,000 loans. title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Our Company

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable software applications and platform services supporting the OQGA ecosystem, including batch processing, APIs, integrations, and healthcare quality solutions
  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and distributed application components that process large healthcare and quality datasets while ensuring performance, scalability, and data integrity
  • Develop high-quality software solutions using Java, Python, SQL, and modern engineering frameworks following enterprise coding standards and best practices
  • Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to implement scalable application designs, technical solutions, and cloud-based services aligned with business and technology objectives
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, maintainable, and secure software solutions
  • Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements refinement, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Partner with Product, QA, Operations, and cross-functional engineering teams to estimate work, resolve dependencies, and deliver features using Agile methodologies
  • Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance of OQGA applications across DEV, TEST, UAT, STAGE, and PROD environments. Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and support innovation initiatives where appropriate
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, technical documentation, and knowledge-sharing activities to strengthen overall engineering quality
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field with 4+ years of software engineering experience
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-grade applications
  • 3+ years of experience developing applications using Java and frameworks such as Spring Boot, Spring, or similar enterprise technologies
  • 2+ years of experience developing applications using Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, and production-quality code
  • 2+ years of experience designing and consuming REST APIs, microservices, and integration services
  • 1+ years of experience building, integrating, and deploying AI-powered features, automated workflows, or machine learning services/APIs
  • 1+ years of experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform

Preferred Qualification:

  • Experience with healthcare quality systems, population health platforms, claims data, clinical data, or healthcare analytics solutions
  • Knowledge of AI/ML concepts and experience integrating AI-powered features, automation capabilities, or machine learning services into enterprise applications
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications using containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and scalable application design patterns
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices including code reviews, testing strategies, secure coding, and performance optimization
  • Experience with Azure services, data platforms, monitoring tools, and enterprise integration frameworks
  • Experience contributing to technical design discussions and implementing scalable solutions based on architectural guidance
  • Experience supporting production applications, troubleshooting issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions
  • Familiarity with Generative AI, LLM-powered solutions, or AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, source control, and DevOps practices
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 to $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
