title: Product Delivery Manager - Threat Detection & Analytics
description:
Shape the future of threat detection and security product delivery at one of the world's most complex financial institutions. In this role, you will lead cross-functional product delivery across high-stakes programs—translating strategy into execution and driving outcomes that directly support the firm's security mission. You will work at the intersection of technology, data, and operational security, partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to deliver capabilities that protect the firm and its people.

As a Product Delivery Manager at JPMorganChase within the Global Security Threat Detection & Analytics team, you will own end-to-end delivery leadership across Insider Threat, Strategic Threats, and Workplace Violence programs. You will serve as the central coordination point between product strategy and technology execution—driving roadmap delivery, managing dependencies, and ensuring that capabilities are built with the right controls, quality, and adoption in mind. This is an opportunity to build repeatable delivery practices and institutional product knowledge within a mission-driven security environment.

Job responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product delivery across multiple threat detection and analytics programs, ensuring alignment between roadmap priorities, technology capacity, and business outcomes
  • Serve as the primary coordination point between product management and technology partners—managing dependencies, removing blockers, and driving timely execution of the product roadmap
  • Define and track product objectives, key performance indicators, and success measures including operational effectiveness, timeliness, quality, reliability, and user adoption
  • Translate program needs into initiatives, epics, and user stories in partnership with program-level delivery managers, ensuring consistent intake, prioritization, and documentation standards
  • Maintain a consistent operating cadence including roadmap reviews, sprint and program reviews, stakeholder updates, risk and issue management, and decision logs
  • Coordinate across engineering, data, analytics, and platform teams to deliver capabilities through clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and disciplined execution practices
  • Drive delivery outcomes across multiple workstreams—managing scope, timeline, quality, and cost—including escalation management and executive-level communications
  • Ensure product capabilities are designed with appropriate controls and that delivery activities align with legal, privacy, and governance requirements
  • Build trusted partnerships across security, technology, and cross-functional stakeholders, communicating complex topics clearly to varied audiences including senior leaders
  • Support change management and adoption planning for delivered capabilities, including training needs, operating model impacts, documentation, and feedback loops

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on product engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, product delivery, program management, or related roles with demonstrated roadmap ownership and delivery accountability
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery across multiple teams and workstreams, including planning, sequencing, dependency management, risk and issue management, and executive reporting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready briefings and synthesize complex topics for diverse stakeholder audiences
  • Experience operating in a controlled or regulated environment with demonstrated sensitivity to legal, privacy, and risk considerations
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across multiple programs and teams without relying on formal authority
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field such as security studies, intelligence studies, computer science, cybersecurity, data analysis, or a related discipline

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Prior experience within a global security or comparable enterprise security organization delivering products used by operational threat programs
  • Familiarity with insider threat, strategic threats, workplace violence, investigative or analytical workflows, or behavioral threat concepts
  • Experience with threat detection or analytics platforms and concepts such as user activity monitoring, user behavior analytics, rules and policy engines, alert triage workflows, and metrics-driven performance monitoring
  • Data fluency including experience with query tools, dashboards, or visualizations, and comfort partnering with data science and engineering teams
  • Demonstrated ability to build repeatable delivery frameworks, product playbooks, and institutional knowledge within a complex, matrixed organization

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
Owns moderately complex components within platform services ; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

  • Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.

  • Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.

  • Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.

  • Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

  • Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

  • Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.

  • Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.

  • Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.

  • Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.

  • Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

  • Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.

  • Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

  • Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.

  • Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

  • May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.

  • Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

  • Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

  • Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.

  • Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

  • Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

  • Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

  • Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

  • Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:

  • Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:

  • Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: Licensing Coordinator
description:
The Law Society of BC is seeking a permanent, full-time Licensing Coordinator in our Registration & Licensee Services department. Reporting to the Director, Registration & Licensee Services, the Licensing Coordinator (LC) is tasked with regular day-to-day activities to ensure the core functions of the department are operating efficiently and effectively while carrying out the Law Society’s mandate.
The LC position plays a key role in overseeing the performance, productivity, and workflow for all student-related applications, while also processing assigned complex applications and change requests, and responding to inquiries from applicants, licensees, the public, and other stakeholders. This role monitors student application activities, addresses escalated applications, requests and inquiries, performs other student administration duties, and provides guidance and support to the team when needed. Acting as a key point of coordination across roles, the LC collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to support timely and effective service delivery. In addition, the LC monitors the department‘s phone and email operations to ensure inquiries are addressed within the established service standards. This role also leads process improvements initiatives, supports the implementation of departmental changes, and participates in broader organizational projects.
The duties of this position include:

Review applicant eligibility, assess requirements, process complex, critical and urgent applications, submissions and requests in accordance with the Law Society’s regulatory framework including the Legal Profession Act, the Law Society Rules, and organizational and departmental policies and procedures. Process related financial transactions, including issuing invoices and refunds and accepting payments, as required.
Respond to general and complex queries from applicants, lawyers, and other external parties.
Monitor student application activities and the department’s phone and email operations to support timely processing and established service standards.
Conduct follow-ups with applicants and students for assigned processes.
Conduct quality reviews of application data and assigned applications to support accuracy, completeness and consistency.
Provide guidance and operational support to staff across the department, including assistance with complex inquiries or applications, and application of legislation, policies, processes, and task prioritization, escalated matters and workload pressures.
Liaise with internal and external partners to coordinate student-related activities.
Lead department projects and support the implementation of process, system, and operational changes as assigned by the Director.
Prepare affidavits and statutory declarations.
Provide training to new department staff and other law society team/staff when assigned.
Provide relief coverage and operational support for other departmental roles as required.
Perform other related duties as required by the Director.

A list of responsibilities and duties in detail can be found in Appendix A: LEODOCS-#5379979-Job Description (Appendix A) - Licensing Coordinator
Qualifications
Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum five years of relevant regulatory experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of three years of supervisory experience or in other roles involving responsibility for guiding and supporting the work of others.
Demonstrated experience processing and assessing regulatory applications, including complex applications, requests, or matters requiring interpretation and application of established requirements, policies and procedure.
Direct experience with the Law Society’s registration and licensing applications, processes, and systems is a strong asset.

Regulatory & Legal Knowledge:

Strong understanding of the role of regulation within the legal profession and legislative frameworks governing regulation is an asset.
Knowledge of the Law Society’s regulatory framework, including applicable legislation, Rules, policies, procedures, and registration and licensing requirements, is a strong asset.
Knowledge of the Law Society’s student enrolment, licensing, and related application processes is a strong asset.
Experience in interpreting and applying legislation, rules, policies, and procedures to application assessment, operational decision-making, or day-to-day regulatory work.
Knowledge of and experience in applying basic administrative law principles is an asset.
Familiarity with legal terminology or formal legal training is an asset.

Communication & Team Collaboration:

Strong verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to explain complex information clearly
Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and operational support to colleagues on complex applications, processes, policies, and procedures.
Ability to maintain tact, a calm demeanor, and objectivity when working with diverse groups or in high-stress situations.
Experience in drafting, proofreading and editing broad communication materials and procedural manuals in clear, concise, plain language is an asset.
Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Organizational, Time Management & Problem-Solving Skills:

Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to independently prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of work, and meet deadlines under pressure.
Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to interpret, research, and apply complex standards to provided information.
Demonstrated ability to identify issues, exercise sound judgment, and recommend practical solutions to complex application, compliance, or operational matters.
Ability to assess operational priorities and support the coordination of workloads in a high-volume processing environment.

Leadership, Adaptability & Initiative:

Strong leadership skills with an ability to build and maintain a high performing team and effective working relationships.
Ability to be agile and adapt to changing business and operational needs, conditions and work responsibilities.
Commitment to building a supportive, dynamic team culture, with strong engagement abilities.
Ability to maintain objectivity, fairness, and discretion when dealing with sensitive or confidential information.
Experience in leading process improvement projects or initiatives or implementing system or process changes.
Demonstrated initiative, intellectual curiosity, and ability to identify opportunities to improve processes, service delivery, team effectiveness and culture, and user experience.

Technical Proficiency

Strong working knowledge of database management systems and Microsoft Office applications including Word, Outlook, and Adobe.

Intermediate Microsoft Office Excel working knowledge including experience in reconciling data sheets and using Pivot tables for efficient statistical reporting.
Commitment to continual learning.

The salary range for this position is $75,780 to $82,370.

We welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to contribute to the future of our organization. In accordance with the Law Society of B.C.’s commitment to reconciliation, we seek to create a culturally safe space and to continue further improving relationships with Indigenous peoples.
The closing date for this competition is October 23, 2026. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
The Law Society of BC supports hybrid work schedules. This position is located at the Law Society of British Columbia office in the Yaletown area of Vancouver, BC.

title: QC Examiner
description:
Location: Boise, ID, Full-time onsite

SUMMARY/PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:The Quality Control Examiner is responsible for the ongoing development, implementation and integrity of the quality management system including Therma Quality Policy Statement, QC Standard Operating Procedures, and the ASME QC Manual functions. This position will work closely with management and employees to provide a highest quality working environment and develop a culture committed to highest quality workmanship and conscious record keeping and performance. The QCE must be able to administer, and assure implementation of construction quality programs, Code compliance, good manufacturing practice, good documentation practice, training and assuring compliance with corporate procedures. The QCE is responsible for the QC oversight of piping, pressure vessel, sheet metal and structural metal fabrications and record keeping throughout the large, multi-faceted operations of this organization. As the QCE, this person must be able to respond, investigate, report any non-conformances utilizing their experience and knowledge with Code requirements, regulations and customer specifications.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsible for implementation and assisting in the continuous improvement of the QC procedures and programs, policies and cultures.
Provide a workplace culture committed to highest quality and customer complaint free performance.
Perform welder training and witness certification testing of shop and field welding personnel.
At direction of QC Manager, investigate all external and internal Customer Complaints and other non-conformances related to quality workmanship issues to determine root causes & preventative measures. Assist QCM with Corrective Action Plan implementation and verification of completion of Customer Complaints or Non-Conformances.
Inspect production welding and assemblies on a routine basis to identify/correct potential workmanship issues & ensure Code regulation compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS / REQUIREMENTS:

American Welding Society- Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)certification
Committed to the company’s core values, leading by example, and exemplifying these values within written and verbal communications, conduct, and actions
Must be an effective communicator (oral and written) with the ability to operate effectively without supervision. Must possess engaging training and presentation skills.
A minimum of 5 years construction experience.
A minimum of 2 years in a position with welding quality or welding responsibilities.
Current valid driver’s license

QUALIFICATIONS / PREFERRED:

Experience with ASME Biopharmaceutical Equipment documentation and Quality Control requirements.
Experience with SEMI standard for high-purity installation for the semiconductor industry.

Delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience by providing expert photo services, digital passport photos, and support for customer service transactions, including FedEx, Western Union, and online order fulfillment. Owns the inventory, organization, and operational readiness of the photo department by maintaining supplies, monitoring inventory levels, and ensuring product and service availability to meet customer needs. Promotes photo products and services, assists customers at checkout registers, accurately processes transactions and cash handling activities, supports merchandising initiatives, and collaborates with team members to maintain a clean, safe, and customer focused environment while achieving operational and business goals.

Customer Experience

Takes ownership of customer concerns, resolving issues and answering questions to ensure a positive and seamless experience.

• Provides customer support for service offerings, including FedEx, Western Union, and other auxiliary services, while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
• Maintains photo equipment and utilizes store systems and technology to support daily operations, troubleshoot issues, and deliver quality results.

• Follows company policies, asset protection standards, and applicable regulatory requirements to help ensure a safe, compliant, and secure environment.
• Collaborates effectively with team members, maintains respectful working relationships, and completes additional assignments as needed to support business objectives.

Training & Personal Development
• Attends training and completes e-Learnings requested by Manager or assigned by
corporate.

  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)

  • Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
  • Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Ukraine Remote)
description:
Turnitin is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with a strong focus on backend development, particularly in Java and serverless architectures, combined with solid frontend experience. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about building scalable distributed systems, data modeling, and delivering high-performing, reliable software solutions for our award-winning educational platform.

As a core contributor to our shared services team, you will play a key role in developing and enhancing the foundational systems that power both existing and new applications.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge/Experience:

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and data modeling.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and collaborate with stakeholders across various locations, including distributed teams based in Europe and the USA, to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Practical experience in cloud technologies and frameworks, specifically developing serverless applications on AWS using technologies such as lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway and SNS/SQS/EventBridge.
  • Extensive experience with software development best practices (e.g. design patterns, test-driven development, code profiling, debugging).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools, including build, deployment and test automation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues in agile environments.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge/Experience:

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.

Global Benefits

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. title: Controls Room - Quant Modeling Lead  - Vice President
description:
As a Quant Modeling Lead within the Controls Room Team, you will design and build agentic systems that strengthen control monitoring, analytics, and decision support across the Firm. Our mission is to work across agent architecture, workflow orchestration, tool and data integration, and the design of agent reasoning patterns to enable natural, multi-step problem solving. This is a high-impact opportunity within our Control Management organization that comes with great visibility across all groups at the firm and the ability to impact thousands of employees by increasing efficiency in their day to day.

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team’s objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence into all lines of business and corporate functions.

The Controls Room gathers information from key business and technology partners in order to:

  • Facilitate better decision making and actionable insights across the Firm.
  • Create cost-effective and automated reporting; and
  • Provide views into risk and issues.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on agentic AI solutions, multi-agent architectures, and autonomous system design, providing strategic guidance and technical leadership across the organization.
  • Design, architect, and implement dynamic multi-agent orchestration frameworks that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, coordinate, and adapt in real-time to solve complex control and risk management problems.
  • Research, prototype, and productionize innovative agentic solutions leveraging state-of-the-art techniques in agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), and autonomous decision-making systems.
  • Develop sophisticated agent coordination mechanisms, including communication protocols, task allocation strategies, consensus algorithms, and emergent behavior management for distributed agent systems.
  • Build and deploy production-grade multi-agent systems that integrate seamlessly with strategic control management platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and real-time performance.
  • Collaborate with Tech partners to architect agentic AI services using modern orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom-built solutions) and deploy them within enterprise environments.
  • Lead the development of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning, planning, tool use, memory management, and self-improvement through feedback loops.
  • Research data to discover insights and formulate relevant high-impact business questions that can be addressed through agentic AI and multi-agent approaches.
  • Stay at the forefront of research in agentic AI, multi-agent systems, and autonomous AI, continuously implementing state-of-the-art methods and models.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Master's degree/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or related technical
  • Minimum of 7+ years of AI/ML experience with at least 5 years specializing in multi-agent systems, agentic AI architecture, and autonomous agent development
  • Deep expertise in multi-agent orchestration frameworks and dynamic agent coordination, including experience with agent communication protocols, task decomposition, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Proven track record of designing and deploying production-scale agentic solutions that demonstrate autonomous reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom multi-agent orchestration systems
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures including ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflection, Tree of Thoughts, and other advanced reasoning patterns
  • Extensive experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) as reasoning engines for agentic systems, including prompt engineering for agent behaviors, function calling, and tool use
  • Able to design comprehensive evaluation frameworks for multi-agent systems, including both intrinsic and extrinsic metrics aligned with business goals
  • Able to independently research and propose innovative agentic solutions with strategic vision for problem-solving
  • Excellent communication skills to work with non-specialists in a partnership model, convey complex technical concepts clearly, and create trust with stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or related technical

  • Experience with agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, semantic, episodic)
  • Knowledge of agent safety, alignment, and governance frameworks
  • Familiarity with graph-based agent workflows and state machines
  • Experience with vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for agentic systems
